Texas A.G. Ken Paxton has now sued Travis County ( Austin ) and Bexar County ( San Antonio ) over their plans to try and register unregistered voters. The suits seek to stop officials in both counties from mailing voter registration applications to non-registered residents of those counties.
Paxton claims he's not done, either, and has threatened Harris County ( Houston ) by letter as they consider similar measures to increase voter participation.

Peter,

When I arrived at West Point as a new cadet, I had no idea how much it would transform my life. During my first plebe summer, after a long day of training, a sermon on Psalm 121 made an imprint on my soul, strengthened my faith, and sustained me through difficult times.

I'm Dave McCormick. I'm a West Point grad, combat veteran who served in the 82nd Airborne, a 7th-generation Pennsylvanian, and running in the #1 battleground race that WILL decide the Senate majority.

# Melton for Iowa 2024
---
---
| Hello Peter,

This is Ryan Melton, Democrat running for the U.S. House in Iowa's 4th Congressional District. During my 2024 campaign, I'll send you a weekly email to keep you in the loop while not overwhelming your inbox. Typically, the newsletter will be a review from the week prior: Where we went, what issues of note were on the minds of those I met with, where we'll be in the next week, etc.
Where I went on the campaign trail last week: Last week, I did some tabling at Iowa State University, where I had the chance to chat with a number of students, I spoke at the Stew Dinner with the Humboldt Co Dems in Humboldt, and had a lively get together with supporters in Sioux City. I also spent a lot of my time putting the finishing touches on our radio, streaming audio, and streaming video ad campaigns for our final push.
The pressing issue on the campaign trail last week: The cancer crisis in our state continues to be at front of mind for me. My first volunteer ever for our first campaign back in '22, a central part of that campaign, was diagnosed with terminal cancer right before the start of my '24 campaign. My father, who has spent most of his life just over the border in Omaha, was recently diagnosed with cancer and had surgery not too long ago. So many folks I meet on the campaign trail have cancer or have loved ones with it, and they feel helpless as they see so many of our state's elected officials refuse to even acknowledge this crisis that in reality should have alarm bells ringing in every community in this state.
Iowa has the second highest cancer incidence rate in the country and is the only state with a rising cancer incidence rate. If elected, I would push as hard as I could to get the funding necessary to take a look at the science, do more to fill the knowledge gaps that are out there, and then press our regulatory agencies to mitigate the roots they discover. To do this, I anticipate we'll really need to tackle regulatory capture here, as many of the governmental agencies there to protect us from corporate excess and largesse are unfortunately often unduly influenced by those corporate titans that are polluting our air and our water.
I can't think of many more jarring indictments of the leadership of the ruling party of this state than their complete silence on this cancer crisis that is harming so many. A true test of whether a politician is in it for themselves or for us is whether they hide behind any plausible deniability they can find, or whether they tackle issues that are harming us head on. Yes, there is some plausible deniability when it comes to our state's cancer crisis regarding the root causes, and we shouldn't assume anything, but that plausible deniability will only continue as long as our elected officials continue to take big money donations to look the other way. We need to get to the roots of the crisis now, and one vital step is to vote out those who could be pulling the levers of power on our behalf but who instead are selling our public health out to the highest bidder.
Our schedule for this week: In the last week, I'm thinking I'll do some door knocking and sign planting each evening in cities throughout the district. I'll also be doing some more press and radio interviews and will be filling out more Q and A asks from district newspapers. On Saturday, I'll be joining my friends, State Houses candidate Benjamin Schauer and Roseanne Plante, on a tri-county tour out in Western Iowa. Schauer is leading, so I'm awaiting the details of the times and places, but I'll post on my campaign socials when I know more.
Recent press/social media posts of note: Recent interviews:
https://www.timesrepublican.com/news/todays-news/2024/10/meet-the-candidates-2024-u-s-house-district-4-pt-1/
https://www.timesrepublican.com/news/todays-news/2024/10/meet-the-candidates-2024-u-s-house-district-4-pt-2/
https://www.kcci.com/article/close-up-early-voting-iowa-elections/62639461
https://www.kwit.org/podcast/whats-the-frequency/2024-10-18/whats-the-frequency-incumbent-feenstra-and-democrat-melton-weigh-in-on-their-iowa-4th-congressional-district-rematch
https://nonpareilonline.com/news/state-regional/government-politics/elections/feenstra-melton-rematch-iowa-fourth-district/article_fa22563f-c4ac-5812-82dd-75c0378e380d.html
https://iowastatedaily.com/303095/news/meet-the-candidates-running-in-iowas-4th-congressional-district/

We again are rejecting all Corporate PAC money, so we really rely on, and are extremely grateful for your support. We'll spend your donations on ways to expand our reach to as many voters as possible, including: -Post cards and other mailers and postage -Hand out cards for events -Text messaging campaigns -Transportation costs for events and door knocking -Campaign website costs -Radio ads, Social Media Ads, and (hopefully) TV ads -Our campaign staffers
Finally, if you have anyone else in mind that would like to be added to our email list or who would be interested in volunteering, let us know at melton4iowa@gmail.com!
Let's keep fighting the good fight together! Ryan Melton

I also spent a lot of my time putting the finishing touches on our radio, streaming audio, and streaming video ad campaigns for our final push. The pressing issue on the campaign trail last week: The cancer crisis in our state continues to be at front of mind for me. My first volunteer ever for our first campaign back in '22, a central part of that campaign, was diagnosed with terminal cancer right before the start of my '24 campaign. My father, who has spent most of his life just over the border in Omaha, was recently diagnosed with cancer and had surgery not too long ago. So many folks I meet on the campaign trail have cancer or have loved ones with it, and they feel helpless as they see so many of our state's elected officials refuse to even acknowledge this crisis that in reality should have alarm bells ringing in every community in this state. Iowa has the second highest cancer incidence rate in the country and is the only state with a rising cancer incidence rate. If elected, I would push as hard as I could to get the funding necessary to take a look at the science, do more to fill the knowledge gaps that are out there, and then press our regulatory agencies to mitigate the roots they discover. To do this, I anticipate we'll really need to tackle regulatory capture here, as many of the governmental agencies there to protect us from corporate excess and largesse are unfortunately often unduly influenced by those corporate titans that are polluting our air and our water. I can't think of many more jarring indictments of the leadership of the ruling party of this state than their complete silence on this cancer crisis that is harming so many. A true test of whether a politician is in it for themselves or for us is whether they hide behind any plausible deniability they can find, or whether they tackle issues that are harming us head on. Yes, there is some plausible deniability when it comes to our state's cancer crisis regarding the root causes, and we shouldn't assume anything, but that plausible deniability will only continue as long as our elected officials continue to take big money donations to look the other way. We need to get to the roots of the crisis now, and one vital step is to vote out those who could be pulling the levers of power on our behalf but who instead are selling our public health out to the highest bidder. Our schedule for this week: In the last week, I'm thinking I'll do some door knocking and sign planting each evening in cities throughout the district. I'll also be doing some more press and radio interviews and will be filling out more Q and A asks from district newspapers. On Saturday, I'll be joining my friends, State Houses candidate Benjamin Schauer and Roseanne Plante, on a tri-county tour out in Western Iowa. Schauer is leading, so I'm awaiting the details of the times and places, but I'll post on my campaign socials when I know more. Recent press/social media posts of note: Recent interviews: We again are rejecting all Corporate PAC money, so we really rely on, and are extremely grateful for your support. We'll spend your donations on ways to expand our reach to as many voters as possible, including: -Post cards and other mailers and postage -Hand out cards for events -Text messaging campaigns -Transportation costs for events and door knocking -Campaign website costs -Radio ads, Social Media Ads, and (hopefully) TV ads -Our campaign staffers Finally, if you have anyone else in mind that would like to be added to our email list or who would be interested in volunteering, let us know at melton4iowa@gmail.com! Let's keep fighting the good fight together! Ryan Melton == | | | | | | | | == | == == == | == | P.O. <https://secure.winred.com/hogan-for-maryland-inc/bio-footer-acs?utm_medium=pemail&utm_source=rs_acs&utm_campaign=20241028_democrat-money-email-3-rs_aaey_acs&amtposition=2>
Hi, it’s Governor Larry Hogan.

When I launched my campaign for the U.S. Senate, I did so with a deep resolve
to maintain the leadership style and principles that guided me during my eight
years as governor.

Fifty years ago, my father, Maryland Congressman Larry Hogan Sr. made a tough
decision. He became the first Republican to come out for the impeachment of
President Nixon. He put aside party politics and his own personal
considerations and stepped up to do the right thing for Maryland and the nation.

Today, Washington is completely broken because that kind of leadership and
willingness to put country over party has become far too rare. But it’s not in
my nature to sit back and watch the dysfunction continue without doing what I
can to roll up my sleeves and get to work.

I’m under no illusion this will be an easy road. But I’m no stranger to
uphill battles, and I know I can’t do it without your support.

I don't aspire to be a United States senator. I don’t need a title and I
don’t need a job, but I’m more concerned than ever about the direction of the
country and I have become more convinced that I can make a difference by taking
the approach and style of leadership I had during my eight years as governor to
Washington.

It’s no surprise this mindset has made me a target of the Washington
partisans. Despite early polls showing a lead, I know I’m the underdog in this
race. And that’s why your support TODAY is so crucial.

So if you can chip in a donation of $25 or more, it will go a long way in
helping me continue building a strong campaign.
<https://secure.winred.com/hogan-for-maryland-inc/bio-footer-acs?utm_medium=pemail&utm_source=rs_acs&utm_campaign=20241028_democrat-money-email-3-rs_aaey_acs&amtposition=2>

For eight years, we proved that the toxic politics that divide our nation
didn’t need to divide our state, and we got results! Let’s get back to work
again and send a message to Washington that will be heard loud and clear across
the country!
Will you join me today and help end the dysfunction in Washington?

name: David Hogg
subject: I have to share this with you because it cracked me up
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY LEADERS WE DESERVE, LEADERSWEDESERVE
body:
Most of you know that LWD was co-founded with my good friend Kevin. Last night, we’re in the office around 7:45 pm, and I walk over to him...
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20241028-2&t=1&akid=1375%2E587540%2E1GLTiW)
Peter, I have to share this with you because it cracked me up.
Most of you know that LWD was co-founded with my good friend Kevin. Last night, we’re in the office around 7:45 pm, and I walk over to him...
> **
> Kevin: Dude, I can’t wait to vote tonight.
> Me: Oh did you just get your mail-in ballot or something?
> Kevin: What do you mean?
> Me: You said you can’t wait to vote tonight.
> Kevin: Ohhhh haha I meant to say I can’t wait to SLEEP tonight!!
> **
We are so damn sleep-deprived right now. Getting slightly delirious. 🫠
But as tired as we are, I wouldn’t change a thing. We are exactly where we need to be. Doing the work. Because this country is in a pivotal moment. The doors we knock, donations we make, ads we run, and friends we talk to in these final days will determine our future and fate.
**Late last week, Leaders We Deserve crossed 140,000 donors since our August launch.** Because of all the grassroots support, we’ve built a juggernaut electoral machine to mobilize young voters and elect a new generation of leadership.
But, unless you gave through another email address, it doesn’t look like you’re one of those 140,000 donors. So, I’m humbly asking today if you’ll join them and make a donation to help us win these elections.
**[Can you make your first donation right now? Whether you can give $5 or $500, I promise you one thing: Kevin, our entire team, and I will not rest in putting your hard-earned money to good use turning out voters in the final days.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20241028-2?refcode=em20241028-1375&amount=5&refcode2=1375_587540_1GLTiW&akid=1375%2E587540%2E1GLTiW)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20241028-2?amount=5&refcode=em20241028-1375&refcode2=1375_587540_1GLTiW&akid=1375%2E587540%2E1GLTiW)**
With so many elections coming down to tiny margins, it’s no exaggeration to say that the work we do right now may represent a tipping point in any given race.
That’s why these donations are so meaningful.
Donate. Knock doors. Talk to friends. Get out and vote early.
In the words of my friend Tim Walz... “We’ll sleep when we’re dead.”
**David Hogg**
Leaders We Deserve

| **Meet Kevin Lincoln
**
My name is Kevin Lincoln, and my story, is the Valley’s story. I am a 3rd generation Stocktonian, raising a 4th generation in the city I love. I’m the grandson of Mexican immigrants, and my stepfather is an Army veteran.

Like many Stocktonians, my family has overcome economic setbacks. My own father struggled to survive on these streets, and was at one time, homeless. But I never let adversity define me. I joined the Marines and served in the White House Military Office, assigned to Marine One. I graduated college while working full-time and raising a family. I’ve worked in corporate America and served our community as a pastor, and as a non-profit leader.

I’m blessed with a beautiful wife, Bonnie, and two amazing children. I’ve lived a life of service, but the greatest honor of my life has been giving back to my community, through serving as Mayor of my hometown, Stockton.

Friends -
I’ve been voting for over 40 years, and my first vote was for Ronald Reagan. And in 2022, I did something I had never done before: campaigned on behalf of a Democrat, for Elissa Slotkin in her congressional campaign.
I endorsed Elissa in her race in 2022 because I had seen her work in the House, and I know that she is someone who is laser-focused on doing the right thing for the people she represents and will put service to our country over service to herself, every time.
The choice to me was clear then, and it’s even clearer now. **That’s why I am supporting Elissa Slotkin in her campaign for United States Senate in Michigan.**
The stakes in this election are unlike anything we've ever faced before. But the future of our democracy is on the line, and this is not about policy differences. It’s about doing what’s right for our country.
Donald Trump, if he is reelected with a Republican Congress, will be far more dangerous than we have ever seen before.
And if Elissa loses in Michigan, he will likely get that chance.
We have a responsibility to future generations to ensure that our republic survives. This is not just about the next four or six years—it’s about the kind of country we want to leave for our children and grandchildren.

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

Is Mitch McConnell secretly stabbing conservative senators in the back this November? That's the scoop, according to _The Hill: "**Cruz and Scott, both McConnell critics, get cold shoulder amid tough races."**_

|

|

Recent polls in Texas and Florida show incumbent Senators **Ted Cruz** and **Rick Scott** in neck-and-neck races against leftwing Democrat challengers with control of the Senate hanging in the **balance**. Yet, while McConnell’s money machine is pouring cash into some Senate races, it’s conspicuously ignoring these two key states. _Everyone knows why._ Ted Cruz and Rick Scott are conservative patriots, not leadership lapdogs. They fight for the American people and for the Constitution, which means they often challenge the Beltway Establishment. **[**Please don't sleep on these Senate races. Support Ted Cruz and Rick Scott with a split contribution today.**](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=c178ffe0945d4506a346fcbd8254b388&_e=2JOdegCVeKiDxkr9fMbC46wYYVFBMFrpdX8D1WneBUnU9ych2imyCmCYiVjf8IoHX3q_ZfzxEZ0swHmWYVSItOBtJ_iE6jZlELPXOwEuP4dqS5LIVt2lrI2Mf8iZcE_W0-f8hytbktKPxXO6rcOXRy1VIxVs8yP6U8grbbQOIMpZml646WW3nZdGYCJGMyxCJjssRAoBfLna2kVtNFVAdgMSR7hsKwUplHbybC1sEXeuy_63XsfCnkl0oP6N9IDo)** **_"Mitch McConnell runs the largest Republican super PAC in the country," said Senator Cruz. "It has $400 million, but that super PAC is used to reward the Republican Senators who obey him and to punish those who dare to stand up to him_."** So while Democrats pump millions into Texas and Florida to turn them blue, Washington Republicans are slow-walking their support — even as these races tighten. **Born and raised in the Twin Cities, Royce White was the son of a single mother and started playing sports at the age of 5 years old. Living in various neighborhoods growing up, much of his family remained in the Rondo community, where he spent much of his time and received schooling. White excelled at basketball and recieved a scholarship to play basketball at the University of Minnesota, and later transferred to Iowa State. He would go on to make Dean's List while receiving All Big-12 first-team honors and many other basketball awards.

body:

**Don’t let the Ads Fool Alaskans, The Dark Money is Funding The Ads To Stop Our Repeal of Ranked Choice Voting, Out Funding Us 100-1.****Our Repeal Has No Impact on Dark Money Funding, it only addressing Open Primary and Ranked Choice Voting**
---
---
|
---
**“So if the ultimate goal of these changes is to pass ranked-choice voting, it behooves us to know where this revolutionary idea came from and who is behind it. Not surprisingly, the supposedly non-partisan idea is funded by far-left donors like Kathryn Murdoch (wife of one of Rupert Murdoch’s sons) and Alex Soros (son of radical billionaire George Soros).”**
---
**Let's do some digging on the Pro-RCV group here in Alaska. Disclaimer from their most recent newsletter.****The Pro-RCV group appears to be the “Dark Money” they were so worried about, Arabella Advisors and 1630 Fund are about as “Dark Money” as “Dark Money” gets.**_**Their new Incorporation is their top donor.**__**Then "Article Four from Virginia"**__**Then "1630 Fund in Washington D.C."**_
---
This is who is funding the [#RankedChoiceVoting](https://f69e.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=672037a9e5501615f631922e&u=https%3A%2F%2Ftwitter.com%2Fhashtag%2FRankedChoiceVoting%3Fsrc%3Dhashtag_click&w=636d98a80d1d302f275cb244&c=b_67203652534880625de166d5&l=en-US&s=uiroezIGVsuTt002b9v9y4-sNns%3D) group in Alaska 1630 Fund Swiss billionaire whose personal goal is to “(re)interpret the American Constitution in the light of progressive politics” has donated hundreds of millions of dollars to a left-wing group that is dumping millions into state ballot initiatives, a new report from Americans for Public Trust (APT) revealed. Hansjörg Wyss, through his Berger Action Fund, has donated $243 million to the Sixteen Thirty Fund, which “uses its war chest ... to support massive get-out-the-vote drives, issue advocacy campaigns bolstering President Biden’s agenda, liberal pet projects from abortion to immigration, and attack ads against Republican lawmakers,”
---
Swiss billionaire Hansjörg Wyss has been channeling substantial funds into American state ballot initiatives through the 1630 Fund aka Sixteen Thirty Fund, a progressive advocacy group.As reported by Americans for Public Trust, Wyss’s donations, which total around $243 million to the group, have been instrumental in influencing policies across various states, with a significant focus on Michigan. Since 2017, nearly $34 million has been funneled into Michigan to, among other goals, "rewrite the state’s election laws." This massive infusion of cash aims at bolstering liberal causes from immigration to abortion and enhancing Democratic voter turnout. Such activities have sparked controversy and legislative responses aimed at curbing foreign influence in American electoral processes.https://thefederalist.com/2024/04/18/dark-money-group-backed-by-foreign-billionaire-has-dumped-100-million-into-state-ballot-initiatives/1630 Fund is currently funding multiple ballot initiatives in Alaska, including Alaskans For Better Elections AKBE who brought Ranked Choice Voting to Alaska. Also including the recent push for a higher minimum wage. At some point, one must question when the regulators and government officials, elected to safeguard citizens, become tools manipulated by these malicious actors to act against the citizens they are meant to protect.(e.g. we have been attacked 4 times so far 3 times using state offices, we have been spied on, harassed, and our reputations damaged nationwide all because we were trying to address an election system we didn't feel was a good fit for Alaska)I hope you take this threat to your State Seriously, they are incredibly well funded and they are hell bent on making changes to the State of Alaska. This is one of those cases of too big to fail, where you will attack Alaskans and regular people, but applying these rules to a Swiss Billionaire is outside your job and expectations. As a citizen it saddens me to learn that millionaires and billionaires have more influence on a state and the way the state operates than the people who live here.Phil IzonPer State Statutes:**Sec. 15.13.068. Expenditures and contributions by foreign-influenced corporations and foreign nationals.
** (a) A foreign-influenced corporation or foreign national may not, directly or indirectly, in connection with an election under this chapter, make a contribution or expenditure or make an express or implied promise to make a contribution or expenditure.

(b) The provisions of this section prohibit a foreign-influenced corporation or foreign national from making a contribution or expenditure in connection with a state election only to the

subject: This changes everything.

body:
#

Peter—it’s Shelbi, Jon Tester’s Campaign Manager. I just made a tough decision that you need to hear about immediately.
**According to several recent reports, Tim Sheehy lied about his military service.**
1. On the campaign trail, Sheehy claimed he had a gunshot wound in his arm from combat. But according to the **_New York Times**_ , public records, and firsthand accounts—including a Navy SEAL who served with Sheehy—his gunshot wound was from accidentally shooting himself in the arm in Glacier National Park.
2. Days later, _**NBC News**_ released another bombshell report stating Sheehy lied about being “medically discharged” from the Navy.

It’s shocking—and Montanans must know the truth but we’re running out of time.
So I made the difficult decision to launch more television and digital ads today. The money isn’t in the budget yet—but with polls in the margin of error, **running these final ads could be enough to break the tie in Jon’s favor and win this race.**

name: #6 Steve Garvey
subject: Things have changed
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY STEVE GARVEY FOR U
body:
Adam Schiff doesn’t care about Californians – he's just obsessed with taking down Republicans. | | |
---
It’s a gift to have even a moment to spare with a campaign to run and the chaos of life.
---
| |
---
| | Fellow American, I got a few free minutes today, with no meetings and calls. It’s a gift to have even a moment to spare with a campaign to run and the chaos of life.I wanted to take this moment to tell you about why I decided to run for Senate in the first place. You are critical to our success, and I feel like I owe that much to you. The truth is, when I jumped into this race, I had no idea how things were going to go. I’m not a career politician and in what has become a one-party state, we were just hoping to finish in the top two in the March primary election against three democrat candidates. But things have changed. Adam Schiff is my opponent — someone way more interested in _burning_ our country down than building it up. Someone who doesn’t care about the quality of life for Californians who are facing rampant crime, homelessness, drug addiction, inflation, failing school systems, and open borders chaos.Adam Schiff doesn’t care about Californians – he's just obsessed with taking down Republicans.And if he wins, it will be an absolute nightmare for California and the country. He’s dangerous. Really.He's also been raising a ton of money from his unhinged ramblings, and that’s extremely concerning. This is one of the toughest races in the country. But, with your help, we can save the soul of California and start a Republican come back throughout the U.S. **The last end of month deadline before Election Day is right around the corner.** We outraised Adam Schiff in past months but Kamala Harris’ nomination as the Democrat’s candidate for president has energized their grassroots supporters and donors. If we’re going to defeat Adam Schiff, protect millions of Californians, and start the nationwide Republican comeback rally, I’m going to need a ton of support from people like you. We **need** to show our strength this month. So, please: **[Can you make a $6 contribution to my campaign today?](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=aaea9269983949ee859cdcb00cbc44a4&_e=jUq0nsISjqqdO1v1uL3cZUbKRoxsHTNJscSBt4PKxy1_ONZ3r-A5t7EkeOpHjd0XsbkSt49z9z3UXnhlAmu8ulkrkE7TGyIn5OPAXTFZ_8QLsZwf3-jHoJu4DCXhVB5QAtYKZA5RsgXZnGYAdpc5MXis3thpeHgSUBkpQFtwLvi1rKTCTXwCljtxDn3G1_3vkAjuHjaEjJsLgZNllhaongvUlCki2oXyLukFPJpovUGy-gTqiHHC8QHwUUxoudGj49if7_JRbxAuuKe6ZvDmPymwG5yXrikChilDErkhaUWHoOHOaFfy99Qk_C1ty4laS7B6F_U35Kg0hL3ohpKtiggQfTuYOXoPGlwzkbxbhHX_19kl9LhvjIzFyaeK3nNIxuFaWCBa5bJkJcKJPS4sUA%3D%3D) The amount really isn’t as important as the number of donations we receive. clean_body: Adam Schiff doesn’t care about Californians – he's just obsessed with taking down Republicans. | | | It’s a gift to have even a moment to spare with a campaign to run and the chaos of life. | | | | Fellow American, I got a few free minutes today, with no meetings and calls. It’s a gift to have even a moment to spare with a campaign to run and the chaos of life.I wanted to take this moment to tell you about why I decided to run for Senate in the first place. You are critical to our success, and I feel like I owe that much to you. The truth is, when I jumped into this race, I had no idea how things were going to go. I’m not a career politician and in what has become a one-party state, we were just hoping to finish in the top two in the March primary election against three democrat candidates. But things have changed. Adam Schiff is my opponent — someone way more interested in burning our country down than building it up. Someone who doesn’t care about the quality of life for Californians who are facing rampant crime, homelessness, drug addiction, inflation, failing school systems, and open borders chaos.Adam Schiff doesn’t care about Californians – he's just obsessed with taking down Republicans.And if he wins, it will be an absolute nightmare for California and the country. He’s dangerous. Really.He's also been raising a ton of money from his unhinged ramblings, and that’s extremely concerning. This is one of the toughest races in the country. But, with your help, we can save the soul of California and start a Republican come back throughout the U.S. The last end of month deadline before Election Day is right around the corner. We outraised Adam Schiff in past months but Kamala Harris’ nomination as the Democrat’s candidate for president has energized their grassroots supporters and donors. If we’re going to defeat Adam Schiff, protect millions of Californians, and start the nationwide Republican comeback rally, I’m going to need a ton of support from people like you. We need to show our strength this month. So, please: The amount really isn’t as important as the number of donations we receive. Today is National First Responders Day, friend!

Early this year, we witnessed the bravery and compassion of our first responders when San Diego County faced the historic floods and the devastation that followed them.

**Our paramedics, firefighters, lifeguards, police officers, and 911 dispatchers provided immediate assistance to those who were hurt, reunited separated family members, and rescued those trapped in their homes, and we are so grateful for all their work.

[_Click here and add your name, joining Team Monica in thanking all the first responders who took quick action against the destructive floods in January._](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96032684/508718201/1700002265?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTY5NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1NWE4YjhkMS05Njk1LWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=LdxWa70Xz4CqbjJtOHJ13y0bfLuqdW2J5L4QzF1lxrc=&emci=7406becb-9695-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&emdi=55a8b8d1-9695-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&ceid=31112076)**

Oftentimes, their bravery and sacrifice go unnoticed.

When faced with life-threatening emergencies, public health crises, or extreme weather conditions like the floods we saw back in January, our first responders consistently risk their lives to keep us safe.

In our worst moments of fear, our first responders never hesitate to take action, _serving and protecting our County._

Our first responders’ courage, care, and community-centered outlook keep our communities strong every day. As your Supervisor, I am committed to providing our first responders with the resources to continue this important work.

**That’s why it’s vital we take pause, on days like this, to let them know just how much we appreciate them.

[_Take a moment to sign onto our Thank You Card and show our County’s first responders how much we appreciate their service._](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96032686/508718203/1700002265?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTY5NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1NWE4YjhkMS05Njk1LWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=LdxWa70Xz4CqbjJtOHJ13y0bfLuqdW2J5L4QzF1lxrc=&emci=7406becb-9695-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&emdi=55a8b8d1-9695-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&ceid=31112076)**

— Team Monica

Making dinner and taking calls before my evening events — that's just the reality of being a working mom, friend!
As the election heats up (pun fully intended 😉), I find myself taking solace in the normal moments at home. Don't get me wrong, I love being on the campaign trail, too: Talking to voters, traveling around Florida, running a battleground Senate race — I don't take a second of it for granted.

But here's what I also don't take for granted, friend: dinners at home with my three kids and husband, Sundays playing dominoes with my mom, and conversations with my children about what's been going on at school.
I love being a parent. But parents all over our nation — perhaps you, too, friend — share the same sinking feeling right now: Our kids are growing up in a country with fewer freedoms than we had at their age.

_I'm in this race to protect, restore, and defend our freedoms. To preserve our democracy. _

My opponent, Sen. Rick Scott, is directly responsible for confirming Supreme Court justices who have eviscerated reproductive rights and weakened voting rights. **_Ya no más — enough is enough._**
This is our greatest opportunity to defeat extremist Rick Scott and protect our democracy. His approval rating sits at an abysmal 35%, with election experts calling him one of the most vulnerable GOP senators on the ballot. **With Florida likely deciding Senate control, I'm fighting with everything I have to win and ensure my kids — and all kids — grow up with every freedom and opportunity to achieve their American dream.**

name: Bryan
subject: Campaign Update
body:
Early voting is underway, Rally for the Referendum, Pints and Politics in Kenosha, Pancake Breakfast, Knocking Doors, Friday Night Lights, and more! | | | | |
---
| | | | | 8 days until Election Day. Here’s an update from the campaign trail:
---
| **Early Voting is Underway** Early voting has started in Wisconsin and will continue this week.
Early voting is a great, convenient way for people to vote. The weather was perfect last week, but you never know what it’s going to look like next week.
I made sure to vote early last Tuesday!
---
| Take advantage of the good weather. Get your vote in and you’ll be a little more relaxed on election day.
---
[Click Here to Find Your Polling Location!](https://bryansteil.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5855432ef30dec79be4122095&id=a3459b16aa&e=e907534017)
| **Rally for the Referendum** I hosted a get-out-the-vote rally in Greendale last week to encourage Wisconsin voters to vote **YES** on the Citizenship Voting Requirement Amendment.
I was joined by Scott Walker, Ron Johnson, our State Legislators, and local advocates to talk about the importance of making sure only American citizens vote in Wisconsin elections.
---
| Make sure to vote **YES** on the**** Citizenship Voting Requirement Amendment!
---
| **Pints and Politics in Kenosha** Kenosha County is fired up and ready to win next week. The last couple election cycles we’ve seen Kenosha continue moving to the right. And I think we’re going to see that trend continue this election.
---
| I’m grateful for all of our volunteers’ hard work!
---
| **Rallying with State Representative Bob Donovan** I joined State Representative Bob Donovan for a rally in Greendale. We need conservative fighters like Bob Donovan in Madison to be a check on the liberal policies of Tony Evers.
---
| We need to get Bob Donovan across the finish line.
If you live in Greendale or Hales Corners, **make sure you get out and vote for Bob**!
---
| **Knocking Doors in Janesville** I was out in Janesville with State Representative Scott Johnson this weekend. Our team was out knocking doors and bringing our message directly to voters in Rock County.
---
| We need to get Scott Johnson and all of our conservative candidates across the line next week! Make sure to tell your friends and family to finish the ballot.
---
| **Milwaukee Hispanic Outreach Center** We had a great group for our rally with Ron Johnson at the Hispanic Outreach Center on Milwaukee’s south side. If Republicans want to win, we need to bring our message into every community.
---
| Thanks to everyone who joined us!
---
| **Friday Night Lights** It was first round of High School Football playoffs and our team was at Milton High School for their matchup against Westosha Central.
---
| | | | | It was great to see everyone!
---
| **Whitewater Lions Club Pancake Breakfast** It’s tough to beat the pancakes and sausage at the Whitewater Lions Club Pancake Breakfast. It was great to grab a bite before watching the Packers beat the Jaguars!
---
| Thank you for all you do to support our local community.
---
| **Help Our Campaign Finish Strong** We only have 8 days until Election Day and we’re bringing our message to every voter in the district. As you know, **Democrats have spent over $4.2 million attacking me.**
We’re pushing back on these false attacks but we need your help.
If you’re able and willing, please donate to our campaign.
**Donating $5** helps us buy a yard sign.
**Donating $20** helps us send 10 pieces of mail.
**Donating $50** helps us run digital ads targeting undecided voters.
---
[Click Here to Donate!](https://bryansteil.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5855432ef30dec79be4122095&id=8e1b543e63&e=e907534017)
| I’m grateful for your support.
On Wisconsin,
Bryan Steil
---
| | | | [View email in browser](https://mailchi.mp/4df82aaa6578/campaign-update?e=e907534017)
Steil for Wisconsin, Inc. * 1818 Milton Ave # 1448 * Janesville, WI 53545-1129 * USA

body:

---

Last month, some of our largest contributions were sending money directly to state parties that need it most. In fact, there wasn't a part of the country where the support from people like you wasn't felt. Truly, we are fighting to win races up and down the ballot in all 50 states. But there's more: We're working hard on organizing and turning out Democrats who don't vote in every election -- our voters -- the ones who if they vote will help us win. name: Steve Garvey
subject: A few free minutes
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY STEVE GARVEY FOR U
body:
The last end of month deadline before Election Day is right around the corner.

| | |
---
It’s a gift to have even a moment to spare with a campaign to run and the chaos of life.
---
| |
---
| | Friend, I got a few free minutes today, with no meetings and calls. It’s a gift to have even a moment to spare with a campaign to run and the chaos of life.I wanted to take this moment to tell you about why I decided to run for Senate in the first place. You are critical to our success, and I feel like I owe that much to you. The truth is, when I jumped into this race, I had no idea how things were going to go. I’m not a career politician and in what has become a one-party state, we were just hoping to finish in the top two in the March primary election against three democrat candidates. But things have changed. Adam Schiff is my opponent — someone way more interested in _burning_ our country down than building it up. Someone who doesn’t care about the quality of life for Californians who are facing rampant crime, homelessness, drug addiction, inflation, failing school systems, and open borders chaos.Adam Schiff doesn’t care about Californians – he's just obsessed with taking down Republicans.And if he wins, it will be an absolute nightmare for California and the country. He’s dangerous. Really.He's also been raising a ton of money from his unhinged ramblings, and that’s extremely concerning. This is one of the toughest races in the country. But, with your help, we can save the soul of California and start a Republican come back throughout the U.S. **The last end of month deadline before Election Day is right around the corner.** We outraised Adam Schiff in past months but Kamala Harris’ nomination as the Democrat’s candidate for president has energized their grassroots supporters and donors. If we’re going to defeat Adam Schiff, protect millions of Californians, and start the nationwide Republican comeback rally, I’m going to need a ton of support from people like you. We **need** to show our strength this month. So, please: **[Can you make a $6 contribution to my campaign today?](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zdu8uebdog9qr2lq4al36qcrli1g0rmdu21dcs5g_rp22sh2s8i6epj0chie6o31cjh2bs) The amount really isn’t as important as the number of donations we receive. It’s going to add up fast when a ton of people chip in together.******

name: Hillsdale College via First Look News
subject: Learn about the Electoral College
body:
Citizens are free to say what they think. Subjects aren’t.

This sponsored message from First Look News is on behalf of Hillsdale College

| | | [](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2zanfienavl1pe72pp0mmuq7h00avrr8v8vg4kvl0_rp22sh2s8i6epj0c9g64pj0cph2bs)
---
---
| | Dear Friend,

Citizens are free to say what they think. Subjects aren't.

Sadly, the question of whether we are citizens or subjects has become politically controversial in our country. A clear sign of this is the attempt to suppress the expression of obvious truths, such as the fact that boys cannot become girls.

Another sign that many of our leaders consider us subjects is their denial of our right to decide who is allowed to enter our country--indeed, they tell us that if we complain about mass illegal immigration, we are racists.

**This is a pivotal time in our nation 's history--a time when we must stand up and forthrightly demand to be treated as citizens, not subjects. Because freedom hangs in the balance.**

A poisonous ideology has infected almost every major American institution. Only a few still stand in defense of freedom and the right of self-government.

One of the most important of these is **Hillsdale College**. And today, my friends at Hillsdale need your partnership and support in their mission to preserve the blessings of civil and religious liberty through education.

For 180 years, Hillsdale has offered its students the kind of education America's founders thought necessary to sustain free government. And in recent decades, Hillsdale has extended its teaching mission nationwide with a vast national outreach effort.

This outreach effort includes its free publication _Imprimis_ , its free online courses, and its tireless work to return excellence--including excellent civics instruction--to American K-12 education.

And Hillsdale College does all of this while refusing to accept one penny of government funding--not even indirectly through federal or state student grants and loans.

That's why I ask you to take the time to view their video **"[The Electoral College Explained](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2zfdr2av8retfnqb52ah3l0qvlq595nntag2s2nd0_rp22sh2s8i6epj0c9g64pj0cph2bs)"** below and join Hillsdale in defending freedom and the American way of life.

**[https://info.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-video](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2zcko919d1nlm73e92snmc4gtv4k52mifgk42ur10_rp22sh2s8i6epj0c9g64pj0cph2bs)**

Sincerely, [](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2zf8rdvvcpgssfg8sqd888dcui3die5lal7a8th40_rp22sh2s8i6epj0c9g64pj0cph2bs)
Tucker Carlson

| | Dear Friend,

Citizens are free to say what they think. Subjects aren't.

Sadly, the question of whether we are citizens or subjects has become politically controversial in our country. A clear sign of this is the attempt to suppress the expression of obvious truths, such as the fact that boys cannot become girls.

Another sign that many of our leaders consider us subjects is their denial of our right to decide who is allowed to enter our country--indeed, they tell us that if we complain about mass illegal immigration, we are racists.

**This is a pivotal time in our nation 's history--a time when we must stand up and forthrightly demand to be treated as citizens, not subjects. Because freedom hangs in the balance.**

A poisonous ideology has infected almost every major American institution. Only a few still stand in defense of freedom and the right of self-government.

One of the most important of these is **Hillsdale College**. And today, my friends at Hillsdale need your partnership and support in their mission to preserve the blessings of civil and religious liberty through education.

For 180 years, Hillsdale has offered its students the kind of education America's founders thought necessary to sustain free government. And in recent decades, Hillsdale has extended its teaching mission nationwide with a vast national outreach effort.

This outreach effort includes its free publication _Imprimis_ , its free online courses, and its tireless work to return excellence--including excellent civics instruction--to American K-12 education.

And Hillsdale College does all of this while refusing to accept one penny of government funding--not even indirectly through federal or state student grants and loans.

2025 Hillsdale College calendar.

Please see a special message from our sponsor:

Dear
Fellow American,

I'm
reaching out to you today because I'd like to send you your 2025
Hillsdale College calendar.

I know, I
know. It's a little early to be thinking about 2025. But since
you're someone who cares about liberty, I wanted to make sure you
had this chance to get the 2025 calendar.

Claim
your 2025 Hillsdale College calendar before October 31 by

know, we live in an era of increasing bureaucratic despotism.
You've seen it, and you understand. More and more, we are ruled

elected representatives.

therefore, completely unaccountable to "we the people."

This
collapse of the separation of powers has spread far beyond the
federal level into our states, our cities, and maybe even where

One
particularly disturbing example is in our K-12 schools…

At these
schools, swarms of administrators impose dangerous ideologies and

In higher

universities-bloated administrations push ideologies that teach

But

influence. We stay true to our mission…

of civil and religious liberty."

Indeed,
as the crisis in our nation has deepened in recent years, we have
redoubled our efforts to extend this mission nationwide. But
we've only been able to do so thanks to supporters like you.

Just in
the last year, our dedicated supporters have helped to…

4 million Americans in Hillsdale's free online courses, including

especially thousands of K-12 students.

Provide an American classical education to young students
nationwide through K-12 education programs, returning excellence
and proper civics instruction to K-12 classrooms.

Expand the circulation of Imprimis, Hillsdale's monthly digest of

you'll claim your 2025 Hillsdale College calendar so that when

your support is especially crucial because we refuse every penny

state student grants and loans. NOT. ONE. PENNY-to remain
INDEPENDENT!

generosity, and that of tens of thousands of people like you,

enroll millions more Americans in free online courses, expand the
readership of Imprimis, and restore excellence to K-12 education.

# The Preserve Rural America Act
---
---
|
---
| I served as a San Benito County Supervisor during the COVID pandemic, and i saw firsthand the breakdown of local authority, the economic transfer of power from small business to big-box corporatization of important industries (especially with the healthcare industry), the loss individual freedom, and the abuse of rural preservation of critical resources and agricultural land.
Many don't realize that we were under one-man rule in the middle of the lockdowns and mandates for a year and a half. During that time we suffered a complete shift of power away from Rural America toward State and Federal powers.
---
| | |
---
|
It's time for Rural America to have a stronger voice to protect public health, bottom-up economic development, food integrity, resource management, and community stability.

* Make it harder for precious agriculturally productive soil to be overdeveloped, reducing the food production foot print
* Make it illegal to sell these lands to foreign countries
* Prioritize our American workforce in the harvesting and production of these crops

subject: Share your thoughts on CRT and its influence
body:
I’m reaching out because you’re an informed patriot who cares about this country.

This sponsored message from Freedom Nation Today is on behalf of Hillsdale College

| | | [](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=cd64e2b916cd46fabee6ed4b821f0332&_e=FwPfBG6R6fLvHvHOyAK0ww0EgXJLldpoAKCEUTPmPMmY4NboRy6BzNm42g0MQFQwYGhV842Lg5FV7C9ndusJScR-bcE6cUXQzK7Uf2tE2n0xYlr0MCcevVZtr9mhIyGz9bmVnU_BpAwBFZOjHWY7QMB-yo276JgpKoyvNVFTL3Kc4xDLKp8QXgeGIjnNlvKMWkH35jffjRGMHy_bjXkmUwUULJsD6cyf1vXvURktGggY6V5XYmMKisjeGiDr-nZUmfQzBU821w6j1fMoa_nlzb1YACthwDiG-fEm7NyrQzi1avfjGd1vEB8zUfr1iDxOgnDVUKARZE8K-AJhXrsrbpreqdRhhJGBeBE14JxiJnbQ6zi73jzGfvnKfh78zYK7)
---
| | Dear Fellow American,

[**Hillsdale College has selected you to participate in its National Opinion Survey on Critical Race Theory (CRT).**](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=cd64e2b916cd46fabee6ed4b821f0332&_e=FwPfBG6R6fLvHvHOyAK0ww0EgXJLldpoAKCEUTPmPMmY4NboRy6BzNm42g0MQFQwYGhV842Lg5FV7C9ndusJScR-bcE6cUXQzK7Uf2tE2n0xYlr0MCcevVZtr9mhIyGz9bmVnU_BpAwBFZOjHWY7QMB-yo276JgpKoyvNVFTL3Kc4xDLKp8QXgeGIjnNlvKMWkH35jffjRGMHy_bjXkmUwUULJsD6cyf1vXvURktGgg4-vqjtn1ajdUunInMf-V8ZU2QVRZbaAYlLmrFQXCImvpKofK3OTpURZpJCER7DoRdSDmdrGnUSigKRm-sEVl7mkQLje1etz8P7lLXo6pUmWOn39Zf6cXW8xd0mztdwNYs30kLxofepspazc1kM0gg)

I'm reaching out because you're an informed patriot who cares about this country. The situation is urgent, and your response will only take a few moments.

CRT has been around for decades.

Feminist academics used to make arguments about "unpacking their invisible knapsacks of privilege." However, at the time, CRT was rejected for being "just _another_ crazy fringe academic theory."

**Today, the situation is much different ...and much worse.**

_Now_ , CRT infiltrates our schools and workplaces. It's not so laughable for you to have to sit in a meeting or seminar that explains to you your "invisible knapsack of privilege."

To speak up often means you can lose your job, or worse...

What's frightening for the direction of this country is that federal agencies have labeled some parents who oppose CRT as "domestic terrorists."

**This should NOT be happening in America.**

Hillsdale College--where I work--teaches the principles of liberty and justice that our country was founded on. And we're fighting to defend them on the battlefield of education.

**But we need YOUR help to defend our constitutional principles against CRT.** Sharing your opinion with us is one important way you can take action.

**Complete your National Opinion Survey on Critical Race Theory now:[https://info.hillsdale.edu/crt-survey/](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=cd64e2b916cd46fabee6ed4b821f0332&_e=FwPfBG6R6fLvHvHOyAK0ww0EgXJLldpoAKCEUTPmPMmY4NboRy6BzNm42g0MQFQwYGhV842Lg5FV7C9ndusJScR-bcE6cUXQzK7Uf2tE2n0xYlr0MCcevVZtr9mhIyGz9bmVnU_BpAwBFZOjHWY7QMB-yo276JgpKoyvNVFTL3Kc4xDLKp8QXgeGIjnNlvKMWkH35jffjRGMHy_bjXkmUwUULJsD6cyf1vXvURktGggvj0vdVxShCJi9AO772pS83w3-znH62A9LXvXRE-i3SEg0GE4eN4XKbEcxtbi-OqfR620e_BtTg4DioCVzwVA9PeDrOOQUjIIVNWLe86qdvYdw6oJvX8TfZU3vRiCdxfVH9ZJr_d5OsGNQsuHo0ttp)**

When you participate in our survey, you will help us gather the information needed to address CRT's threats to our liberty and find solutions that restore our constitutional principles.

When you finish taking your survey, please consider giving a generous gift.

Our NATIONAL EDUCATION CAMPAIGN--which includes _Imprimis_ , free online courses, and K-12 curriculum and school network--educates millions of citizens about our Constitution and founding principles.

We need your help expanding these initiatives. And because we do not take a single penny of taxpayer funding, even indirectly through federal and state student grants loans--all of our work is funded by informed patriots like you.

Thank you for joining us in our mission on behalf of liberty.

Warm regards,

Bill Gray, '01
Vice President
Institutional Advancement

This sponsored message from Conservative Gives is on behalf of Hillsdale College

| | | [](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=8827dafec2084dff965f47e3b5722ded&_e=I9_SWaZepZLgDyB9zDohkiqb1BsQI8K9d0FECmgi76XkOkomTqsQs-3szFu39XGHSe0foAF5ycK6b2QOdeZisN8r-tgBErcW-f4F6IvIsrcMU7qIYkqmhHjWx2dA2hBbUmTko88LiXINuIUZgdCtaNvgQch_mUfh6vcRilkeBFqnAF7BAeG8yIKHD-vDpbR_o3zMEOtntYjhmtqMxgdSrEQUnKrZiBeMAqx0ctweIPbq_fFXPXxOJkS4U-XqeVTaK3DOj9Ze243J6nz5FkjPd8YmAFiVnKv_tB9OQoHLuyA0nKRaGrfg7Ns6a2PnIwccLJ5us6tN68yfyyaMC5Qw3eX8uKViHUJi3DNnO8XtL64T9aERNiF312_vkGP5ddUzR_PfJKsENohEzav5PM08IYoc1qsYMuKJiNV7sZj4Ojg%3D)

| | Dear Friend,

Citizens are free to say what they think. Subjects aren't.

Sadly, the question of whether we are citizens or subjects has become politically controversial in our country. A clear sign of this is the attempt to suppress the expression of obvious truths, such as the fact that boys cannot become girls.

Another sign that many of our leaders consider us subjects is their denial of our right to decide who is allowed to enter our country--indeed, they tell us that if we complain about mass illegal immigration, we are racists.

**This is a pivotal time in our nation 's history--a time when we must stand up and forthrightly demand to be treated as citizens, not subjects. Because freedom hangs in the balance.**

A poisonous ideology has infected almost every major American institution. Only a few still stand in defense of freedom and the right of self-government.

One of the most important of these is **Hillsdale College**. And today, my friends at Hillsdale need your partnership and support in their mission to preserve the blessings of civil and religious liberty through education.

For 180 years, Hillsdale has offered its students the kind of education America's founders thought necessary to sustain free government. And in recent decades, Hillsdale has extended its teaching mission nationwide with a vast national outreach effort.

This outreach effort includes its free publication _Imprimis_ , its free online courses, and its tireless work to return excellence--including excellent civics instruction--to American K-12 education.

And Hillsdale College does all of this while refusing to accept one penny of government funding--not even indirectly through federal or state student grants and loans.

| CAMPAIGN TV AD - WE CAN DO BETTER
---
|
In our currently running TV Ad, I make the case that the election season 'bipartisan" Hillary Scholten doesn't match her 96% voting record with the Biden-Harris Administration.
The people of West Michigan deserve a leader who stands on what they say and will actually work across the aisle to address our inflation, wide open borders and crippling national debt. Check out our Ad below!
---
[](https://5hqec7gbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001MHzQpax7sT6IBsFy92lCfB7EkcokUEXDxTxiH4BsTZlKeZYENX0pC7IFjJHqvXiWXNruQbbfeOlQWpbn759_rPJfmTJ7RxIdCHHDhFxPcE1gRw8BW6N_zP-npJk0xe8mDLdCrTHUUFmzIwKTVysks2GmRESWZinpJhcuoIpF4vU6RsSlSAeKjg==&c=OqWku_QNG_LiKIiJEQIqt_HeyaKi9xkaeQ9-d3CvOjkABrXz8dCQjw==&ch=AHRG5nrhlAVEqVs5ypu79hAKezGwG88mrLTjvHEoOxnGN8XNWG2bhg==)
---
With only 7 days left in this election, we can continue to [spread our message of a better West Michigan for All with your help!](https://5hqec7gbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001MHzQpax7sT6IBsFy92lCfB7EkcokUEXDxTxiH4BsTZlKeZYENX0pC9_18V2NGI5boO_jbT-hwlMQgiNd00KIDERKn9hTJGG6RXymoqBBqskfJyFEmuF5Jq2r9_zKOj_83IJaS4g04qMWUw4EWYEp81ske77Y0NWg3UyGesOZzUrnaRxK8mFc5caPSnwZnJcVTTy0eYBsyN0xf1gVOsWyOOgbqdsyqGdPXVU2ca97PGf7g1ux5vRFW-BwBkuf0EJZaITFOzFKWIFuAv1I48K-tQ==&c=OqWku_QNG_LiKIiJEQIqt_HeyaKi9xkaeQ9-d3CvOjkABrXz8dCQjw==&ch=AHRG5nrhlAVEqVs5ypu79hAKezGwG88mrLTjvHEoOxnGN8XNWG2bhg==) Every donation we receive will go straight to promoting our TV Ad in homes across the district.
[Your support will help us win this seat back in November and bring common-sense back to West Michigan!](https://5hqec7gbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001MHzQpax7sT6IBsFy92lCfB7EkcokUEXDxTxiH4BsTZlKeZYENX0pC9_18V2NGI5boO_jbT-hwlMQgiNd00KIDERKn9hTJGG6RXymoqBBqskfJyFEmuF5Jq2r9_zKOj_83IJaS4g04qMWUw4EWYEp81ske77Y0NWg3UyGesOZzUrnaRxK8mFc5caPSnwZnJcVTTy0eYBsyN0xf1gVOsWyOOgbqdsyqGdPXVU2ca97PGf7g1ux5vRFW-BwBkuf0EJZaITFOzFKWIFuAv1I48K-tQ==&c=OqWku_QNG_LiKIiJEQIqt_HeyaKi9xkaeQ9-d3CvOjkABrXz8dCQjw==&ch=AHRG5nrhlAVEqVs5ypu79hAKezGwG88mrLTjvHEoOxnGN8XNWG2bhg==)
---
| DONATE TO KEEP THE AD RUNNING
---
| ENDORSEMENTS
---
| From the start of this race, we've been focused on creating a [broad coalition of supporters](https://5hqec7gbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001MHzQpax7sT6IBsFy92lCfB7EkcokUEXDxTxiH4BsTZlKeZYENX0pC8wkhIkWtNfwYFESECeoWvKKtipjVRIR-01ykZkRuvttOFz4SJjOSsX74hRo4tS84CQZORUr1d_OITsywSgzPzyTB2nO9k9bPSNc5U2KvBrI99v3v2SqOLs0x3mtDDwzuCUD467oU9CH&c=OqWku_QNG_LiKIiJEQIqt_HeyaKi9xkaeQ9-d3CvOjkABrXz8dCQjw==&ch=AHRG5nrhlAVEqVs5ypu79hAKezGwG88mrLTjvHEoOxnGN8XNWG2bhg==) who want to see common-sense change in Washington.
We're proud to be the only campaign endorsed by the Detroit News and Grand Rapids Chamber of Commerce PAC, and throughout this campaign, we have proudly rolled out endorsements from 31 strong community leaders and organizations from in and around the district! Here's what a few of them had to say:
---
---
"[Hudson] is perhaps the overall best congressional candidate on the Michigan ballot this cycle. [Paul] embodies the spirit of Gerald Ford, a pragmatic conservative focused on creating a favorable business climate to help bring prosperity to the people of the district. He stands apart from his party's populists and cultural warriors, instead pushing practical, bipartisan solutions to the nation's many problems.
Paul Hudson is the sort of common sense, principled Republican who once defined the GOP in West Michigan. In Congress, he could help return the party to its roots." - The Detroit News
---

"In these crazy times, we can use more people in Congress who have Paul's common sense as well as his deep understanding of the US Constitution. As a candidate, Paul has already demonstrated a serious, sober appreciation for the national security challenges facing our country, whether facing off against China or the crisis on our southern border." - Congressman Jack Bergman

"I've seen first hand Paul's hard work and dedication out in our community ... I'm proud to endorse Paul Hudson for Congress. His experience in the legal sector and his fiscally conservative values are deeply needed to stop DC politicians' reckless spending of our tax dollars and soft on crime policies that have hurt our communities back home." - Senator Roger Victory

We can all feel it in our bones - our country is off track. That's why I created a plan to be our [GPS.](https://5hqec7gbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001MHzQpax7sT6IBsFy92lCfB7EkcokUEXDxTxiH4BsTZlKeZYENX0pC1hyxQaTV4Hx6BtPKTtjf4W3fexJIR60CzInGM6FX3BThApUSIm7lnzqi_MBvB-pFukf1-cfGlnUpdJfIuB0uPcvecAXkDYtMmFYye4tlVGixXuBdWU3AouPIuIhD-9cNw==&c=OqWku_QNG_LiKIiJEQIqt_HeyaKi9xkaeQ9-d3CvOjkABrXz8dCQjw==&ch=AHRG5nrhlAVEqVs5ypu79hAKezGwG88mrLTjvHEoOxnGN8XNWG2bhg==)

---

## Americans Hitting the Polls Early
With one last week to go before Election Day, [over 45.5 million Americans](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0jzGPhCAUhH8NdGseICAFxTV2e-2VhoXn-i4oRonGf39x-2tnkpnv-3kOz0CZlvd3mNHXsQwSZPsQ8JBuSIHyNbQ8-RFRouLohVUgXAct8MljjEoHq0ftUnLKWWOjMM6MgMloazj5e02AdAKU0l2jQme0fYUuINikDGsBE9WyNb-FljrhmK9y4NbEMvPsp1rXnakvJnsm-_M8m-UVFzz3u2eyX0umSnFnsv9gY8ZYqSx3gGHL1-MoFfnm03pSzrQby1p4z4Hy56H-Z3x4-RcAAP__VPFX3Q) have already cast their ballots either in person or via mail. Democrats lead Republicans in early voting 42% to 40%, with the other 18% unknown, and early voters have favored in-person voting over mail-in ballots. Fifty-three percent of early voters are women and 45% are men, and nearly half of all early voters were aged 65 or older. [You can find your state’s results here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0jzGPhCAUhH8NdGseICAFxTV2e-2VhoXn-i4oRonGf39x-2tnkpnv-3kOz0CZlvd3mNHXsQwSZPsQ8JBuSIHyNbQ8-RFRouLohVUgXAct8MljjEoHq0ftUnLKWWOjMM6MgMloazj5e02AdAKU0l2jQme0fYUuINikDGsBE9WyNb-FljrhmK9y4NbEMvPsp1rXnakvJnsm-_M8m-UVFzz3u2eyX0umSnFnsv9gY8ZYqSx3gGHL1-MoFfnm03pSzrQby1p4z4Hy56H-Z3x4-RcAAP__VPFX3Q). In 2020, a record number of Americans voted early. By election day that year [more than 101,450,000 people](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0z7FytCAQAOCngU5mWVSkoPiL31SXMikdhPXcGzwcj1zi22eSPi_wzXzvl-kSOPP9-ho28nUpEwK2jYYG3ZQC53NqZfILEZKR5LU1oN0ALcjVzzZ2zg0GTdQhxT6Bs9bFxVjXGTcnyf5H04BOgzHdoEwY-s7OYQgENpletECJaznUrfC9rrTkszzpULFsMvu11v0hzD-Bo8CRMsW6H-VGsaor1_VjVlwEjv_Dkc_mrVRqEBBeBI58T_Sl1rplefi0f3LO_OitaOG6Bc6_fv3r-_T4HQAA__-M3FbT) had already voted.
## Philadelphia DA Sues Musk to Halt $1M Payouts
Philadelphia District Attorney Larry Krasner is [suing Elon Musk](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLtuhDAURL_GdEZ-8SpcbBRRZSNFKVKiu_iy3MTGCHsX8fcR6dPOaEZH5-s6XIE8Lfd3CGjzFAcllOFScNUNDsgfgymcnRAV6gKtbLSQXSuMKGaL3VSNstMtGCmk6Kpb62pZQdPVtQFsCrLnmxSqk0Lrqi01tHXV3KAFFI3TNTMCHeW4ld-Rljzj5I_4xK0cYyi8nXNeE9MXpnqm-n3fy5CWs2Oqx4U_ElN9iAseTPVjDCsshGe2zuTBoV9nAu6Apwcmjj4uPDzSD8-Rz-Azl4Hf6Ymww3GuYOOXi8zm7WNiuo8jOaZfX043uKdP3NZis27dyXtKdcOMuAcg_4ea_1P3tOo3AAD__wkpcMs) to halt his $1 million daily giveaways to Pennsylvania voters, funded by Musk’s pro-Trump America PAC. [Krasner's lawsuit claims](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kL2OqzAQRp_GdBPZ5s8ULm5Dl9tuiSZhgNkMGNkOEW-_YvvtPumTjo7O1324Iwtv839cyecpDFbbCowG2w0jspxDVYx-IrJUFuRNW2rTOV3pYvE1uWZybdd1D0Kj2wqbyT2nR9s5Y2vdFOwvmtG2M7osa3cr0TV1-0CHpNuxbFSlaeQc4u078JYXmuQMB8XbM6yF-CXnPanyn7K9sv127iHl61K2v8DK9kZf2ynbvxNs9EnK9vvCgiPJvjDCiCAY4wmviGmjCOlNCXKAlMMOJGGD9Z1eCcwKR8gUYeaD8IMnPFGuMsAZWIRmFJCQM8VT2b6Iftw_LMKpaVWl5xVZfrXzXxkPb38CAAD__zgrdWw) the Musk’s lottery, which awards cash randomly to swing-state voters who support a constitutional petition, is an illegal attempt to influence the Nov. 5 presidential election.

Musk’s giveaways have already awarded $1 million each to nine voters across key swing states, with more winners to be announced daily. A court hearing on the matter is [set for Friday](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLFuhDAQRL_GdIvstQ-4wkUaukubEi32cjgxGGHfIf4-In26kWb0NHpfj-FBIYb1-UkL2zKlASUaUBLwPngK8RxM5e3EjKwrtqrVUt07aWQ128k5wm40PDWtJsPsWjc2HrVRzt-8qYK9aEriXUmtb12tqWtu7UgdsWy9boSR7ENJe_2dwlpmnuKZ3rzXLi1VtHMpWxb6Q2AvsD-Oo3br6K5SYH-hBfZKXrkT2G9ziOQ5bnMg8AT5xRk4phWWV_6BjRyUBLmkDRQsIcaQVoipFN5PmNIO71R4z_Vclljt1m_HtclNK4x8LhTi36vyn6W3xd8AAAD__5daalg), as Krasner seeks an injunction to stop further payments.

## Bogus Teacher Certification Scheme Exposed
Investigators with the Harris County District Attorney’s Office uncovered a [massive teacher certification cheating ring](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kDFvgzAQRn-N2YzswzH24KELW7p2RMf5HKwaiMANyb-v0r3jp096enpf1_GKueT19okLh_pM2wgKjNRKgh8j5vIaTRPDpKLXDQfdd0p7Zzw0c0geLAJdgDpI5CMq6i127J2-WNunJoc3TCvwWhkNpqXJW0Jnpyl575ISRnHMddvbOnPlJx6pvLYH7y1tS1PCXOv9EN2HgEHAcJ5n-z1vP-9TwIB7zVRYwLDyeQgYaM_Le1ZGmnmXxHvNKRPWvK2SZsaa15s8CNeIRcAA7iKt65h1TJJ6m6SJ_SS9ASejd73WyielbLOHeD9zKfmwvTDqtmAuf4r132aPAL8BAAD__35zbI4) that provided fraudulent certifications to at least 200 unqualified teachers across the state, including two charged with crimes against children. District Attorney Kim Ogg charged [five alleged ringleaders](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGO6yAQAL_G7rBgzXNMQfEad7n2SgvDYlbCEAGJ478_5frrR6PRfN_Xu6FIaf8yB-r29nkFDpIJzkCtzlC8Vtk7vXGnRI9a3EYu1CwV9EGDQuUkgncclVNK8Fl5gzdrRgf_-NiT_sgEByW4FCAHu6nJmnnaNq_U7HknOTpquQwtYMO3qT5e-YVlsPnoow6tPWo3_u9g6WA5z3Pw-Q1TyM_acvpAHSwJz9rBEkwpVJnNz9QuZgsdyDzGnC5mgyk7VuYpomOHqZVeyBoaG7Awi6WRJ2sa5cRsQNMo7azagAf2RbvHSTFSnW6d5PthKP7WtT93vTT8BAAA__-XBnGJ) on Monday, including Booker T. Washington High School basketball coach Vincent Grayson, who is accused of organizing the scheme. Grayson is believed to have made over $1 million. Other alleged suspects include a proxy test-taker, test proctors who were bribed to look the other way, and an assistant high school principal who [recruited nearly 100 teachers](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGO2zAQRL-G6tYgVzxbLFSkUXdpUxrr5UpaHEUeKNo6_32g9OkGmME8zPz5vH-SJs3Lb9pkbD9zuaNFD84ChnskTe-77-L4sDG4TkZ3660Lgw_YraPtaY7oe7E20vWDHDvne8Ih3OyNe-50PMucxeCsd-gv_AhXpuH6eMwhDLM13krUVuqlrdLkh_Y5vctL6oXL1qVxbe17N_0vg5PB6TiOCyflL1zLc28lnymDU5ZjNzilwpQMTifT4OTsqYfT0JfAB1CtsjeJoBncBk2IV6nAUpvOytS0ZOBVqGleYOdVNoGVatUduDxze0Mk-NINyrIA5VyemeUkd3WM34empPv1ZrxdNtL0b0L776evEf8GAAD__xUoei8) to participate in the scheme. Houston ISD said the employees charged with crimes would be dismissed immediately, and administrators would investigate whether any active teachers had obtained fraudulent certifications.
## Roberson Family Speaks Out On Halted Execution
Family members of death row inmate Robert Roberson and Nikki, his two-year-old daughter he was convicted of killing in 2002, are speaking out on both sides of the ongoing public debate [about his guilt and suspended execution](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00L2OqzAUBOCngc7IPjiACxe3octtt0T-OYQjjB3ZTkjefpXVtluORvo0mq_rcjUUKN7-mwN1fa1pAQ6SCc5ALd5QeC-y9dpyr0SLWow9F2qSCtpNj-Auoxouvh8MDl6JyRpcwfa9xHHEqSX9wQQHJbgUIDtn1eDMNFi7KjWtvJEcPdWUu7phxZcpa3inJ-bOpaMNeqv1Xpr-XwNzA_N5nt2Odf-UDcwRz9LAHJIzgf0GfLnwKPREFmnfiblHrlTYag4Kb2Yzmr2wQgGjQ5Yiy8liLimyDU2mePsYbdb-flIIVIaxkfx2GAo_g-qfDz01fAcAAP__RfFrgw). Nikki’s brother, aunt, and grandfather wrote a letter criticizing lawmakers for their role in stopping Roberson’s execution, arguing that the persistent focus on “shaken baby syndrome” has [overshadowed other factors](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kL3O3CAQAJ8Gd2vBGv9QuEjj7kub8rTA-kDizAmIfX77KEn9VdONNPPr6_FFMcXj-ZNevLbPnh8oUYOSgObhKab7oTu_WumN6nhV8yCVWbTBLqzIkxqJyNjBDoy7VXZWu5-Q58HSrLu4_pUpiUZJrVD3zprJ0TJZuxuz7FJoyT62XPoWuPGH6p7ufHLpXX51aQ2tvasYfgjcBG7XdfXOVmX6dgrcqLToEgvcDr6qwC1lR0ngttMrphvyDiVbLu0_aj4qePr9DI0LVLortMB3YXD5OOPh2EPgCj4Wdi3dULi-81GjTQyBC3imFgRuo1QgWWkrhxEGs0ygx3mEhSYF3tnRLCMvC-uurP59xZRinWah5fNFMf0La9-ePlf8EwAA__-1aoER) pointing to Roberson’s guilt. Meanwhile, Roberson’s brother [released his own letter](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGO6yAURL8Gd1hwTWxTULzGXV67pQXmEiNjE8HdOPn7VaJttxqNRhodna_rfLUxxeP23-5o6BnyDAIUl4KDnr2N6TWrxhsnvJYNGjl0QupRaWhWM3QwKj0s_uJ6Lz10okeBLgTnne_9pYnmfSYFaCmUBNUuTveLHXvngtZjEEwJ9JFyaWlFwqetIb3yA0u75L1JZiW6V9b9YzAxmM7zbDek7T0ymA48K4Mp5cUm_ltKdliIf6Lmo3JXMq1YeMF6z4evnDI_4rZFvnwXipUHu8f0qjwhERYGU1OMv58xpVj7gSlx221MHx76U9DDwE8AAAD__2QQa-k) saying he didn’t believe Roberson was capable of killing someone and that Nikki’s relatives had agreed Roberson should have custody of her when she turned two. Last Thursday, members of the Texas House Committee on Criminal Jurisprudence [issued a rebuttal](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0j7GOgzAQRL_G7ox2Nw7gwsU1dLn2SmTjdWLJwQh8gfz9ifRXzRSjeXo_t_HmUk7z_ds92dYjlpGAtEJQZMbgUn6PWgbrIRiUbLG7AJpeG5IPi861iNSj9uEaoWXviC4cOuqAvAaZ7HmGQAZBI-lm8qadXN96H43pIwgNHFIta1MfXPlwW8zv8uK1mcpTZvuoddnE5UvQIGjY972J5dAz79s5EDScVdCwFs9rVZ_Yyqx-l-AqqzJVRVe52rDsKee0tZ3QcH-6lD-A-q_xy9JfAAAA___jm1j0) to Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton’s statement asserting Roberson’s guilt, while State Rep. Cody Harris—who represents Roberson’s hometown of Palestine—said Nikki and her family deserve justice.
## Oldest Living Person In U.S. Dies In Houston

# [French aristocrats wore a version of pimple stickers.](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sm46pn&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
### [Arts & Culture](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sm46pn&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
[](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sm46pn&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
| W e are, perhaps, currently in the cutest era of acne treatment. Rather than attempting to hide a pimple, many people are leaning into the imperfection by using fun, colorful hydrocolloid stickers that both cover and treat the blemish. While this trend emerged in the last decade or so, it’s not the first time cute acne accessories have been in vogue — [not by a long shot](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sm46pn&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com).
---
Decorative blemish covers called _mouches_ were all the rage in France at the end of the 16th century. Cute little shapes such as hearts, crescent moons, and diamonds were cut from silk, taffeta, velvet, or satin, and often backed with adhesive before sale. But it wasn’t just acne that these early users were worried about: Smallpox and syphilis were abundant, and both left serious scarring behind.
The bold patches went well with the ostentatious makeup popular among the French aristocracy at the time, including white hair powder, white face paint, and dramatic rouge. Just as [today’s adorable pimple patches](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sm46pn&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) are sometimes worn just for fun, _mouches_ started appearing on unblemished skin — and sometimes in meaningful locations. Wearing one on the right cheek, for example, would communicate that you were married, while the left cheek meant engaged. _Mouches_ weren’t the first complexion stickers, either. Ancient Romans would [stick small leather dots](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sm46pn&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) called _splenia_ or _alutae_ to their faces to cover blemishes — and, as with the patches of Renaissance-era France and today, people eventually started wearing them for fun.
[](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sm46pn&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) | [](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sm46pn&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)

## Whole pigeons were used in Renaissance beauty treatments.
Beauty rituals in the 16th century were not for the faint of heart: Bloodletting, lead-based paint, and even urine were all part of the cosmetic arsenal. One of the stranger recipes to emerge from the era is a lotion made from [whole pigeons](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sm46pn&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com), published in 1540. It called for two plucked pigeons stuffed with Venice turpentine, lilies, eggs, honey, periwinkles, pearls, and camphor, cooked in a glass vial. The liquid from the pigeon vial was infused with musk and ambergris — it probably didn’t smell very good — silver, and more pearls. Similar recipes for “pigeon water” appeared throughout the 17th century and, occasionally, beyond. One variation published in 1832 calls for, among other things, eight pigeons, crumbs from French rolls, and white wine, left to stew for 17 to 18 days.
