name: Heidi Ganahl
subject: The Mountain Minute: 10/29/2024
body:
Why Western Colorado stands opposed to the Dolores River National Monument
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi friends,
This is the Mountain Minute for Tuesday, October 29, 2024.
– Heidi Ganahl
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[Why Western Colorado stands opposed to the Dolores River National Monument](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
On Saturday in Nucla, Colo., hunters emerged from the wilderness. They paused from their morning hunt and headed to the town park in camouflage, joining with neighbors and locals to meet candidates for election.
At the heart of this gathering was a shared concern: the proposal to designate the nearby Dolores River as a national monument. Environmentalists praise its potential for conservation. But, it has sparked a fierce debate in Nucla.
Sean Pond, a Navy veteran and former nuclear engineer, leads the opposition through Halt the Dolores. Pond has criticized news media for ignoring those who would be most impacted by the Dolores Monument designation. He expressed gratitude to Rocky Mountain Voice for responding to the challenge of coming to hear from locals, firsthand, how they would be impacted.
For these communities, rooted in mining, ranching and farming, the designation threatens their culture and way of life.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**ELECTION MUST-READS 🗳️**
[**Here’s how to use BallotTrax to safeguard your vote in Colorado**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) **BY JEN SCHUMANN | STATE | OCTOBER 25** _In Colorado, voters can ensure transparency and increase self-awareness with BallotTrax, an online ballot tracking tool which provides real-time updates on the status of your ballot._
[**Panel at Colorado Mesa debates merits, concerns with Prop. 131, the ranked-choice voting measure**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) **BY JEN SCHUMANN | STATE | OCTOBER 25** _Imagine if your vote could genuinely reflect your voice. Some argue Proposition 131, the ranked-choice voting measure, can do just that._
[**Coloradans can ride the RTD for free to vote early Tuesday and on Election Day**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) **BY BRIAN PORTER | STATE | OCTOBER 25** _Some voters along the Front Range can take advantage of fare-free rides with the Regional Transportation District to vote in-person or at a ballot drop-off location._
|
---
**[In rural school districts, creative solutions to house teachers being created](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Colorado rural school districts face challenges in attracting teachers due to limited affordable housing, prompting creative solutions, such as partnerships to build modular homes.
* The Colorado Rural Schools Alliance hosted a forum to explore options like public and private collaborations, with initiatives already underway in areas like Basalt and Vail.
* Local leaders emphasize that affordable housing is essential for retaining teachers, as the high cost of housing in rural Colorado often far exceeds what school staff can afford.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Senate District 16 Showdown: Robyn Carnes vs. Chris Kolker](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* In Colorado's Senate District 16 race, incumbent Democrat Chris Kolker and Republican challenger Robyn Carnes present distinct approaches on issues like affordability, housing, and public safety.
* Carnes, a Centennial City Council member, focuses on reducing costs, supporting local businesses, and strengthening public safety, advocating for community-driven solutions.
* Kolker emphasizes his work on property tax relief and middle-income housing but faces criticism for not fully addressing the district's affordability and public safety concerns.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Denver’s mayor ‘factually incorrect’ as he argued for sales tax hike, state senator says](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [DENVERITE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Denver Mayor Mike Johnston mistakenly claimed that a property tax increase for affordable housing would largely benefit Denver Public Schools, which state Sen. Chris Hansen corrected as factually inaccurate.
* Johnston acknowledged his error but defended the proposed sales tax, arguing it would shift costs to visitors while avoiding essentials like groceries and gas.
* Hansen raised concerns about the regressive impact of sales taxes on low-income families, noting that the measure, if approved, would raise Denver’s total sales tax close to 10%, a rate few cities exceed.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Forget swing states, here are the swing counties that will decide the 2024 election](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [WASHINGTON EXAMINER](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Arizona’s Maricopa County, Georgia’s Fayette and Sumter Counties, and Pennsylvania’s Erie County are highlighted as pivotal due to their diverse demographics and voting patterns.
* Candidates are focusing on counties with specific demographic swings, such as Hispanic voters in Arizona and suburban voters in North Carolina, to sway tight races in their favor.
* In battleground states like Wisconsin and Michigan, longstanding bellwether counties will serve as indicators for potential outcomes, with slight shifts potentially tipping the scale.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Brace for ‘unrest’ if Donald Trump wins, Democrats warn](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [BREITBART](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Democrats and activists warn that a Trump victory in the 2024 election could lead to widespread unrest, with some preparing safety teams and protests to counter perceived threats to democracy.
* Concerns include potential violence, with activists citing examples from past protests and preparing for intensified activism, including efforts to support abortion rights in states with restrictive laws.
* Political figures like Mark Halperin predict a significant mental health impact if Trump wins, potentially leading to increased societal division and personal distress among opponents.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Bzdek: When judges break the rules, it’s time to judge the judges](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY VINCE BZDEK, [THE GAZETTE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_Despite five years of searing reports by investigative reporter David Migoya into serious problems afflicting the Colorado Supreme Court, the commission that reviews judicial performance gave all the justices on the ballot this year glowing recommendations._
_The two most senior members of the Supreme Court, Chief Justice Monica M. Márquez and Justice Brian D. Boatright, plus junior Justice Maria E. Berkenkotter, will be on the ballot for a retention vote. Now it’s up to voters to decide if their coverup and unethical handling of a pay-for-silence scandal, their stonewalling of investigations into that scandal, and their rule breaking and conflicts of interest uncovered by Migoya warrant a “NO” vote._
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️**
**[Leaders in NW Colorado discuss challenges, solutions for energy, seniors, workforce, housing](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY LINDY BROWNING | LOCAL | OCTOBER 25** _When the Associated Governments of Northwest Colorado (AGNC) held their meeting in Rifle, on Wednesday, Oct. 23, much of the discussion concerned how the region would plan for energy needs, housing shortages, and workforce development and retention._
[**Mesa County to Secretary Griswold: ‘This is our community and our investigation’**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) **BY BRIAN PORTER | LOCAL | OCTOBER 24** _The Mesa County elections office is investigating a potential case of election fraud, Mesa County Clerk Bobbie Gross announced Thursday, just moments after a press release vividly detailing the case was sent to the media from Secretary of State Jena Griswold’s office._
__
[**Overbeck: Don’t align with teachers’ unions against Amendment 80 for school choice**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) **BY JOY OVERBECK | COMMENTARY | OCTOBER 24** _From the Strange Bedfellows Department: the Christian Homeschool Educators of Colorado (CHEC) have joined with the sworn enemies of school choice, including teachers unions, the National Education Association (NEA) the Colorado Educators Association (CEA), and the Colorado Democratic Party to work against School Choice (Amendment 80) on the ballot._

| | |

But the bet we made was that, as the race tightens, and if we asked, our supporters would come through to help fill the gap. We hope that you will. To keep the Senate in the hands of the Democrats.
So with that in mind: [**can you make a $3 contribution to help us fill the budget gap we created going after the voters we need to persuade to help win this race? $3 isn’t much, but at this point it’s the small-dollar donations that are making a difference here at the end.**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-oct24.UCjdR-&refcode=em241029-1-900&t=2&akid=2145%2E135344%2E-6dxPW)

# **On the Road for Free Enterprise**
---
We were out on the east coast this month where I was invited to speak at Harvard University by my good friend and former Arkansas Governor, Asa Hutchinson. Governor Hutchinson and I had the chance to speak to students about free enterprise, conservative principles, and what it's like being the executive of a state.
| [](https://ssjjz.mjt.lu/lnk/AU8AAFQ7ejIAAc4KxKgAAPXnhIAAAYCtSSIAnYvcACac8ABnINJyzTfOkqKRSo6T_AebkHT8tAAjuaE/2/rWlLxNWVmL-vOqvcxhkLGw/aHR0cHM6Ly94LmNvbS9Bc2FIdXRjaGluc29uL3N0YXR1cy8xODQ2ODg2MTY3ODc2MDk2MDYzP3JlZj1saWJlcnR5bGFiJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1PY3RvYmVyJTIwUmVjYXAlM0ElMjBFZHVjYXRpb24lMjBXaW5zLCUyMEhhcnZhcmQlMjBIaWdobGlnaHRzJTIwJTI2JTIwRWxlY3Rpb24lMjBQcmVwJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX3NvdXJjZT1tYWlsamV0)
---
I also got to join the Josiah Bartlett Center for Public Policy in New Hampshire to speak about many of these same issues. New Hampshire has been lucky to have a great conservative Governor at the helm for the past 8 years with Chris Sununu, and I look forward to seeing Kelly Ayote win and continue the good work.
| [](https://ssjjz.mjt.lu/lnk/AU8AAFQ7ejIAAc4KxKgAAPXnhIAAAYCtSSIAnYvcACac8ABnINJyzTfOkqKRSo6T_AebkHT8tAAjuaE/3/r0FjZ4Sfv5577O3eOxSY2g/aHR0cHM6Ly94LmNvbS9Eb3VnRHVjZXkvc3RhdHVzLzE4NDMzNDM2Nzc5NDQ2NzIzOTc_cmVmPWxpYmVydHlsYWImdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU9jdG9iZXIlMjBSZWNhcCUzQSUyMEVkdWNhdGlvbiUyMFdpbnMsJTIwSGFydmFyZCUyMEhpZ2hsaWdodHMlMjAlMjYlMjBFbGVjdGlvbiUyMFByZXAmdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fc291cmNlPW1haWxqZXQ)

Back at home, we got a big new update on Arizona's first-in-the-nation universal ESA program. Long story short: It's a big success. Education freedom is saving taxpayer dollars and ensuring every Arizona family has access to a great education that fits their children’s needs.
| [](https://ssjjz.mjt.lu/lnk/AU8AAFQ7ejIAAc4KxKgAAPXnhIAAAYCtSSIAnYvcACac8ABnINJyzTfOkqKRSo6T_AebkHT8tAAjuaE/4/4s0xnnUofqZUmFFK7hc_2g/aHR0cHM6Ly94LmNvbS9Eb3VnRHVjZXkvc3RhdHVzLzE4NDkyMTU3NzY0NTQwMDg5NzM_cmVmPWxpYmVydHlsYWImdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU9jdG9iZXIlMjBSZWNhcCUzQSUyMEVkdWNhdGlvbiUyMFdpbnMsJTIwSGFydmFyZCUyMEhpZ2hsaWdodHMlMjAlMjYlMjBFbGVjdGlvbiUyMFByZXAmdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fc291cmNlPW1haWxqZXQ)
---

## **ABOUT US**
[ _Citizens for Free Enterprise_](https://ssjjz.mjt.lu/lnk/AU8AAFQ7ejIAAc4KxKgAAPXnhIAAAYCtSSIAnYvcACac8ABnINJyzTfOkqKRSo6T_AebkHT8tAAjuaE/8/wMiAHVqL4mG2fTMe-Vs4uw/aHR0cHM6Ly9jaXRpemVuc2ZvcmZyZWVlbnRlcnByaXNlLmNvbT9yZWY9bGliZXJ0eWxhYiZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249T2N0b2JlciUyMFJlY2FwJTNBJTIwRWR1Y2F0aW9uJTIwV2lucywlMjBIYXJ2YXJkJTIwSGlnaGxpZ2h0cyUyMCUyNiUyMEVsZWN0aW9uJTIwUHJlcCZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9zb3VyY2U9bWFpbGpldA) stands at the center of the fight for continued American prosperity. We promote free enterprise, so all Americans understand the role it has in creating a dynamic economy and people’s ability to climb the income ladder.

**Here's What We Do...**

**PROMOTE OPPORTUNITY**
Opportunity is at the heart of our free enterprise system. An economy that creates greater opportunity empowers people to pursue their aspirations and reach their goals, allowing them to provide for their families in the process. We work to advance policies that foster more opportunity.

**FIGHT BUREAUCRATIC OVERREACH**
Regulation must remain limited and effective for businesses to grow and consumers to reap the benefits. The free-market economy has demonstrated its ability to succeed, often after the government has failed. We fight to prevent the government from stifling entrepreneurialism and hurting the American worker.

**DEFEAT BIG GOVERNMENT SOCIALISM**
Progressive lawmakers have shown no hesitation to pursue a socialist agenda, normalizing the idea that economic solutions come from more government control. History tells us socialism has failed every place it’s been adopted. Now, we stand ready to protect and promote the economic policies that have made our country the most prosperous in the world. With the help of principled lawmakers and people like you, we can safeguard for everyone an economic system that provides equality of opportunity for all who seek a happier, more financially secure life. Stay tuned in the coming months to find out more about our initiatives, and opportunities to get involved.

clean_body: A look at Arizona’s ESA success, free enterprise at Harvard, and election readiness | | | | | On the Road for Free Enterprise We were out on the east coast this month where I was invited to speak at Harvard University by my good friend and former Arkansas Governor, Asa Hutchinson. Governor Hutchinson and I had the chance to speak to students about free enterprise, conservative principles, and what it's like being the executive of a state. | I also got to join the Josiah Bartlett Center for Public Policy in New Hampshire to speak about many of these same issues. New Hampshire has been lucky to have a great conservative Governor at the helm for the past 8 years with Chris Sununu, and I look forward to seeing Kelly Ayote win and continue the good work. | Back at home, we got a big new update on Arizona's first-in-the-nation universal ESA program. Long story short: It's a big success. Education freedom is saving taxpayer dollars and ensuring every Arizona family has access to a great education that fits their children’s needs. | At Citizens for Free Enterprise, we just released the fourth installment of our Faces of Free Enterprise series, highlighting small businessmen and women around the country. Our latest video features Sage Aubrey, a designer based in Scottsdale. | Election season is here so Citizens for Free Enterprise's team is working to get voters to the polls to make their voices heard on behalf of free enterprise. We have teams in Arizona and Georgia that will be working hard through election day. | | Doug Ducey Former Governor, Arizona ABOUT US stands at the center of the fight for continued American prosperity. We promote free enterprise, so all Americans understand the role it has in creating a dynamic economy and people’s ability to climb the income ladder. Here's What We Do... PROMOTE OPPORTUNITY Opportunity is at the heart of our free enterprise system. An economy that creates greater opportunity empowers people to pursue their aspirations and reach their goals, allowing them to provide for their families in the process. We work to advance policies that foster more opportunity. FIGHT BUREAUCRATIC OVERREACH Regulation must remain limited and effective for businesses to grow and consumers to reap the benefits. The free-market economy has demonstrated its ability to succeed, often after the government has failed. We fight to prevent the government from stifling entrepreneurialism and hurting the American worker. DEFEAT BIG GOVERNMENT SOCIALISM Progressive lawmakers have shown no hesitation to pursue a socialist agenda, normalizing the idea that economic solutions come from more government control. History tells us socialism has failed every place it’s been adopted. Now, we stand ready to protect and promote the economic policies that have made our country the most prosperous in the world. With the help of principled lawmakers and people like you, we can safeguard for everyone an economic system that provides equality of opportunity for all who seek a happier, more financially secure life. Stay tuned in the coming months to find out more about our initiatives, and opportunities to get involved. | | FOLLOW US ON SOCIAL MEDIA | | | | We believe that free enterprise is the bedrock of a prosperous society, enabling economic growth, job creation, and the betterment of people’s lives. | | Paid for jointly by Citizens for Free Enterprise and Citizens for Free Enterprise Action. You most likely can, but it’s as lethal a tool as a gun, [so make sure](https://links.nationalgunowner.org/a/1537/click/18931/6374453/29895ef2b4e5637879280c6bd9da1c12437e1e25/e1c42d2e32821d6c3886e337f59c98691c2a2498). name: Rob Mercuri
subject: One Week Until Election Day
body:
Early Voting is Still An Option.

|
---
Friend, While it may be hard to believe, we are exactly ONE WEEK away from Election Day - that means we are giving it our all as we use the remaining time to both share our message with voters and encourage folks to vote. **Mercuri Said Yes to Debate, Deluzio Dodged** This past Friday, I [accepted and participated in a debate](https://robmercuri.nationbuilder.com/r?u=Nqpst8YiOcHB9ig6eY19TFKhc9JesBmJP09oOzd1uop6TFCrdPiJv2rotwOxSxLSyuUxzeJXl_Hx8FD6ybVS_VzdpSanCv2D_LHC2UUci5WF7mnxUu7aCkeYI1vgqNooNKcnzmm0l91q5vOa1lYTwKyWFqZ02T7QNjP0hxHeT059P4aqfOSS6Ys8rcsEow5H9I2vPcZ_MCO9_RS9CLiA6Gw8uro5lYcQ3uenmTmWQ4iehPlEkvUY_IT2BaAnDrEDgAxJY6vtlGNx2D4vOAk1-9JlZwV6-E6R60XLxFQlLylWkPwuNNM-VzWtw2PQXy8G&e=3e5e734082f1493d27255edb80fe3a63&utm_source=robmercuri&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=10_29_24_email_to_supporters&n=1) hosted by Grand Opportunity (GO) USA, where I proudly took questions and discussed my positions on a wide range of topics, from energy to taxes, to the economy and the border - I’m a believer that the voters deserve to hear contrasting visions, and I’m happy that the hard-working people of PA-17 got to learn more about our pro-growth, pro-family, and pro-unity agenda. My opponent Chris Deluzio, on the other hand, said he was too “busy” to participate. While Chris hides from his failed record, I’m proud of how I’ve served Western Pennsylvania, and can’t wait to continue that service in the U.S. Congress. You can [CLICK HERE](https://robmercuri.nationbuilder.com/r?u=Nqpst8YiOcHB9ig6eY19TFKhc9JesBmJP09oOzd1uop6TFCrdPiJv2rotwOxSxLSyuUxzeJXl_Hx8FD6ybVS_VzdpSanCv2D_LHC2UUci5WF7mnxUu7aCkeYI1vgqNooNKcnzmm0l91q5vOa1lYTwKyWFqZ02T7QNjP0hxHeT059P4aqfOSS6Ys8rcsEow5H9I2vPcZ_MCO9_RS9CLiA6Gw8uro5lYcQ3uenmTmWQ4iehPlEkvUY_IT2BaAnDrEDgAxJY6vtlGNx2D4vOAk1-9JlZwV6-E6R60XLxFQlLylWkPwuNNM-VzWtw2PQXy8G&e=3e5e734082f1493d27255edb80fe3a63&utm_source=robmercuri&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=10_29_24_email_to_supporters&n=2) to watch the debate in full. [](https://robmercuri.nationbuilder.com/r?u=Nqpst8YiOcHB9ig6eY19TFKhc9JesBmJP09oOzd1uop6TFCrdPiJv2rotwOxSxLSyuUxzeJXl_Hx8FD6ybVS_VzdpSanCv2D_LHC2UUci5WF7mnxUu7aCkeYI1vgqNooNKcnzmm0l91q5vOa1lYTwKyWFqZ02T7QNjP0hxHeT059P4aqfOSS6Ys8rcsEow5H9I2vPcZ_MCO9_RS9CLiA6Gw8uro5lYcQ3uenmTmWQ4iehPlEkvUY_IT2BaAnDrEDgAxJY6vtlGNx2D4vOAk1-9JlZwV6-E6R60XLxFQlLylWkPwuNNM-VzWtw2PQXy8G&e=3e5e734082f1493d27255edb80fe3a63&utm_source=robmercuri&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=10_29_24_email_to_supporters&n=3) **Making a Plan to Vote: Early Voting is Still An Option** Haven’t voted yet? You still have today to make a plan to vote early in this crucial election! Residents of both Allegheny and Beaver counties can request a mail-in ballot by 5 p.m. today or utilize over-the-counter voting at the Allegheny County Office Building until 4:30 p.m. today. To request a mail-in ballot, please visit the following link -[https://www.pavoterservices.pa.gov/onlineabsenteeapplication/#/OnlineMailInBegin](https://robmercuri.nationbuilder.com/r?u=0UzDwLU8EkLkfWPFCr_6rpN-Mqzsq_qkR4BxqH_V_c54qz6vjntGwd0L72vme9ZydUTGIQXWHZ1FSi3jLKzDb2zaPL7wM-vFF2a1Nq0gRc-ddCnnItoSHX5E9rxRmWXy&e=3e5e734082f1493d27255edb80fe3a63&utm_source=robmercuri&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=10_29_24_email_to_supporters&n=4). Should you complete your ballot and wish to drop it off instead of mailing it, there are various ballot drop-off locations throughout Allegheny County, and you can find the [list of locations here.](https://robmercuri.nationbuilder.com/r?u=Bb-Tmxg6ZlO2xM8wOFdRArfqlwz4DV8r9n2uUNmDAGnBAKhBCG2odpxn9iD1Eq8eHp95wyITOw2IUp0BXCHMPGnbhZUmqAge9TI25WiyUoU&e=3e5e734082f1493d27255edb80fe3a63&utm_source=robmercuri&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=10_29_24_email_to_supporters&n=5) No matter how you vote, it is imperative that you make a plan to vote and exercise your right in our amazing country! Please visit the following websites to learn more about your various voting options: [https://www.pa.gov/en/agencies/vote.html](https://robmercuri.nationbuilder.com/r?u=lvC0zySgANn09obiz0UGcERadoCJMnx4lvjd6hWYm23c6QocFbwpV73mVvFFy5sr&e=3e5e734082f1493d27255edb80fe3a63&utm_source=robmercuri&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=10_29_24_email_to_supporters&n=6)
[https://www.alleghenycounty.us/Government/Elections](https://robmercuri.nationbuilder.com/r?u=Bb-Tmxg6ZlO2xM8wOFdRArfqlwz4DV8r9n2uUNmDAGnBAKhBCG2odpxn9iD1Eq8eoNuTI5v8Fpn9rCOYBQFuYQ&e=3e5e734082f1493d27255edb80fe3a63&utm_source=robmercuri&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=10_29_24_email_to_supporters&n=7)
[https://www.beavercountypa.gov/departments/election-bureau](https://robmercuri.nationbuilder.com/r?u=1TPCHaRGUnLlZUBZI1ybMBxSS1C3aPaHgKEWUgPwVdGWY5-jhEHw42qyREbGhwnBYSrVRMPvNXxuU4HArIwumQ&e=3e5e734082f1493d27255edb80fe3a63&utm_source=robmercuri&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=10_29_24_email_to_supporters&n=8) ******Door Deployment Nets Huge Interactions!** This past weekend, scores of College Republicans from Carnegie Mellon University and the University of Pittsburgh joined Team Mercuri out in Kennedy, Shaler, and South Fayette as we knocked on doors and greeted voters. Our efforts resulted in hundreds of voter interactions and a resounding affirmation that voters have voted and will be voting for our vision to bring common sense leadership to Washington! **ICYMI: The Squad in Western PA** Last week, the campaign released a new ad, Western PA's Squad, highlighting Chris Deluzio’s far-left voting record. In less than two years, he has supported raising taxes, voted to give illegal immigrants our taxpayer dollars, and even supported illegal immigrants voting. We don’t need an extreme liberal partisan. We need a leader who is going to search for common ground to bring people together to lead us forward. [](https://robmercuri.nationbuilder.com/r?u=QfIZV-WGX1tv8x-Rj8_8rmPIALQoB_HtQ9yBvm3EsdfdP4kpkzPLmZotpYqAnH6_&e=3e5e734082f1493d27255edb80fe3a63&utm_source=robmercuri&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=10_29_24_email_to_supporters&n=9) **We Need Your Help at the Polls!** We know that many voters will still choose to vote in-person, and we need your help to ensure those Election Day voters can learn about our message prior to voting! Throughout Allegheny and Beaver counties, we are looking for poll greeters to serve at least one time slot at a high priority precinct, where margins have been tight in the past few elections. A few interactions with undecided voters could determine how PA-17 goes, and with that, determine who controls Congress. If you are interested in joining us at the polls, please visit our SignUp.com links, where you can find a polling site that works for you: Allegheny North ([https://signup.com/go/EpVaPfv](https://robmercuri.nationbuilder.com/r?u=eS-nty21fpZd4ZaM0pkEPkdHRw3B1bLhiTuh-VqEqEA&e=3e5e734082f1493d27255edb80fe3a63&utm_source=robmercuri&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=10_29_24_email_to_supporters&n=10))
Allegheny South ([https://signup.com/go/LUhYnzD](https://robmercuri.nationbuilder.com/r?u=eS-nty21fpZd4ZaM0pkEPtUYJXlBmnBES1XbmLhXmCs&e=3e5e734082f1493d27255edb80fe3a63&utm_source=robmercuri&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=10_29_24_email_to_supporters&n=11))
Allegheny Southeast ([https://signup.com/go/eLTFuBg](https://robmercuri.nationbuilder.com/r?u=eS-nty21fpZd4ZaM0pkEPl9gRgdd43bgjm1PUO60eNY&e=3e5e734082f1493d27255edb80fe3a63&utm_source=robmercuri&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=10_29_24_email_to_supporters&n=12))

clean_body: Early Voting is Still An Option. | Friend, While it may be hard to believe, we are exactly ONE WEEK away from Election Day - that means we are giving it our all as we use the remaining time to both share our message with voters and encourage folks to vote. Mercuri Said Yes to Debate, Deluzio Dodged This past Friday, I hosted by Grand Opportunity (GO) USA, where I proudly took questions and discussed my positions on a wide range of topics, from energy to taxes, to the economy and the border - I’m a believer that the voters deserve to hear contrasting visions, and I’m happy that the hard-working people of PA-17 got to learn more about our pro-growth, pro-family, and pro-unity agenda. My opponent Chris Deluzio, on the other hand, said he was too “busy” to participate. While Chris hides from his failed record, I’m proud of how I’ve served Western Pennsylvania, and can’t wait to continue that service in the U.S. Congress. You can to watch the debate in full. Making a Plan to Vote: Early Voting is Still An Option Haven’t voted yet? You still have today to make a plan to vote early in this crucial election! Residents of both Allegheny and Beaver counties can request a mail-in ballot by 5 p.m. today or utilize over-the-counter voting at the Allegheny County Office Building until 4:30 p.m. today. To request a mail-in ballot, please visit the following link -. Should you complete your ballot and wish to drop it off instead of mailing it, there are various ballot drop-off locations throughout Allegheny County, and you can find the No matter how you vote, it is imperative that you make a plan to vote and exercise your right in our amazing country! Please visit the following websites to learn more about your various voting options: ****Door Deployment Nets Huge Interactions! This past weekend, scores of College Republicans from Carnegie Mellon University and the University of Pittsburgh joined Team Mercuri out in Kennedy, Shaler, and South Fayette as we knocked on doors and greeted voters. Our efforts resulted in hundreds of voter interactions and a resounding affirmation that voters have voted and will be voting for our vision to bring common sense leadership to Washington! ICYMI: The Squad in Western PA Last week, the campaign released a new ad, Western PA's Squad, highlighting Chris Deluzio’s far-left voting record. In less than two years, he has supported raising taxes, voted to give illegal immigrants our taxpayer dollars, and even supported illegal immigrants voting. We don’t need an extreme liberal partisan. We need a leader who is going to search for common ground to bring people together to lead us forward. We Need Your Help at the Polls! We know that many voters will still choose to vote in-person, and we need your help to ensure those Election Day voters can learn about our message prior to voting! Throughout Allegheny and Beaver counties, we are looking for poll greeters to serve at least one time slot at a high priority precinct, where margins have been tight in the past few elections. A few interactions with undecided voters could determine how PA-17 goes, and with that, determine who controls Congress. If you are interested in joining us at the polls, please visit our SignUp.com links, where you can find a polling site that works for you: Allegheny North () Allegheny South () Allegheny Southeast () Allegheny West () Beaver North () Beaver South () In the case that a polling site isn't listed that you are comfortable serving at, please contact Political Director Michael Guido at michael@robmercuri.com to discuss alternative options. Leading us forward, Rob Mercuri | "DONATE TODAY" Mercuri for Congress · PA 15222, United States

###
Today marks 7 days until Election Day, and America's choice of president will make or break our country. It's time for us to _fight, fight, fight_ through Get Out The Vote efforts and ensure that everyone we know, and those we don't, get to the ballot box and cast their vote for Donald Trump. There are still several ways you can get involved with Tea Party Patriots Citizens Fund's Get Out The Vote opportunities:
* **Get Friends and Family Out to Vote:** This has been an effective tool for the left for years, and it's time we use it too. We have an app to make it easy, and we want you to learn how to use it! For more information visit **[winelections.com](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb9794a5eaa7e9/1edb9794a5e611ba "https://www.teapartypatriots.org/citizensfund/win-elections/")**.
* **Door Knocking in Georgia:** We will knock until the end of the election cycle. If you would like to be paid to knock for Trump in Georgia only, visit [**knockfortrump.com**](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb9794a5eaa7e9/1edb9794a5e611bc "https://knockfortrump.frdm.org/"). The hours are flexible; pay is $20 an hour with bonuses and other incentives.
* **Phone Banking:** You can phone bank for Trump by signing up at [**CallForTrump.com**](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb9794a5eaa7e9/1edb9794a5e611be "https://www.teapartypatriots.org/citizensfund/call-for-trump/").
* **Educate Voters About Kamala Harris:** Use the information on our [**Kamala Info Page**](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb9794a5eaa7e9/1edb9794a5e611c0) to educate other voters about her, including sending people to our Jeopardy-style [**Kamala Quiz**](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb9794a5eaa7e9/1edb9794a5e611c2).
* **Educate Voters About Donald Trump:** Use the information on our **[Trump Info Page](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb9794a5eaa7e9/1edb9794a5e611c4 "https://www.teapartypatriots.org/citizensfund/trumpinfo/")** to educate other voters about him.

---

* [**Early Voting**](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb9794a5eaa7e9/1edb9794a5e611c6)

Peter,

Yesterday was not a good fundraising day, and that is putting it lightly._** If I’m being totally honest, it was the worst day of the month so far.**_ Just 22 people donated to the email that I sent out yesterday, for a total of $370. Hi Peter,

We are working to unseat each and every legislator who passed abortion bans – in every single abortion ban state across the country. We are officially one week away from Election Day — which means time is running out to chip away at those anti-choice majorities this cycle.

That is why we are reaching out today – to share our incredible roster of fiercely pro-choice women running for office in TN, where, in 2022, **the Tennessee state legislature, which is 85% male, passed a near-total ban on abortion.**

[**Before we tell you more, be sure to chip in a split $50 or more donation to help us ensure our candidates have the funds they need to hit their LAST end-of-month fundraising goals ahead of Election Day.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/96053782/508766271/1685593444?recode=EM_F_241029TN_N_CD_90DO_8_NG_N_L1&amount=50&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNy8xLzg4NDk1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjIwMjZhM2U2LWY5OTUtZWYxMS04OGNlLTAwMGQzYTk4ZmE2YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=kxVOkOkEnLPXL_DwIg6tI6h5SlyGBhVVLWp_P00TPQ4=)

✅ **Allie Phillips for the TN House of Representatives, District 75:** During a routine anatomy scan at 19 weeks pregnant, Allie learned that the baby she was expecting, Miley Rose, was not going to make it. Doctors warned that continuing the pregnancy would endanger her life. However, since abortion is banned in Tennessee, Allie was forced to leave the state to seek life-saving care. After her traumatic experience, Allie met with her legislator, Rep. Jeff Burkhart, to share her story and persuade him to sponsor a measure she named after the baby she lost but desperately wanted, “**Miley’s Law,** ” which would add an exception for fetal anomalies to the state abortion ban.

However, Burkhart responded by telling Allie that if his daughter had been in her position, he’d tell her to keep going with the pregnancy until the end (!!!!???) AND that he didn’t think a miscarriage could happen in a 2nd pregnancy (???!!!). Now, she is running for HIS SEAT in the TN State House. **Allie Phillips’ race has moved from a purple district to a STATEWIDE PRIORITY for the Democratic party and is now _the top target_ for a Democratic victory in Tennessee!**

✅ **Claire Jones for TN House of Representatives, District 61:** As a nurse, Claire is committed to expanding Medicaid, fighting to stop any additional restrictions to women's healthcare and reproductive care, and working to repeal Tennessee's current abortion ban. She’s running against an extremist right-wing conservative with an insane record. The incumbent, Gino Bulso, is **anti-abortion** and has openly told people **he doesn't believe contraceptives should be legal because sex should only occur for procreation.** Additionally, he has staunchly **defended the right for first cousins to marry in Tennessee.** She is running a phenomenal, organized, impressive campaign. We need to ensure she wins on Tuesday!

✅ **Lexi Melton for TN House of Representatives, District 35:** Lexi has a background in healthcare and is ready to bring positive change to TN. She is passionate about policies prioritizing equity across our education system, gun safety legislation, transparency in government, and ensuring that every voice is heard and valued in the political process. **She is running against an incumbent who has passed policies that would arm teachers with guns in schools.** Additionally, he supports banning abortion with limited exceptions for the life of the mother.

A CNN panel discussion with Abby Philips on Monday night addressed the grotesque racism at Trump's rally at Madison Square Garden. In my column yesterday [I documented much of that racism](https://substack.com/redirect/727d6f58-a5a6-4d19-b2ac-79d486c82148?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Citing that racism, Mehdi Hasan, Founder and Editor-in-Chief of [Zeteo](https://open.substack.com/pub/zeteo) News asserted that it absolutely aligned with Nazi ideology. Hasan further asserted that he proudly speaks up for the Palestinian people--[an especially important point given the anti-Muslim and anti-Palestinian rhetoric at Trump's rally](https://substack.com/redirect/5fa45234-57da-4610-853e-5b989d2631b3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). In response, right wing pundit Ryan Girdusky retorted to Mehdi , "_I hope your beeper doesn 't go off_,"--a clear reference to Israel's mass beeper attack [that killed at least 32 people, including two children](https://substack.com/redirect/e443931c-2ef5-4422-bc97-87099deaee38?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and injured 3000. [An attack that UN experts deem a war crime](https://substack.com/redirect/9f5d0676-48f6-46d5-a75e-601084cd9aa8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), but one Girdusky apparently finds incredibly funny.
As you watch the exchange below, consider the deeper issue about how ingrained and frighteningly normalized white supremacy is in modern discourse? This includes, for example, that Girdusky previously wrote for a Nazi publication, yet was invited by CNN on air anyway. Why? **Let 's Address This.**
[](https://substack.com/redirect/dd7b6037-56b9-4dec-83c7-6d7bd654bd82?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

### Girdusky's History of Racism
Many on the right are defending Girdusky's racist comment, claiming it was reactive to Hasan calling him a Nazi. I continue to receive ongoing comments to this effect.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/8495cab7-36a5-416d-8c57-97f50ef08547?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
There's only one problem with this absurd line of argument--Hasan called out Girdusky and the right due to [documented examples of racism and actual Nazis at Trump rallies](https://substack.com/redirect/50d01a16-7b7f-47ef-a51c-e16c24976101?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), while Girdusky maligned Hasan for daring to speak up for Palestinian civilians. Hasan is calling out literal Nazis. Girdusky is "joking" about killing a journalist, [echoing the fascist rhetoric from Donald Trump himself](https://substack.com/redirect/afb1877e-3617-4a36-a2a0-92b4a003a512?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). The two positions are not the same.
Indeed, Girdusky's racist remarks on CNN are not isolated, but are part of his long and sordid history of racism and bigotry against minority communities. And apparently, none of which disqualified him from earning an invite from CNN. Girdusky's history and contemporary acts of racism include but is not limited to:
* Girdusky is the founder of 1776 Project PAC, which is currently working to elect extremist candidates to school boards nationwide. How? By banning teaching critical race theory in public school ([it already isn't taught](https://substack.com/redirect/b4c86ef2-8eb4-4c3f-9da3-f16819689547?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)) and by banning efforts to promote diversity, equity, and inclusion in public schools ([which has meant banning books by Black and LGBTQ authors](https://substack.com/redirect/4c91d4ab-946b-4c0a-9acd-bbf9767fb120?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)). Girdusky's 1776 Project PAC doesn't only engage in xenophobia--it also engages in illegal activity. In October, 2023, the [Maryland State Board of Elections fined 1776 Project PAC over $20,000](https://substack.com/redirect/1eae8350-8bd8-492d-b94b-0b2c6f5e8dd3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for violating state election law during school board elections.
* Girdusky sits on the board of an anti-immigrant non-profit known as "American Moment," which seeks to restrict all [immigration to the United States](https://substack.com/redirect/e2eed4f6-d48e-4c9d-99c4-2865fafa1b2f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--which is also a main policy platform for America's white supremacist movements.
* Girdusky has [also given favorable and soft ball interviews to The Proud Boys](https://substack.com/redirect/ecad53c0-5dbc-44e5-8e6a-666573651d4b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), which is one of the white supremacist organizations Donald Trump famously refused to condemn and instead told to "[stand back and stand by](https://substack.com/redirect/85f02758-c22c-47c3-b978-6bc90976be53?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)."
* Girdusky is also an advisor to Project 2025, which as I've written at length, [invites fascism to America](https://substack.com/redirect/761461e8-4486-4ae1-8d44-42b32b965bd0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). A reminder that Project 2025 seeks to strip basic reproductive rights for hundreds of millions of women in America, legalize anti-LGBTQ discrimination, ban immigration, deport 11 million plus immigrants, and criminalize any discussion of diversity in any government setting.
* But perhaps most ironic about Girdusky feigning outrage at being compared to Nazis is that he has openly written for a literal Nazi named Richard Spencer--a fact Spencer confirmed on Twitter after Girdusky's CNN interview.

| [](https://substack.com/redirect/8a64555b-e2b9-4318-a683-510dcfa4e328?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---

### Yes, Girdusky Wrote for a Nazi
[The Southern Poverty Law Center calls Richard Spencer](https://substack.com/redirect/890195a4-f312-493d-9a1c-311f423cc44c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), "_one of the country 's most successful young white nationalist leaders_." When Trump won in 2016, Spencer openly celebrated with Nazi salutes, screaming, "[Hail Trump](https://substack.com/redirect/5835db04-36fd-4ef0-a638-ecbfeac6c4fb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)." And lest Girdusky claim Spencer was somehow not a white nationalist "back then," VICE News quotes Spencer in October of 2013:
> Our dream is a new society, an ethno-state that would be a gathering point for all Europeans. It would be a new society based on very different ideals than, say, the Declaration of Independence.
How is Spencer's anti-immigrant rhetoric and policy driven by white supremacy different than the rhetoric at the Trump rally which called to end all immigration and to round up and deport 11 million Latino immigrants? The answer is, it isn't, and that's the fundamental problem Hasan (and many on the left) call out.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b1c0ee32-21a3-4308-b905-0c9768b241ce?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Nazi salutes at Richard Spencer's rally for Donald Trump. Credit: PBS News
### CNN's Response to Girdusky's Racism
Finally, after spewing his racist comment at Hasan, Girdusky initially doubled down on his comment. Moments later on air he reversed his position and pretended to apologize to Hasan in a backhanded non-apology. During break CNN removed Girdusky from the panel and sent him home, issuing the following statement:
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f012729e-0114-45d3-a9cc-bce946ff5f55?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
And after being sent home for his racism, Girdusky reversed his position yet again, apparently retracted his non-apology, and tripled down on his racism, defending his racist, ridiculous, and potentially violent threat to Hasan once more. He tweeted:
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/894b7075-600e-44a2-96be-82a2e74c6f3c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
It should disturb anyone with a conscience that Girdusky sees a war crime that killed innocent children and thinks, "_that 's hilarious_." It is also fascinating that Girdusky complains that Hasan "_falsely called every Republican a Nazi_ ," but is Girdusky--as someone who regularly fraternizes with white supremacists--really the example to follow? And while I am glad CNN issued a swift statement condemning Girdusky's overt racism, making it clear that he would no longer be welcome on CNN, the question remains--why was he invited in the first place?
Given his well documented history of Islamophobia, anti-Black racism, misogyny, and antisemitism in fraternizing with white supremacists--even working for an avowed white supremacist--why does CNN platform xenophobes like Girdusky at all? Indeed, are there no Republicans left to invite who have cleared the very low bar of _not_ working for a notorious white supremacist? If not, then it speaks to the point of the entire CNN conversation in the first place--the Trump rally at Madison Square Garden was indistinguishable from a Nazi rally, because for all intents and purposes it was a Nazi rally.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..Av-ls4QEXjsnPKku--s9OFUUuU4Y0gk9Rq1hgmh1Puo?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=150874555)
### Girdusky's Racism is a Symptom of a Bigger Problem
The bottom line is this. Girdusky is the symptom of a greater problem of the systemic racism that permeates so much of our political, media, and public discourse. Take note that Hasan's 'crime' was merely stating that he is willing to speak up for the people of Palestine, [which is why he condemned the hateful anti-Palestinian and anti-Muslim rhetoric from Giuliani and others at the MSG rally](https://substack.com/redirect/5fa45234-57da-4610-853e-5b989d2631b3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). And in response to this basic statement of standing up for a marginalized community, Girdusky, a man with a history of writing for a Nazi, decided to also demonize Hasan and insinuate he deserves assassination for daring to speak up. This is 2024 America, and this is the hateful and violent rhetoric Trump is empowering. Deplatforming Girdusky from CNN is a step, but we must do so more to hold all media accountable to stop platforming such extreme voices in the first place. As I wrote yesterday regarding [Trump's rally at Madison Square Garden](https://substack.com/redirect/e0e32af5-2d77-4a31-bd4c-0b125eb3e7ff?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> As a society, we have to demand more from our leaders, our media, and ourselves. With just days before the Presidential election, it is critical we build our coalition and rally our voices to ensure Donald Trump does not reenter the White House. He is telling us who he is, the fascism he plans to enact, and the violence he will use to enforce his will. Let there be no confusion about his intentions. And let there be no doubt in what we must do--reject this hate and violence, and vote in overwhelming numbers to prevent fascism from taking hold in the United States. Make a plan to vote, and take your circle of family and friends with you.
A Trump victory will ensure known xenophobes like Girdusky, and many more like him, become even more emboldened in their hate, than they already are. The solution to this hate is not violence or threats--but a mass movement of people committed to absolute justice and human dignity. This next week will decide the long term future of our nation, and indeed of our planet. Let us make sure our voices and votes prevent a return of the former guy, and instead give our nation the chance to uphold democracy and human rights--yes, even for American Muslims who dare to speak up for Palestinian humanity.

Let's Address This with Qasim Rashid is a reader-supported publication. To receive new posts and support my work, consider becoming a free or paid subscriber. Girdusky's History of Racism Many on the right are defending Girdusky's racist comment, claiming it was reactive to Hasan calling him a Nazi. I continue to receive ongoing comments to this effect. | | ---|---|--- There's only one problem with this absurd line of argument--Hasan called out Girdusky and the right due to , while Girdusky maligned Hasan for daring to speak up for Palestinian civilians. Hasan is calling out literal Nazis. Girdusky is "joking" about killing a journalist, . The two positions are not the same. Indeed, Girdusky's racist remarks on CNN are not isolated, but are part of his long and sordid history of racism and bigotry against minority communities. And apparently, none of which disqualified him from earning an invite from CNN. Girdusky's history and contemporary acts of racism include but is not limited to: Girdusky is the founder of 1776 Project PAC, which is currently working to elect extremist candidates to school boards nationwide. How? By banning teaching critical race theory in public school () and by banning efforts to promote diversity, equity, and inclusion in public schools (). Girdusky's 1776 Project PAC doesn't only engage in xenophobia--it also engages in illegal activity. In October, 2023, the for violating state election law during school board elections. Girdusky sits on the board of an anti-immigrant non-profit known as "American Moment," which seeks to restrict all is also a main policy platform for America's white supremacist movements. Girdusky has , which is one of the white supremacist organizations Donald Trump famously refused to condemn and instead told to "." Girdusky is also an advisor to Project 2025, which as I've written at length, . A reminder that Project 2025 seeks to strip basic reproductive rights for hundreds of millions of women in America, legalize anti-LGBTQ discrimination, ban immigration, deport 11 million plus immigrants, and criminalize any discussion of diversity in any government setting. But perhaps most ironic about Girdusky feigning outrage at being compared to Nazis is that he has openly written for a literal Nazi named Richard Spencer--a fact Spencer confirmed on Twitter after Girdusky's CNN interview. | | ---|---|--- Yes, Girdusky Wrote for a Nazi , "one of the country 's most successful young white nationalist leaders." When Trump won in 2016, Spencer openly celebrated with Nazi salutes, screaming, "." And lest Girdusky claim Spencer was somehow not a white nationalist "back then," VICE News quotes Spencer in October of 2013: Our dream is a new society, an ethno-state that would be a gathering point for all Europeans. It would be a new society based on very different ideals than, say, the Declaration of Independence. How is Spencer's anti-immigrant rhetoric and policy driven by white supremacy different than the rhetoric at the Trump rally which called to end all immigration and to round up and deport 11 million Latino immigrants? The answer is, it isn't, and that's the fundamental problem Hasan (and many on the left) call out. | | ---|---|--- Nazi salutes at Richard Spencer's rally for Donald Trump. Credit: PBS News CNN's Response to Girdusky's Racism Finally, after spewing his racist comment at Hasan, Girdusky initially doubled down on his comment. Moments later on air he reversed his position and pretended to apologize to Hasan in a backhanded non-apology. During break CNN removed Girdusky from the panel and sent him home, issuing the following statement: | | ---|---|--- And after being sent home for his racism, Girdusky reversed his position yet again, apparently retracted his non-apology, and tripled down on his racism, defending his racist, ridiculous, and potentially violent threat to Hasan once more. He tweeted: | | ---|---|--- It should disturb anyone with a conscience that Girdusky sees a war crime that killed innocent children and thinks, "that 's hilarious." It is also fascinating that Girdusky complains that Hasan "falsely called every Republican a Nazi ," but is Girdusky--as someone who regularly fraternizes with white supremacists--really the example to follow? And while I am glad CNN issued a swift statement condemning Girdusky's overt racism, making it clear that he would no longer be welcome on CNN, the question remains--why was he invited in the first place? Given his well documented history of Islamophobia, anti-Black racism, misogyny, and antisemitism in fraternizing with white supremacists--even working for an avowed white supremacist--why does CNN platform xenophobes like Girdusky at all? Indeed, are there no Republicans left to invite who have cleared the very low bar of not working for a notorious white supremacist? If not, then it speaks to the point of the entire CNN conversation in the first place--the Trump rally at Madison Square Garden was indistinguishable from a Nazi rally, because for all intents and purposes it was a Nazi rally. Girdusky's Racism is a Symptom of a Bigger Problem The bottom line is this. Girdusky is the symptom of a greater problem of the systemic racism that permeates so much of our political, media, and public discourse. Take note that Hasan's 'crime' was merely stating that he is willing to speak up for the people of Palestine, . And in response to this basic statement of standing up for a marginalized community, Girdusky, a man with a history of writing for a Nazi, decided to also demonize Hasan and insinuate he deserves assassination for daring to speak up. This is 2024 America, and this is the hateful and violent rhetoric Trump is empowering. Deplatforming Girdusky from CNN is a step, but we must do so more to hold all media accountable to stop platforming such extreme voices in the first place. As I wrote yesterday regarding : As a society, we have to demand more from our leaders, our media, and ourselves. With just days before the Presidential election, it is critical we build our coalition and rally our voices to ensure Donald Trump does not reenter the White House. He is telling us who he is, the fascism he plans to enact, and the violence he will use to enforce his will. Let there be no confusion about his intentions. And let there be no doubt in what we must do--reject this hate and violence, and vote in overwhelming numbers to prevent fascism from taking hold in the United States. Make a plan to vote, and take your circle of family and friends with you. A Trump victory will ensure known xenophobes like Girdusky, and many more like him, become even more emboldened in their hate, than they already are. The solution to this hate is not violence or threats--but a mass movement of people committed to absolute justice and human dignity. This next week will decide the long term future of our nation, and indeed of our planet. Let us make sure our voices and votes prevent a return of the former guy, and instead give our nation the chance to uphold democracy and human rights--yes, even for American Muslims who dare to speak up for Palestinian humanity. # The Preserve Rural America Act
---
| I served as a San Benito County Supervisor during the COVID pandemic, and i saw firsthand the breakdown of local authority, the economic transfer of power from small business to big-box corporatization of important industries (especially with the healthcare industry), the loss individual freedom, and the abuse of rural preservation of critical resources and agricultural land.
Many don’t realize that we were under one-man rule in the middle of the lockdowns and mandates for a year and a half. During that time we suffered a complete shift of power away from Rural America toward State and Federal powers.
---
| | | | | | | | | |
---
| |
It’s time for Rural America to have a stronger voice to protect public health, bottom-up economic development, food integrity, resource management, and community stability.
---
| As your Congressman, one important policy proposal I'll sponsor is what I call the Preserve Rural America Act. It will enact the following:
* Provide strong measures that allow funding to be controlled locally for everything managed under a local jurisdiction, especially disaster management
* Provide policy that creates an easier process to charter areas as independent municipalities
* Establish checks and balances to curb state abuses of local governments (i.e., reject unfunded mandates that bog down local government’s resource management)
* Protect rural areas from unfunded state laws
* Impose stiffer penalties on states that abuse individual freedoms
* Require adding an assessment mechanism of “resource” ( rural ) counties that add value and provide protections from eminent domain on those properties
* Make it harder for precious agriculturally productive soil to be overdeveloped, reducing the food production foot print
* Make it illegal to sell these lands to foreign countries
* Prioritize our American workforce in the harvesting and production of these crops

---
| Devastating flooding in Pajaro Valley due to levee breach. Recovery still incomplete due to slow FEMA response.
Strengthening America means strengthening the people that live and work here, and pushing back on the Progressive Left’s intent to urbanize and centralize all states. It’s time to restore power back down to the level that respects, lives in, and understands Rural America, giving power back to the people!
Please help us get the word out - tell your friends, consider donating to my campaign, vote by November 5th!
---
| Regards,Peter Hernandez

clean_body: Let's Return Power to the People | | | | | | | | | | | The Preserve Rural America Act | I served as a San Benito County Supervisor during the COVID pandemic, and i saw firsthand the breakdown of local authority, the economic transfer of power from small business to big-box corporatization of important industries (especially with the healthcare industry), the loss individual freedom, and the abuse of rural preservation of critical resources and agricultural land. Many don’t realize that we were under one-man rule in the middle of the lockdowns and mandates for a year and a half. During that time we suffered a complete shift of power away from Rural America toward State and Federal powers. | | | | | | | | | | | | It’s time for Rural America to have a stronger voice to protect public health, bottom-up economic development, food integrity, resource management, and community stability. | As your Congressman, one important policy proposal I'll sponsor is what I call the Preserve Rural America Act. It will enact the following: Provide strong measures that allow funding to be controlled locally for everything managed under a local jurisdiction, especially disaster management Provide policy that creates an easier process to charter areas as independent municipalities Establish checks and balances to curb state abuses of local governments (i.e., reject unfunded mandates that bog down local government’s resource management) Protect rural areas from unfunded state laws Impose stiffer penalties on states that abuse individual freedoms Require adding an assessment mechanism of “resource” ( rural ) counties that add value and provide protections from eminent domain on those properties Make it harder for precious agriculturally productive soil to be overdeveloped, reducing the food production foot print Make it illegal to sell these lands to foreign countries Prioritize our American workforce in the harvesting and production of these crops | Devastating flooding in Pajaro Valley due to levee breach. Recovery still incomplete due to slow FEMA response. Strengthening America means strengthening the people that live and work here, and pushing back on the Progressive Left’s intent to urbanize and centralize all states. It’s time to restore power back down to the level that respects, lives in, and understands Rural America, giving power back to the people! Please help us get the word out - tell your friends, consider donating to my campaign, vote by November 5th! | Regards,Peter Hernandez | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | mailto:Peter@peterhernandezforcongress.com | | | | | | Paid for by Peter Hernandez for Congress. | | | | | | | | | Copyright (C) 2022 Peter Hernandez for Congress, All rights reserved. name: Evangelicals for Harris
subject: Call for Repentance-Puerto Rico Remarks
body:
Call for Trump and Vance to Repent | |
---
| | | In response to comedian Tony Hinchcliffe’s repugnant remarks at Sunday’s Trump campaign rally that Puerto Rico is a "floating island of garbage," Catholic Archbishop González Nieves calls on Mr. Trump to repent and personally apologize for these insults. Evangelicals for Harris supports this call and asks Mr. Trump to apologize. In addition, we ask our brother in Christ, Senator Vance, a professed Catholic, to repent and apologize for allowing this. We ask of Senator Vance: **_Do you agree with the assessment from Archbishop González Nieves, one of your own leaders in the faith, that: “humor should never insult or denigrate the dignity and sacredness of people,” and that “these kinds of remarks do not have a place in a society founded upon ‘liberty and justice for all?’” Or, is the campaign so free of sin that there is no need of forgiveness, as Trump has said of himself?_**

**_We ask you to please _**[**share this X post with your networks**](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=870d7fd4ae&e=43463f1dee)** _ to support those calling for an apology. _**This post includes the letter sent from Archbishop Nieves to Mr. Trump.

We also thought you might be interested in this [NPR piece](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=46d994efa1&e=43463f1dee) on the difference the Evangelicals for Harris campaign is making. **_As we’ve shared all along, our goal is to persuade enough voters to give Harris and Walz a win – not to persuade all evangelicals. This NPR piece highlights how – with your prayers and support, we are doing just that with over 300,000 in the Evangelicals for Harris community and our ads viewed over 80 Million times. _**Please share this good news widely to inspire your families, friends, and networks that **_each of our votes matter_ and to encourage them to vote**, especially in these final days as the race is tightening. Here are our [Evangelicals for Harris voting resources](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=f7d8c3b57c&e=43463f1dee), for you to use and share.

Thank you for all you’re doing. We’re praying for you.

Blessings,
The Evangelicals for Harris Team

Holidays like Halloween can feel like all trick and no treat for deployed service members and their families -- who miss out on festivities like trick-or-treating, gathering with friends and watching scary movies.
That's why we've worked hard this month to bring the spirit of the season to service members by decorating USO Centers across the globe, stocking them with favorite treats from home and hosting fun-filled events to bring members of the military community together.
And with so many service members spending Halloween deployed far away from home and their loved ones this year -- even something as simple as showing your support by displaying a patriotic pumpkin in your community can mean so much to those who serve and their families.
So please: **[Take a moment now to choose your favorite stencil to carve your pumpkin and show off your military support this Halloween!](https://links.e.uso.org/els/v2/0d-ehpD40eFP/ckpvL3I4ZDdMeGZ5V3UydDY1U3cwRGV3aWdlSStOZzMrZFVXNVl5TXhjQk9wdVR5aitmUXJTMXJoOG9ndVNBY0ZrTC9jS2RVNzF6K01pTG9zdDVYdVFheWE2L1EwbTBORW5iTDBwM1QrRVE9S0/Ynk3UGNsdEhZZ09ITUZCcUtyU2FSS0gxdkZ4dHc4eXUvWHVPb0lKVnhGTldXMlROTCs1ajRnandjcm40NUFLbjlJKzJKN1dSQzJCTzdBUFp5TXpxSFhNb0R0OEdqTWpWS0)**
Happy Halloween!

And with so many service members spending Halloween deployed far away from home and their loved ones this year -- even something as simple as showing your support by displaying a patriotic pumpkin in your community can mean so much to those who serve and their families. Dear Friend,

Politics often leaves a bitter taste in our mouths. It's no wonder so many of us approach it with disdain. The endless mudslinging, pandering to special interest groups, and policies shaped by poll numbers rather than deeply held convictions make politics seem like a world Christians should avoid.

Yet, as Christians, we can't ignore the rapid unraveling of our culture or remain passive in the face of the evil we see around us. The Bible tells us that our citizenship is in heaven (Philippians 3:20) and that we are aliens and strangers in this world (1 Peter 2:11). But does that mean we should leave governing to unbelievers? Should we invest our time in influencing what seems transitory at best?

The answer is simple: Jesus commanded us to be the salt and light of the world (Matthew 5:13-14). As Christians, we are called to preserve the spiritual and moral fabric of society wherever God has placed us. And that includes influencing every aspect of our culture--entertainment, business, education, and yes, even government.
---

In my new 44-page booklet, _How a Christian Should Vote_ , I offer a biblical framework for assessing candidates, their faith, policies, and constitutional views. This practical resource will help you view the election from a biblical perspective, equipping you to make informed decisions.

Should we invest our time in influencing what seems transitory at best? The answer is simple: Jesus commanded us to be the salt and light of the world (Matthew 5:13-14). That's me at just 23, freshly graduated from flight school where I learned to fly the Apache helicopter that's just behind me.
See, my family struggled growing up – I remember moving around to stay a step ahead of the eviction notices and pouring water on my cereal because we couldn't afford milk. **I joined the Army at 17 as a way to afford college and bring stability to my life.**
And an education and economic stability is exactly what I got. I graduated from West Point and Apache flight school, became a commanding officer, and served in combat. When I decided to transition to civilian life, I simply wanted to earn my master’s degree and enjoy some peace and quiet.
But when I saw MAGA Republicans attack our freedoms, Donald Trump incite a violent insurrection, and Brian Fitzpatrick refuse to stand up to any of them – I decided to take a risk.
Filing my candidate paperwork was the most anxious I've felt since getting into the cockpit for the first time. But I did it because the Army trained me to protect my people. I did it because I refused to watch selfish politicians attack the country that saved me purely for their own power.
So here I am, putting the stability I fought so hard for on hold.

body:
Peter,

The most consequential election of our lifetimes is less than one week away.

A new MinnPost-Embold Research poll shows Donald Trump threatening Vice President Kamala Harris’s razor-thin lead in Minnesota. Races are tightening up and down the ballot, so we need to redouble our efforts to hold the line.

It’s going to take an unprecedented effort to overcome the all-out assault Republicans want to institute in Minnesota. GOP megadonors are poised to spend millions of dollars on outrageous attack ads, and Trump operatives have more door knocks and phone banks scheduled in Minnesota than in any other state.

That’s why we’re launching an emergency initiative to expand our outreach to Minnesotans, especially undecided voters and people in hard-to-reach communities that other campaigns often overlook.

We have no time to waste, Peter. Trump and his fellow MAGA extremists could turn Minnesota red and take back the White House if we don’t give these next seven days everything we’ve got. That starts with raising just over $20,000 to meet our final end-of-month budget target prior to Election Day on November 5.

According to our records, you’re still eligible for Minnesota’s Political Contribution Refund (PCR) program. You’re running out of time in this election to make a $75 donation (or $150 for couples) and receive a full refund from the state of Minnesota.

Peter, I'm reaching out today to remind you that Election Day is next Tuesday, November 5. If you haven't voted yet, don't miss this chance to make your voice heard and be a part of deciding America's future.

It may be tempting for some to sit this one out because they're tired of the political rhetoric or don't like the candidates, but this election is too important for any American to stay on the sidelines.
---
[GET VOTING INFORMATION](http://links.johnkasich.com/u/click?_t=6a3b28686d0a4d77958e12349305a4fe&_m=12abd2d3bee84f9eae9f0398ca9a87aa&_e=LNHstupPrTMNs-gpd-4eaWHgWCOCyOm2du8ogGhUFfWjjbsg6v-BgpF9suy_DiJriLQ-E44GHl75upZELZM91VHs6i6NvR8GdYuaUQljvtiz22DS7RptUQTX0deBYUPjedaGQ8IXZyfGnq8s7l5Upte2P_aYf1Zahb8MXOZaFBTYIBtcz5cbZiPzUWxfyR9ZnWCxOGfCS7E--Wgz04Dsrw%3D%3D)
---
**It's also incumbent on all of us (especially our elected leaders) to urge patience and calm as we wait for state-by-state election results**. In recent years, more states have passed laws to allow for early voting options, and some set rules about when they can start counting mail-in ballots, which means that we could be waiting days in close states to learn who the winner will be.

**What's important to remember is that this is a normal part of the process**. It does not mean there is anything illegal or corrupt is happening. In fact, it means the opposite. States should take the time that they need to ensure that every legal vote is counted correctly.

And when the result is known, it's up to each of us to remember that we are all Americans. We may have different beliefs than our neighbors, but we are still collectively a part of the greatest nation in the world. No matter the outcome, even if our candidate isn't elected, we must respect the office of the presidency. We are so much stronger when we stand together.

Thank you for your ongoing support and for being a part of the process by casting your ballot.
---
-John

name: Evangelicals for Harris
subject: TODAY: Day of Prayer
body:
Join Us in Prayer | |
---
| | | Evangelicals for Harris is **lifting up** **today as a national day of prayer for our communities, country, and candidates**. _**We invite you to pray with us today and every day through the election.**_ As evangelical Christians, **praying is one of the most powerful things we can do.** You may wish to pray alone, with your family, as part of a friend or community gathering, and share prayer requests on your social channels. Choose what’s best for you and your loved ones. However you decide to pray, know that you’re being joined by us and others across the country who are also praying.

Here are some suggestions of things to pray for, which include prayer requests provided by Evangelicals for Harris supporters. Please [share your prayer requests with us](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=69cd1af112&e=43463f1dee) so we can lift them up to our community.
* That love for others, especially the less fortunate and the vulnerable, is what determines our votes;
* Wisdom for all voters to see what’s best for the country;
* That voters take their gift of citizenship seriously, producing a strong turnout;
* A decisive victory for Vice President Harris and Governor Walz;
* Protection and safety for all voters and poll workers;
* Respect for the integrity of the voting process and results, including concessions by those who lost;
* The prevention of any efforts to subvert or steal the election;
* That the outcome can begin to bring healing to our country; and
* Favor and Wisdom for President Harris and that she has a strong Senate and House of Representatives to support her.

Thank you for all you’re doing. We’re praying for you.

Blessings,
The Evangelicals for Harris Team

clean_body: | | | I'm just going to come right out and say it, friend: I am so sick and tired of the inept and morally bankrupt leadership of Republicans in Florida. = As another dangerous hurricane hurled toward our state, Gov. Ron DeSantis refused to even pick up a phone call from Vice President Kamala Harris — who was calling to plan through recovery efforts in the aftermath of Hurricane Helene and in preparation for yet another devastating storm, Hurricane Milton. This makes me so angry: DeSantis and his allies are playing politics with the lives and livelihoods of Floridians. It's the same old tired playbook from the likes of Donald Trump and my opponent, Sen. Rick Scott. Floridians deserve better. America deserves better. It's no wonder Kamala Harris is polling within the margin of error against Trump here in Florida and that I am just 2 points behind Rick Scott. Floridians are ready for change — and it's our grassroots campaign that can deliver it. But friend, at the drop of a hat, Rick Scott spent $10 MILLION on ads to defeat me — a desperate effort to cling to power. We must respond. We must fight back. And the only way we can is if I hit my next $500,000 grassroots fundraising goal. Please, I'm counting on your donation right now:= If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Debbie Mucarsel-Powell and Kirsten Gillibrand will go through immediately: | | | = | | = | | = | | = Thank you, Debbie | * | = A note from Kirsten: Friend, I can’t thank you enough for standing by my side in the critical fights ahead of us. While Republicans only have to defend 10 seats in 2024, Democrats have to defend 23 — and if the GOP flips just two of them, it will deliver Senate control back to Mitch McConnell. Now, experts at FiveThirtyEight are saying that the GOP has a clear path to the majority. As right-wing special interests gear up to pour millions into flipping the Senate, we need to fight back right now. I am reaching out to ask you to make a donation to our campaign before our final end-of-month deadline comes to an end. Let me explain why: As you read this, Trump and his right-wing allies are outspending us on ads attacking my character and values. What does keep me up at night, is what is at stake in this election and the thought of undecided voters seeing his hate-fueled message before we have a chance to correct the record. We can and must reach these voters -- and that takes significant resources. If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | | | | | Donald Trump is counting on us to lose momentum. Voter Action Project Logo [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-weekly?refcode=102924_2&amount=25]
NPR: Ballots set on fire in three states as Election Day approaches [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=102924_2&amount=25]
This is what the anti-voting rhetoric from the vote suppressors leads to, Team:
Workers scoop burning ballots from a drop box in 2024. [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/EA/EA007/1/89215/images/DropBoxFire_WashingtonState_2024_small%282%29.gif]
Yes, those are burning ballots in Washington state's 3rd congressional district , projected to be one of the tightest races in the country. But that's not all -- another drop box in Oregon and a mailbox in Arizona were also set on fire in the last few days in attempts to destroy mail-in ballots.
Clark County Auditor Greg Kimsey said it best: " It's heartbreaking. It's a direct attack on democracy ."
We don't know who those ballots were filled out for. We don't know which political party those voters belong to. But we do know these are now hundreds of voices whose votes won't be counted. All because of the vile lies and misinformation spread about mail-in ballots for political gain by sore losers who want to hold onto their power.
Mail-in ballots have been proven safe and secure time and again, Team. We must protect their use, inform voters how easy they are to complete, and stop opponents of voting rights from attacking them, both physically and verbally. [] [] [] October 29, 2024 • Newsletter Roseanne Barr Unfiltered Moms for America Weekly Podcast [] [] Moms for America Weekly Podcast [] Roseanne Barr is one of the most successful female comedians in entertainment history. The mainstream media tried to cancel her for her political views, but she refused to be silenced. In this exclusive interview, the one and only creator and star of "Roseanne" sits down with Debbie Kraulidis on the Tucker Carlson tour in Texas. She gave Moms for America a fun, wide-ranging interview where she talked about President Trump, her faith, being a grandma and, of course, laughter! Roseanne has a lot to say, and you won’t want to miss this one! Like, share and subscribe. View the Podcast [] Listen to the Podcast [] Listen to the Podcast on Spotify [] [] [] Attack on our 1st Amendment – Moms will NOT be censored! Moms are the fierce protectors of our children's futures, boldly standing at the forefront of a battle for free speech and authentic expression. We refuse to let our voices be silenced or our beliefs coerced, as culture tries to force conformity in words, expression and beliefs. America’s moms have had it up to here with the attack on free speech. Together, we will shatter the illusion of a single narrative, nurturing a generation that honors truth and integrity and courageously challenges the status quo. You've
probably heard Bill Clinton's 1992 presidential campaign slogan,
"It's the Economy, Stupid." Clinton's political strategist, James
Carville, posted it inside campaign headquarters to keep the team
focussed and on the message.

The
slogan is making a comeback in 2024 as Republicans highlight
Kamala Harris's dismal economic record. But if you're a
freedom-loving American, we have a different slogan for you.

"It's the
Senate, Stupid."

Conservatives are rightly focused on the presidential race this
year, but winning the White House - as critical as it is - won't
be enough to save the country without a conservative Senate.
Without the Senate, President Trump won't be able to confirm his
appointees or enact his second-term agenda.

A
Republican president without a conservative Senate is simply a
waste of a Republican president.

That's
why we must take action right now to help elect the best Senate
candidates across the nation.

A
president can campaign on good policies, but he doesn't write the
bills. As long as liberals control the Senate, good legislation
will never be signed into law.

Does
anyone think Chuck Schumer will ever send bills to President
Trump's desk to secure our borders, grow our economy, expand
American energy, and restore election integrity?

Of course
not. If we fail to win the Senate, none of these common-sense
policies will be passed.

And if
Kamala Harris wins, we won't be able to stop Senate Democrats
from nuking the filibuster, passing their extreme agenda without
debate, and creating a permanent Democrat majority.

As we
head into the final days of this election, we must support the
conservatives running for U.S. Senate.

These
eight candidates believe in the principles of freedom that make
America great and are willing to fight for them. They aren't
liberal RINOs who will sell us out as soon as they're elected.

WIN THE
SENATE

Contribute to these Senate candidates and help push them on to
victory.

DONATE
NOW

These
Senate races will not receive the same media attention as the
presidential race, but they are no less important.

If you
agree that winning a conservative majority in the U.S. Senate is
vital to our nation's future, and if you're willing to engage in
these races even when the media ignores them, then please do two
things today.

(1)
Forward this email and encourage other conservatives to join our
grassroots effort to build a conservative Senate.

(2) Make
a split contribution to these candidates today. Without financial
support, they simply won't win.

Thank you
for considering this urgent request and for doing so much to help
fight for America's future.

We live
in the greatest country in the world, and if we work together, we
can preserve it for generations to come.
