body:
None of that was an accident.
#
Did you see this?
This isn’t really about a comedian. This is about the Trump campaign.
Those comments and that individual saying those things on that stage — inciting an entire arena of individuals who have been previously incited to commit attacks, like the ones we saw on January 6th, by people like Donald Trump — **none of that was an accident**.
These campaign events are vetted. That language was vetted by the Trump campaign. That person was approved by the Trump campaign because he is speaking _on behalf_ of the Trump campaign.
What is being said and transmitted about Latinos in the United States is exactly what the Trump campaign means: **who they believe is American and who they don’t is not based on citizenship, but based on ethnicity and their opinion of Donald Trump**.
When Donald Trump and Stephen Miller flirt with the idea of taking away US citizenship from people depending on their own personal opinions about what “being an American” means, **they mean what they say**.
**And _we believe them_. So we’re organizing against them every minute of the next 7 days**.

https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-tester [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-tester]
Hello there, it’s Ken Burns.
I’ve dedicated my life to telling America’s stories through film. Oftentimes, those stories aren’t easy. They examine moments of our country in crisis and threats to our democracy.
So, I can confidently say our country is at a crossroads, and this is the most consequential election of our lives. We are the stewards of our republic, and now, more than ever, our democratic values are at stake.
That’s why I’m reaching out today. The fate of our Democratic Senate majority—and all the progress that comes with it—hinges on Jon Tester and what happens in Montana.
Will you please join me in supporting Jon’s campaign during this critical moment by making a split donation today? I’m not exaggerating when I say the stakes have never been higher. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-tester]

Having spent almost five decades making films that tell America’s stories, I am well-versed in our country’s historic moments.
Despite troubling times, Americans have always met challenging moments with fierce hope and determination to preserve a future that safeguards our democracy, respects our rights, and upholds our most cherished value of freedom.

body:
freedomva.org [freedomva.org]
Moms are important; they care for us, they love us, and they legislate. Virginia boasts a General Assembly with a historic number of women serving, 14% of them being mothers with young children. That gives Virginia the third-highest percentage of mothers in the legislature [https://www.axios.com/local/richmond/2024/10/21/virginia-mom-legislators-young-kids?utm_source=newsletter&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=newsletter_axioslocal_richmond&stream=top&nvep=&hmac=&emci=01c2a4ae-4491-ef11-8474-000d3a98fa6b&emdi=ea000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001&ceid=] across the country. So what is Virginia doing to take care of moms?
https://richmond.com/news/state-regional/government-politics/virginia-legislators-infant-mortality-don-scott-mamie-locke/article_e1f0e34e-8d81-11ef-b3a9-cb36708925bd.html [https://richmond.com/news/state-regional/government-politics/virginia-legislators-infant-mortality-don-scott-mamie-locke/article_e1f0e34e-8d81-11ef-b3a9-cb36708925bd.html]
Read the Full Article Here [https://richmond.com/news/state-regional/government-politics/virginia-legislators-infant-mortality-don-scott-mamie-locke/article_e1f0e34e-8d81-11ef-b3a9-cb36708925bd.html]
This bipartisan proposal focuses on expanding on General Assembly initiatives to provide comprehensive care for mothers and set up a maternal mortality review team to address high rates of mortality for Black women, who are three times more likely to die from a pregnancy-related cause than white women [https://www.bing.com/search?pglt=41&q=black+pregnancy+mortality+rate&cvid=894a0b1d862e4b9788dd5bca77c4e61e&gs_lcrp=EgRlZGdlKgYIARAAGEAyBggAEEUYOTIGCAEQABhAMgYIAhAAGEAyBggDEAAYQDIGCAQQABhAMgYIBRAAGEAyBggGEAAYQDIGCAcQABhAMgYICBAAGEDSAQg2NTAwajBqMagCALACAA&FORM=ANNTA1&PC=SMTS] .
Healthcare, especially maternal care, needs to be safe and equitable for ALL in Virginia. This session, we’re standing with moms and continuing the fight for access to affordable childcare and paid family and medical leave so that Virginia’s moms can focus on what they do best: changing our commonwealth for the better.
Natalie Jones

| "Previously, I wrote about both presidential candidates talking almost exclusively to their bases and neither trying to appeal to undecided or crossover voters. That’s become less true in the past couple of weeks. Trump did an interview with Bloomberg editor and chief John Micklethwait. David Pan Shares Immigrant Values of Hard Work and Education

| | | | | [](https://eot.davidpanforcongress.org/f/a/6UmM2SMQHECaQVZtvXxRNw~~/AAAHUQA~/RgRpA4u2P0UgODY0YTk3MDc1ZjJmMjUwYzdiYzljODM5MDRhNGY5NTREImh0dHA6Ly93d3cuZGF2aWRwYW5mb3Jjb25ncmVzcy5jb21XBXNwY2V1QgpnDrYGIWfQKGh0UhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAABrnQ~~)

| | I am excited to share the news that the **Hispanic 100 Foundation** ([https://www.h100foundation.org/](https://eot.davidpanforcongress.org/f/a/HiukP_RWFFLm-w9kJ2iH2Q~~/AAAHUQA~/RgRpA4u2P0UgNDE2MTRhNjQ1N2I5Mzk0NjlhMjQ4YTBhZDhiZjFlYjREH2h0dHBzOi8vd3d3LmgxMDBmb3VuZGF0aW9uLm9yZy9XBXNwY2V1QgpnDrYGIWfQKGh0UhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAABrnQ~~)) has endorsed my campaign for Congress against an embedded opponent in California’s majority-Hispanic 46th district, covering Santa Ana, Anaheim, Stanton, Fullerton, and Orange.

Mario Rodriguez, Chairman of Hispanic 100, stated that “David Pan promotes equal opportunity, school choice, and strong law enforcement, all of which resonate with the Hispanic population, who are committed to hard work and education as the way to create opportunities for our youth.”

I am extremely grateful to Mario Rodriguez and Hispanic 100 for this endorsement. They have been pioneers in developing mentoring and scholarship programs to help Hispanic youth, and they are committed to making sure that the Hispanic community can thrive.

Though Hispanics have traditionally voted Democrat, our surveys indicate that there will be a major Hispanic shift toward the Republican party in this district. They value public safety and want to see our laws enforced. They support school choice as a way to give parents more control over their children’s education and improve outcomes for all students.

They also see the dysfunction of our government bureaucracy and support overwhelmingly my plan to phase out our current welfare and entitlement system and use this money to create a universal basic income. This transformation would help working families the most, who currently pay into the system but receive very little back. Meanwhile, non-working people receive benefits that disappear when they work and save, creating a counter-productive set of incentives that trap them in poverty.

My parents immigrated from Taiwan, and I understand the perspective of recent immigrants, who value our market-based structures, our democratic freedoms, and the ideal of equal opportunity. My volunteers and I have spoken to thousands of Hispanic voters, and they agree that hard work and equal educational opportunity are the best ways to guarantee a prosperous future for the Hispanic community. I am committed to transforming our system to orient it around these values.

Please support my campaign by telling your family and friends to vote for me. You can also find more information and donate at [https://www.davidpanforcongress.com/](https://eot.davidpanforcongress.org/f/a/lz6zT7asEEgdljHsU2TWsA~~/AAAHUQA~/RgRpA4u2P0UgMDQ0MmI5NWIyYmIxZDYzNDEzYTBlMDhlYzY4MmQ2YWREJGh0dHBzOi8vd3d3LmRhdmlkcGFuZm9yY29uZ3Jlc3MuY29tL1cFc3BjZXVCCmcOtgYhZ9AoaHRSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAGud).

Thank you!

clean_body: Our college campuses have witnessed all sorts of protests. | | | Friend, Our college campuses have witnessed all sorts of protests. We only see the angry kids burning flags, but there is actually an army of student liberty activists doing great work, too. Instead of blocking traffic, these students are helping liberty candidates win tough races and getting pro-liberty legislation passed into law. No, these aren’t overpaid consultants wasting campaign resources. These are college-aged youth trained in effective activism, making a difference by door-knocking in some of the most critical districts in the country, and they are delivering major success. I’m talking about Young Americans for Liberty’s Operation Win at the Door. Before I tell you their success rate, please let me explain why it is critical - especially today - to support them in 2024. Alright, now here are the stats showing you how successful these student door knockers are: Since 2018, YAL-recruited student activists have helped elect 328 liberty legislators who have passed over 500 pro-liberty bills. In 2020, YAL-trained student activists helped pro-liberty candidates win races in 72 Counties that Biden carried. YAL-recruited student door knockers have helped elect 66 legislators who were outspent by their opponents. It’s more powerful than money! YAL-trained activists helped secure 128 Wins with margins of victory within 5%! * Independent studies prove YAL-trained door knockers help swing races by 6-15%! Here’s the truth that no one wants to admit... If YAL’s Operation Win at the Door is so successful, then why isn’t everyone doing this? Good question! The simple answer is it is NOT easy to pull off. Conservatives are way behind the radical left when it comes to door-to-door operations. It requires a large network of youth to mobilize such a program, and most organizations do not have access to a large pool of applicants. Most conservative consultants would rather throw money at TV advertisements instead of doing the hard work of door-knocking. name: DNC HQ
subject: A request in the next 60 seconds
body:
Election Day is one week away. Here’s the situation:
---
[](https://ak.democrats.org/go/7620?refcode=&t=1&akid=2142%2E22930333%2EMI-eGJ) Derek, In the next 60 seconds, we’re going to ask if you can attend an event near you to help elect Kamala Harris, Tim Walz, and Democrats nationwide. Here’s the situation: Election Day is one week away. The polls are as close as they’ve ever been. With so much on the line, we’re asking everyone who cares about the outcome of this election to take action in the next few days. That might include stepping out of your comfort zone to knock on doors or make calls for the first time. But don’t worry, our team will make sure you have everything you need to confidently have meaningful conversations with voters, and to make a real impact in this election. **So what do you say, Derek? Can you commit to getting out the vote at an event in your area?**
* * *
**Knock Doors for Kamala Harris in Monroe County!** Wednesday, October 30th, 11:00 a.m. Monroe County Office 24, Stroudsburg, PA 18360
[**SIGN UP HERE](https://ak.democrats.org/go/6822?c0=645465.dT1fzf&utm_campaign=em_ak_mb_do_vol_gotv_20241029_bg_natl_na_na_na&utm_source=mbak_organizing&utm_term=em_20241029_2142_do&t=2&akid=2142%2E22930333%2EMI-eGJ)**
* * *
**Drive canvassers in Monroe County** Saturday, November 2nd, 11:00 a.m. Stroudsburg, PA 18360
[**SIGN UP HERE](https://ak.democrats.org/go/6822?c0=705682.76_WoX&utm_campaign=em_ak_mb_do_vol_gotv_20241029_bg_natl_na_na_na&utm_source=mbak_organizing&utm_term=em_20241029_2142_do&t=2&akid=2142%2E22930333%2EMI-eGJ)**
* * *
**The Final Stretch Canvass with PA Dems in Stroudsburg!** Saturday, November 2nd, 9:00 a.m. Stroudsburg, PA 18360
[**SIGN UP HERE](https://ak.democrats.org/go/6822?c0=713578.xnxtz7&utm_campaign=em_ak_mb_do_vol_gotv_20241029_bg_natl_na_na_na&utm_source=mbak_organizing&utm_term=em_20241029_2142_do&t=2&akid=2142%2E22930333%2EMI-eGJ)**
* * *
**[Can't make any of these events? Find many more opportunities to get involved in your community at go.kamalaharris.com](https://ak.democrats.org/go/10469?t=3&akid=2142%2E22930333%2EMI-eGJ)** Every voter we reach in these last few days could help tip the scales in this election. It really makes a difference. Thank you for everything you’re doing in these final days, The Democrats P.S. Can’t make any of these events but still want to help? **[Chip in a $3 donation to the DNC](https://ak.democrats.org/go/10470?amount=3&t=6&akid=2142%2E22930333%2EMI-eGJ)** to support our voter outreach efforts.

_If you gave recently via check or mail, our system may not have yet processed your gift. We are appreciative and thank you greatly for your support._

Mitch McConnell and his allies spent over $55 million to defeat me in 2022 because they knew Nevada was the key to controlling the Senate.
**_I narrowly won re-election by less than a percentage point and I couldn’t have done it without grassroots supporters like you._**

| Peter,

In the final days before Election Day, we've been spending most of our time on the campaign trail. It’s one of my favorite parts of campaigning... yes, even when I’m stuck without cell reception and running low on gas. Talk about cell phone bars - too often, I’m the only “Barr” in the car. Ha!

**Let me explain.**

Here’s a map of our district.

We are Michigan’s biggest Congressional district geographically, but we’re also pretty sparse. **When it comes to basic utilities, rural communities like ours typically bear the brunt of a lack of infrastructure development.**

It’s an issue that’s been present in my life for as long as I can remember, and it’s really noticeable when you’re traveling from one end of our district to the other. I’ve had to make accommodations with my team to ensure we’re communicating to the best of our ability, and sometimes that just means I’m optimistically yelling, “Can you hear me now?”

**_Upper and Northern Michiganders need investments in rural broadband, plain and simple. A congressman like Bergman, who votes against that funding, shouldn’t be in office._ [_I’m running for Congress to give us a seat at the table and ensure we break down digital equity barriers. body:
It’s really that simple.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96080514/508843617/2130526953?refcode=emwrapper&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZTg2NmU4NzEtMTM5Ni1lZjExLTg4Y2UtMDAwZDNhOThmYTZiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=XoDEHg5b09wrB5y6yPUvE19K66zJ09Wn4mEjSJyJz-c=&emci=40a1a86b-1396-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&emdi=e866e871-1396-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&ceid=14016711)
Peter,
On Sunday, during Donald Trump’s rally at Madison Square Garden, podcaster Tony Hinchcliffe took the stage and delivered a shockingly racist “joke” about Puerto Rico, calling it “a floating island of garbage in the middle of the ocean.” He followed up with another “joke” about “carving watermelons” with Black people, while Tucker Carlson mocked Kamala Harris’ racial identity, and another speaker likened the Vice President to a prostitute managed by “pimps.”
The legacy media has rightly focused intense coverage on the rally and what it reveals about Trump and the racism of the MAGA movement.
**But it’s fair to ask—what took so long? This is nothing new. For MAGA, cruelty has always been the point, often aimed at minority groups while mainly ignoring the white supporters who form the movement’s base.**
[**We’ll share more about how COURIER is holding MAGA and the media accountable while building a positive, community-focused alternative to hate-driven journalism. But if you’re ready to support us in this mission, can you chip in $25 today?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96080515/508843618/-260044646?refcode=20241029-EM-MAGACruelty&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZTg2NmU4NzEtMTM5Ni1lZjExLTg4Y2UtMDAwZDNhOThmYTZiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=XoDEHg5b09wrB5y6yPUvE19K66zJ09Wn4mEjSJyJz-c=)
For a decade, the legacy media has struggled to cover Trump without normalizing him or fueling his hate-driven MAGA movement.
The reason is simple: Trump isn’t just a political candidate—he’s a fascist hate merchant who sells an addictive brand of racism, bigotry, and xenophobia.
**The cruelty and divisive racial politics aren’t accidental—they’re a calculated strategy to keep his supporters angry, loyal, and primed to view Trump and the MAGA movement as the only solution to save an America he describes as a “garbage can.” **
His rhetoric has mainstreamed the worst of white supremacy, conspiracy theories, and Christian nationalist ideas, creating a twisted feedback loop that both he and his supporters feed on.
**At COURIER, we’re committed to breaking this cycle by holding Trump and the far-right media accountable.** And we meet people where they’re most likely to encounter this cruel rhetoric – on social media news feeds and in email inboxes – and counter it at the source with real news.

Peter, On Sunday, during Donald Trump’s rally at Madison Square Garden, podcaster Tony Hinchcliffe took the stage and delivered a shockingly racist “joke” about Puerto Rico, calling it “a floating island of garbage in the middle of the ocean.” He followed up with another “joke” about “carving watermelons” with Black people, while Tucker Carlson mocked Kamala Harris’ racial identity, and another speaker likened the Vice President to a prostitute managed by “pimps.” The legacy media has rightly focused intense coverage on the rally and what it reveals about Trump and the racism of the MAGA movement. But it’s fair to ask—what took so long? This is nothing new. For MAGA, cruelty has always been the point, often aimed at minority groups while mainly ignoring the white supporters who form the movement’s base. = For a decade, the legacy media has struggled to cover Trump without normalizing him or fueling his hate-driven MAGA movement. The reason is simple: Trump isn’t just a political candidate—he’s a fascist hate merchant who sells an addictive brand of racism, bigotry, and xenophobia. The cruelty and divisive racial politics aren’t accidental—they’re a calculated strategy to keep his supporters angry, loyal, and primed to view Trump and the MAGA movement as the only solution to save an America he describes as a “garbage can.” His rhetoric has mainstreamed the worst of white supremacy, conspiracy theories, and Christian nationalist ideas, creating a twisted feedback loop that both he and his supporters feed on. At COURIER, we’re committed to breaking this cycle by holding Trump and the far-right media accountable. Ohio is **OFFICIALLY** the most expensive U.S. Senate race of 2024.

But with the support of each and every one of you, we can win.** [**I hope you’ll read on and, if you’re able, make a $47 donation today.**](https://click.contact.kamalaharris.com/ss/c/u001.NV3IV8RXB3BPG-RgoenRivizIuY7_hyRTlr0Ev1A4jyRess_Z46ivJQExIi6hcFA37l4hMbbj3hHO6FwDMmULGGIWP2pg5QVBCBaixvdx6g6ltSXvhDG_W-ttRQllcwGF0Z7ApjFkY-tUDQHMqW21rapq6UY8jE1UqjRGCm0oRgLCkIdzhgdd4NdnhY_-yz3TesCzKuPzQIZIDyzPfvyZdBTnTl_TqGhpCsOS-_uTqKZvtJsss7ZsZMITB7fyVV0E_fud4MuHrTCNWqwSX88954O9LBLQFyBczfyavqWiXSoDL5iC3gys5TjRIcQVYjqaRMyu2NEmrRPXxRIUCW2hwjHUEhNo2aozoAkqLZlXv35ktAFq34BLgbIaMbNg-2bxHaAosud_Cz4anwOogB-OL79UpYJnMtHy9zBz7Kqvi_uVC3Rp5o9mq6udRA8IvyHX3C3NR4yt1lBC55vzi2eXCNoHFSUOG4Nf3GUEVps85F5wsIh9ZmNcJr966diK542Vk7x6EFpi9GqQuSGJIzi6bOP8ZC4r9lKJt9TNwstGhv4OnQDbypafFz5MYctRjmW/4b0/7rnnAk34QMGqhXKmWr5-1g/h1/h001.0rAtNcyvmFzRjWEVsj_n82c9ZW_iLj4sIPJTAvP11pU) Let's get into it. Jen
* * *
**_State of the Race_** We've got a wide map. While Donald Trump has only ever had one path to victory, our campaign continues to have multiple pathways to earning the 270 electoral votes we need to win. We can do it by winning:
1. The “Blue Wall” or Pennsylvania, Michigan, and Wisconsin
2. The “Sun Belt” or Georgia, North Carolina, Arizona, and Nevada
3. Or a combination of both

We are closely monitoring each of these states and, every week, we're seeing growing enthusiasm. We're excited about it, and we’re not taking our eye off the ball in any of the other states that are also critical to winning. **This is a margin-of-error race.** _Every single one of our top battleground states is polling within the margin of error._ [](https://click.contact.kamalaharris.com/ss/c/u001.NV3IV8RXB3BPG-RgoenRivizIuY7_hyRTlr0Ev1A4jyRess_Z46ivJQExIi6hcFA37l4hMbbj3hHO6FwDMmULGGIWP2pg5QVBCBaixvdx6g6ltSXvhDG_W-ttRQllcwGF0Z7ApjFkY-tUDQHMqW21rapq6UY8jE1UqjRGCm0oRgLCkIdzhgdd4NdnhY_-yz3TesCzKuPzQIZIDyzPfvyZdBTnTl_TqGhpCsOS-_uTqKZvtJsss7ZsZMITB7fyVV0E_fud4MuHrTCNWqwSX88954O9LBLQFyBczfyavqWiXSoDL5iC3gys5TjRIcQVYjqaRMyu2NEmrRPXxRIUCW2hwjHUEhNo2aozoAkqLZlXv2Vg8a319MVzKs2SFzw2jn53u89L7enihbBfLtaoMRWJdOlgx9PqAp7eqXq1-o986tX73XgAoRS4q0xvdxYA3goGkyQeQmwXMEnusyI0G8HW8VcwJDCMd4WWHKWSxoptjpXxeZXjVJsomnCbpG-ysyrgIgkAdIdUUqkCQc1ZPU02vdRRxLwqbaGsVN70lD6IEa0F_moIBXOGSWLuhiydbrC/4b0/7rnnAk34QMGqhXKmWr5-1g/h2/h001.AcHBRdYCS_8X2rH9k1pVzPImLJJizNOfxe7g3vgWno4) We need your help to keep getting our message out to undecided voters in these states -- whether that's on the doors, through calls, or by investing in TV and digital ads. **_Early Vote_** If you're like me, or maybe my mom who watches cable news all the time, you’re probably curious about what's going on with early vote. The long and short of it is: **We feel really good about what we’re seeing on the ground.** [](https://click.contact.kamalaharris.com/ss/c/u001.NV3IV8RXB3BPG-RgoenRivizIuY7_hyRTlr0Ev1A4jyRess_Z46ivJQExIi6hcFA37l4hMbbj3hHO6FwDMmULGGIWP2pg5QVBCBaixvdx6g6ltSXvhDG_W-ttRQllcwGF0Z7ApjFkY-tUDQHMqW21rapq6UY8jE1UqjRGCm0oRgLCkIdzhgdd4NdnhY_-yz3TesCzKuPzQIZIDyzPfvyZdBTnTl_TqGhpCsOS-_uTqKZvtJsss7ZsZMITB7fyVV0E_fud4MuHrTCNWqwSX88954O9LBLQFyBczfyavqWiXSoDL5iC3gys5TjRIcQVYjqaRMyu2NEmrRPXxRIUCW2hwjHUEhNo2aozoAkqLZlXv1LdASkVzyzRteYfjIDN-Y5KycP279eNBIzEu0ctskxYn57r4xQAil4ReAGpviv5OfmGGk7JYBc9c1uWUgpEk6WRWH5lmP-7DE3wsMAQjmI7s2kKVWmmjX4PtZvApRZlEsxY51RZtPELHrIRBtIZZ6cWPPc7EtIJYylOURlM3zVr-XppBLLY7nyhWA17RsII6-weP9y8yGzMA2BDTh1tKCO/4b0/7rnnAk34QMGqhXKmWr5-1g/h3/h001.ioy4TlQ14QteDAPJXmf2CVwpvS9jQvan8EcZe5XaZhw) In Clark County in Nevada, we have seen a higher turnout from young voters over the last two days than we have at any other point in the cycle. **But I won’t sugar coat it: Republicans are _also_ voting early.** So, we still have a lot of work to do. There are still a lot of people in these states that are undecided, but they are more open to supporting the Vice President and Governor Walz than Trump. _They just need to know a little bit more information._ Those undecided and lower-propensity voters need to hear from us. They need to have people at their doors. They need to get phone calls. They need to see us wherever they are in any part of their life. And that will require a tremendous amount of resources. **_Where You Come In_** I know you’re anxious. I know you’re worried. And that is okay! But it’s important to channel that anxiety into winning this election. _Because how you take action now really matters._ **How many doors we knock, how many phone calls we make, how many voters see our ads and mail, or how many of our friends and neighbors we get to the polls could determine the outcome of this election. ** While it might not seem like a donation of $25, $10, or even $5 can make a difference, I promise you it does. This campaign is primarily funded by grassroots supporters. Whether you give or not will determine if we have the resources we need to invest in the digital and television ads and battleground state organizing we need to win this election. **That’s why I’m asking you to make your first investment in the resources Kamala needs to win today.** [**It looks like you haven't donated yet to our campaign. With just seven days until Election Day, I’m here to give you an update. The bottom line is this: This is a margin-of-error race. But with the support of each and every one of you, we can win. Let's get into it. Jen State of the Race We've got a wide map. While Donald Trump has only ever had one path to victory, our campaign continues to have multiple pathways to earning the 270 electoral votes we need to win. We can do it by winning: 1. The “Blue Wall” or Pennsylvania, Michigan, and Wisconsin 2. The “Sun Belt” or Georgia, North Carolina, Arizona, and Nevada 3. Or a combination of both We are closely monitoring each of these states and, every week, we're seeing growing enthusiasm. We're excited about it, and we’re not taking our eye off the ball in any of the other states that are also critical to winning. This is a margin-of-error race. Every single one of our top battleground states is polling within the margin of error. We need your help to keep getting our message out to undecided voters in these states -- whether that's on the doors, through calls, or by investing in TV and digital ads. Early Vote If you're like me, or maybe my mom who watches cable news all the time, you’re probably curious about what's going on with early vote. The long and short of it is: We feel really good about what we’re seeing on the ground. In Clark County in Nevada, we have seen a higher turnout from young voters over the last two days than we have at any other point in the cycle. But I won’t sugar coat it: Republicans are also voting early. So, we still have a lot of work to do. There are still a lot of people in these states that are undecided, but they are more open to supporting the Vice President and Governor Walz than Trump. They just need to know a little bit more information. Those undecided and lower-propensity voters need to hear from us. They need to have people at their doors. They need to get phone calls. They need to see us wherever they are in any part of their life. And that will require a tremendous amount of resources. Where You Come In I know you’re anxious. I know you’re worried. And that is okay! But it’s important to channel that anxiety into winning this election. Because how you take action now really matters. How many doors we knock, how many phone calls we make, how many voters see our ads and mail, or how many of our friends and neighbors we get to the polls could determine the outcome of this election. While it might not seem like a donation of $25, $10, or even $5 can make a difference, I promise you it does. This campaign is primarily funded by grassroots supporters. Whether you give or not will determine if we have the resources we need to invest in the digital and television ads and battleground state organizing we need to win this election. That’s why I’m asking you to make your first investment in the resources Kamala needs to win today. | FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE TUESDAY, OCTOBER 29
GREATER GEORGIA LAUNCHES CAMPAIGN TO DRIVE TURNOUT IN KEY REPUBLICAN COUNTIES
(ATLANTA) - Today, Greater Georgia announced a new digital ad, text message, and phone call campaign to drive up voter turnout in key Republican counties. Early voting turnout is currently strongest in counties that President Trump won in the 2020 election. However, Greater Georgia is targeting 80,000 Republican voters in four major counties with a turnout of less than 40%: Bartow, Carroll, Walker, and Whitfield.
"Republican counties are outpacing Democrat counties on turnout, which is a clear sign that conservatives have the enthusiasm advantage in Georgia," said Greater Georgia Chairwoman and former U.S. Senator Kelly Loeffler. "But Greater Georgia is taking nothing for granted - which is why we're closely watching the data and making real-time adjustments to drive up turnout in key areas. By flooding the state with get-out-the-vote efforts where they are needed most, we will augment our margin of victory - and help President Trump and the entire ticket deliver a clear victory next Tuesday."
Bartow, Carroll, Walker, and Whitfield counties are the only Republican strongholds in the state with a turnout of less than 40%.
As of this morning, the average turnout in counties that went for Trump in 2020 is 41.5%. The average turnout in counties that went for Biden in 2020 is 38.9%. Several Republican stronghold counties are seeing high turnout, including Forsyth with 56.3% turnout and Cherokee with 49.6% turnout. Meanwhile, Democrat strongholds like Dougherty and Clayton counties have only achieved 28.6% and 36.4% turnout, respectively.
This is the latest GOTV campaign from Greater Georgia, which has also launched targeted campaigns to encourage Black, Hispanic, Asian, and young voters to [support President Trump](https://fsdy8nbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001NYW3SuViA9GcbtxkoSu-JTJAH3zaWJyC9aFJLQQr0zGMFoSkbvY7ivV6bXboWK6IYHxMQyK0poJ0MDhUXHXVrXKA4z7-JgYGKCzgFFYO1NInfd8D5cEk3w38m00QDtE5kx6sUCceenoERUfpqL5C4VKrbJtNMqIJmKx4iX4hIIk=&c=1dKdfiBMo8PUxpRNlVkXGDujfpxf6dDc9XKvauYspP7-LpGjX36-Wg==&ch=UUeDYp4Dj6dW0Z21h-TKe-vl6hX07sC5Znqtw3JMhawZg5pILIt2Rw==).

body:
Forgive me for being blunt, but we desperately need your help right now.

| |

---

She's also trying to protect us from people like her MAGA opponent, who wants to be another destructive force in the Senate helping Republicans crush affordable health care, ban abortion, and do nothing about the senseless gun violence Nevadans know all too well.

subject: 7 Days until Election Day
body:
Democracy on the line | | | | | [](https://kevinmullinforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=31b479dbea5973b27a9d19670&id=1887e28d2f&e=292fde286a)

| Dear Peter,
With only seven days left until Election Day, we’re in the final stretch of our campaign to defend our democracy and the values we share. As we rally behind the VP Kamala Harris-Tim Walz ticket, I’m more determined than ever to continue advocating for our community in Congress – tackling the urgent challenges of protecting voting rights, addressing climate change, and supporting hardworking families.
[Donate now to fund our final 7 days.](https://kevinmullinforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=31b479dbea5973b27a9d19670&id=fbfdff2d83&e=292fde286a)
In Congress, I’ve been proud to champion initiatives to make our democracy more resilient, from safeguarding voting access to keeping dark money out of elections. I’m also leading efforts to protect our community from climate impacts such as sea level rise, supporting essential programs that make it possible for families to prepare their homes and neighborhoods for a changing climate.
Now, I need your help to carry this momentum forward to the finish line. [Your contribution of $50, $150, or even $500 today could make the difference we need to secure a win for our values.](https://kevinmullinforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=31b479dbea5973b27a9d19670&id=fe261be87e&e=292fde286a) Let’s finish strong for the Peninsula, for our state, and for our country. Please give now to support this shared mission.
Thank you for standing with me in this vital work.
---
| | | | | Sincerely,
---
| Kevin MullinCongressman, Congressional District 15

we have 1 week to save the White House!
| Team, we have just _1 week_ until Election Day.

We’re doing _everything we can_ in these final 7 days to boost Democrats like Harris and Walz to the White House — **starting with sending them an exclusive letter to show our support.**

There are just 7 spots left for local Democrats, and we wanted to open this up to top Democrats (like you!) first: [**Here’s your chance to sign onto our letter to VP Harris and Governor Walz! »**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/83689?t=6&akid=17808%2E878179%2EZy2lRD) [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/83689?t=7&akid=17808%2E878179%2EZy2lRD) | VP Kamala Harris and Governor Tim Walz
FROM: Your Strongest Supporter
Subject: LET’S DO THIS! Dear Vice President Harris and Governor Walz,

**I am ALL IN on making sure YOU are our next leaders in the White House in these final 7 days!**

We are so lucky to have you as our potential next President and Vice President, and I am working tirelessly to ensure MAGA extremists like Donald Trump and JD Vance come nowhere near the White House.

You are incredible and inspirational leaders, and our country would be lucky to have you in the White House — in this final week, I’m with you every step of the way!

**We know Trump and Vance will _lie, cheat,_ and do _everything they can_ to bring our country backwards — but they don’t have an army of grassroots support behind them the way that you do.**

[**I wish you the best of luck, Vice President Harris and Governor Walz! We are 1 week away from Election Day. There is a looming question: **Will Christians Get Out And Vote?** The _Left_ and the _Media_ know the impact of the **Christian Vote** and therefore, there is a **Media** spin trying to keep Christians home. Today, [RawStory](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=16472353.9170.1.312da68c6379574d6540261ae2a2a80f) released an article about **Faith Leaders** who have stayed loyal to **President Trump** and then those who have not so much. I was grateful that I made the list of the _good guys._ But, there are some **Faith Leaders** who have been quiet this election season. However, over the last several weeks, I have been to several **Faith Leader** gatherings with **President Trump** such as the **11th Hour Hour** gathering in Charlotte and the **National Faith Advisory Board summit** in Atlanta and my take a way is that the media is not only wrong but **DEAD WRONG**. **Faith Leaders** are engaged and are pushing their congregations to get out and vote. If my experience at these gatherings is true then we are going to see _MASSIVE_ Christian Turnout which means **WE WILL WIN**. **The job is not finished yet**. Continue to encourage your Christian friends to get out and vote and vote Biblical values. Thank you,
Pastor Jackson Lahmeyer

* Problem Solver: Jessica’s career in public service has been all about tackling tough challenges—from counterterrorism to nuclear nonproliferation, and even fighting wildfires. She’s been on the frontlines of global crises and is the leadership we need now.

* Wildfire Expertise: With California facing wildfires as we speak, Jessica’s unique expertise in wildfire prevention and forest management is desperately needed—not just here in CA, but nationally.

* Flip the House: Taking back Congress runs through California! CA-03 is now a Kamala +1 district—WE CAN WIN THIS!

* The ONLY Woman: Jessica is the only woman running in a red-to-blue seat in California. We must elect more Democratic women to the House!

Friend, When voters in Michigan’s 12th congressional district turn out to vote, our voices are heard at all levels of government. But during our August primary this year, over 19,000 Democrats didn’t return their absentee ballots. **Since then, we’ve been working hard to engage and encourage those folks to follow through and vote in the general election.** And so far, 10,243 have voted―that’s more than 53%! **Through text messages, door-knocking, phone calls, and handwritten postcards, we’re working to ensure the remaining 8,896 people vote between now and Election Day.** Here’s me and Joshua knocking on doors in a city that only had 11.76% turnout. We visited with neighbors who had a sporadic voter history. [****](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqsVjXKDSwuoovVdVLjx0dDtjYxuBybI9iYZuxuuhW2Y8EqET6TfUOPQS-XbP6CJKcwD_iSjtkU-GyOI_KkQYvj6frP4r_JIKbQJuT6q09MNBzID-obzOU60_d1jYKa803dWFFeCCORf1IKTi1jm0fkAR2dbjP87wX8cDMcONgpASeXYIuhfz88h44Ugu9ugsEHHtCyzX_FY4wEA7NFDt8xeu2OVFvfjlBCzfLbgjEAx-uHtlwwJqZYHHv3m5NvcMjQe5amhwONnA1tK_XV_BI949xNPYAX2xSJ_QCjCYhOaVtIMnyluGD3fbR-qr8L4wew5_KSIrwGl75-XFrvOOqUPj3dqr1jTHHsqSokXGUntBml8X34_4cedSFany_05l3ap36NZeSd534dhtaInmGby0SnJYU88Zip4LcDdSZWPmQ/4b0/xFVHeoASToeCTPYMY8yS3g/h1/h001._k_raxX2hKgw_PMkdE28d5jOi8cSvxpnC-11a9tvmZQ) In addition to engaging lapsed and sporadic voters, we’re also reaching out to the 15,859 people who registered to vote in the 12th district this year. Thus far, only 7.4% have voted. That’s why we sent each a personal letter from me and followed that up with a text message and phone call. Studies show that direct voter contact is the most effective method to get our neighbors the information they need to vote. [**In 2020, our team helped increase voter turnout by 3% in our district with a similar voter outreach program. clean_body: Our democracy works best when each of us is informed and engaged. | | | Friend, When voters in Michigan’s 12th congressional district turn out to vote, our voices are heard at all levels of government. But during our August primary this year, over 19,000 Democrats didn’t return their absentee ballots. Since then, we’ve been working hard to engage and encourage those folks to follow through and vote in the general election. And so far, 10,243 have voted―that’s more than 53%! Through text messages, door-knocking, phone calls, and handwritten postcards, we’re working to ensure the remaining 8,896 people vote between now and Election Day. Here’s me and Joshua knocking on doors in a city that only had 11.76% turnout. We visited with neighbors who had a sporadic voter history. In addition to engaging lapsed and sporadic voters, we’re also reaching out to the 15,859 people who registered to vote in the 12th district this year. Thus far, only 7.4% have voted. That’s why we sent each a personal letter from me and followed that up with a text message and phone call. Studies show that direct voter contact is the most effective method to get our neighbors the information they need to vote. | Here’s an update on the direct voter contact our campaign team has done over the last 6 weeks: 🚪 2,638 doors knocked (including in Inkster, where only 11% of residents voted in the last election) ☎️ 39,164 phone calls 🤳 89,587 text messages 📝 2,858 post-walk postcards sent out ✉️ 30,000 letters mailed Here are members of our campaign team, plus 21 volunteers, who joined me and State Representative Dylan Wegela heading out to knock doors in Inkster: If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your secure donation will go through immediately: | | | | | | | | | Our democracy works best when each of us is informed and engaged. Dear Fellow Montanan,
A week from today the polls will be closing and Montanans will elect their new State Auditor. As you know, in January, I stepped up to run for this important position because Montanans want folks, like me, in office who understand that government is designed to work for the people, not the other way around. I stepped up to run for this important office because I understand that the Founding Fathers envisioned a country where free people can make decisions for themselves without passing on massive deficits and debt to future generations. I also understand that elected officials need to be a partner in empowering individuals and freeing up job creators from onerous government regulations. I am humbled by the support I have received to date from all corners of Montana. I am winning this race because I have stayed positive with my message that we need to Montanans first. However, my opponent’s campaign has gone completely negative. My opponent has now spent months attacking me, on everything from my personal life, to my business operations, to my stated desire to protect the Montana way of life from out-of-state dark money special interests. With only a week to go, can you help me counter and fend off the lies and politics of personal destruction in this coming week by contributing $50, $100, $250 or even $500 by contributing online today at [jamesbrownformontana.com](https://gmail.us22.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e42c6bb78e8b53de5ee6ec610&id=586caf1496&e=80cd3574a3)?

| Setting aside the awful rhetoric of my opponent’s campaign, if you want to protect good paying Montana jobs and a bright economic future, not only for ourselves, but also for our kids and their kids, please join me next Tuesday in our shared effort to restore promise to Montana. I am humbled to be your candidate for Montana Auditor and am humbled to receive your vote here in 2024. Sincerely,
James BrownRepublican for Auditor

body:
What will your choice be... Peter,

Right now, we’re in a fight for the future of our country.

The polls are showing neck-and-neck races all over the country, and the choices couldn’t be clearer.

Up and down the ballot, voters are being asked to decide between two visions of America: **One that builds on progress or one that takes us back, stripping away hard-won rights and protections.**

Now, more than ever before, this is the moment we need to rally together and make a choice for our democracy and for the good of every American. Extremists are ready to drag us backward, but we refuse to let them get away with advancing their dangerous agenda – _at least not without a fight._

Look, November 5 isn’t just about electing for-the-people Democrats at every level. It’s about protecting our democracy, enshrining a woman’s right to reproductive freedom, defending our environment and our seniors, ensuring every American has access to quality, affordable healthcare – **and so much more**. With so much on the line, we simply can’t afford to slow down, not until the very last ballot is counted.

| One week until Election Day. Folks, it’s finally here. After months of hard work, thousands of miles traveled, and hundreds of events we can see the finish line. We are running a true grassroots campaign all thanks to your generosity, time, and dedication. We wouldn’t be where we are at without your help.
---
| Together, we are fighting for a better future for our community and nation. To ensure that our message reaches every corner of our congressional district, we’ve launched our billboard campaign, are releasing TV ads, and have been running radio ads left and right.
---
| Our opponent doesn’t have what it takes to represent the people of the sixth congressional district. He is a proud Trump MAGA loyalist. My focus is revitalizing the economy, creating jobs, and ensuring fair wages and protecting workers. I support women’s right to choose, workers and their right to collectively bargain, increased funding for public schools, expanded and optimized broadband, equitable access to technology, and respect for personal privacy and healthcare choices. I am committed to transitioning to renewable energy, tackling climate change, and advocating for a diplomatic resolution to the Israeli-Palestinian conflict. My platform offers practical solutions and progressive leadership for a brighter future in Virginia’s vast, beautiful sixth congressional district.

Folks,
My family means the world to me.
In my mom and my sisters, I see the American dream.
My mom worked her whole life to provide for us. My sisters went to college and built successful lives in service to their own families and communities.
We started with next to nothing. No money. No connections. But we made it, because the American dream is still alive.
There’s no doubt that it’s become more difficult to pursue, though. After I left the Marines, I knew my service to our country wasn’t over. I’ve dedicated the last 20 years of my life to strengthening the American dream and delivering for people who need help.
But people like Kari Lake, like Donald Trump, they’re only out for themselves. They’ll attack anyone who doesn’t fall in line. They’ll stop at nothing in their pursuit of power and influence.

# Can you spare 1 hour to save democracy?

Hi ,
I’ll be blunt. I’ve been working on the ground in all the battleground states (currently training volunteers in Arizona) and I’m scared Trump is going to win. Very scared.

But, I also know there’s something we can do about it. It’s the reason I’m training people in person all day and by Zoom every night. **If we all leverage our own personal networks, we can stop Trump.** You can read about this in detail in [The Nation](https://cat-pac.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=04281a50285c536f7aa0f0006&id=2025df70e6&e=b4b662832c), as well as [podcasts](https://cat-pac.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=04281a50285c536f7aa0f0006&id=f5aa3171ce&e=b4b662832c) and [Substack](https://cat-pac.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=04281a50285c536f7aa0f0006&id=0dc423b6bb&e=b4b662832c), but here’s the very simple math:
There are **500,000 volunteers** making calls and knocking doors right now. If we all got on a Zoom tonight for just one hour and wrote down 50 voters each that we know, that would be **25 million voters** we could reach without a cold call. The election would be done. Unfortunately, 500,000 people haven’t done that. A few thousand people have. But we still have time. Today I’m sending up the bat signal, and asking _everyone I know_ to do one of 2 things:
1) _If you know at least 10 people in swing states (AZ, NV, WI, MI, PA, NC, GA)_ , [download the app](https://cat-pac.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=04281a50285c536f7aa0f0006&id=ec65ff7511&e=b4b662832c) Reach Progressive Organizing, join the Take Back the House campaign (key: **W6H4RT**), and come to my [virtual event**tonight at 8pm ET/5pm PT**](https://cat-pac.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=04281a50285c536f7aa0f0006&id=173f6b37e6&e=b4b662832c) (or tomorrow _if_ you can’t make it)

2) _If you DON’T know 10 people in swing states_ , I’m asking you to find at least 1 person you do know in a swing state and ask them to join you at [my event **tonight at 8pm ET/5pm ET**](https://cat-pac.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=04281a50285c536f7aa0f0006&id=2c806db81d&e=b4b662832c) (or tomorrow)
If everyone reading this right now can spare one hour, we have the votes to win this election.

Thank you,

Sri

body:
#

Peter -
When I first launched this campaign, it was almost impossible to look this far ahead, but here we are. **Seven days until the election.**
Listen. We’ve been through a great deal together since we kicked this off in January of 2023.
That you’ve had my back, followed this campaign, supported us through thick and thin... that 400,000 people from all walks of life have chipped in to get us here... to be honest with you, it’s _incredibly_ humbling to me.
You probably know my story by now. Those nights sleeping on the floor of our one bedroom apartment as a kid, I never thought I’d end up here.
I knew I would need to work hard to build a better life for myself, for my mom, for my sisters. I remember going to them with my plan — I told them I was going to go to Harvard. They listened. They heard me out. They knew it was a long shot, but they didn’t laugh.
They had my back. They helped me do it.
Now, I’m in one of the most hotly contested Senate elections in the country. Our Senate Majority hinges on us, and the hopes and dreams of millions of people depend on our success. And I know that I never would have made it this far if it was not for your support.
You’ve no doubt had a ton of other worthy causes and candidates come to you for your support, but you’ve chosen to stick with me until the end. So, I just wanted to thank you.
But with just seven days to go, we face long odds. Kari Lake’s slowly but surely gained on us over the last few weeks. She’s right on my heels in the polls. She’s got a larger warchest than we do in these final days, and she’s outspending us in one of the most important regions of the state.
I know you’ve done so much already, and I never thought I’d need to ask more of you. But to win this race, that’s what I have to do.

body:
10,000 Doors Knocked Across the District as Former President Bill Clinton Joins Dave Min and Key Leaders to Rally Support | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/aa9f8f71c585/dave-mins-gotv-weekend-rally-in-ca-47-brings-out-big-names-and-big-momentum-ahead-of-election-day-18229926?e=7017cc100e)
---
| |
---
| | **For immediate release:** October 29, 2024
**Contact:** press@davemin.com
**Dave Min’s GOTV Weekend Rally in CA-47 Brings Out Big Names and Big Momentum Ahead of Election Day** _10,000 Doors Knocked Across the District as Former President Bill Clinton Joins Dave Min and Key Leaders to Rally Support_
**IRVINE–** In a powerhouse weekend that saw 11,000 doors knocked and a packed rally with former President Bill Clinton, California State Senator Dave Min’s campaign showcased the massive momentum driving his bid to keep CA-47 blue. With just over a week until Election Day, Min’s campaign is heading into the final stretch with a coalition of supporters and volunteers that grows stronger each day, committed to upholding the district’s Democratic values.
---
|
---
| On Saturday, nearly 400 attendees gathered in Huntington Beach for a high-energy rally led by Min and Clinton, alongside U.S. Representatives Judy Chu, Marilyn Strickland, and Jill Tokuda, actor Ken Jeong, and California Democratic Party Chair Rusty Hicks. Min addressed recent acts of bigotry, including the defacing of his campaign signs with racist slurs and policies by the Huntington Beach City Council that target inclusivity. Local officials, including Huntington Beach Councilmembers Rhonda Bolton, Dan Kalmick, and Natalie Moser, along with Ocean View School Board Trustee Gina Clayton-Tarvin, attended in support of Min’s message. Following the rally, a massive district-wide canvassing push began, with volunteers reaching thousands of doors to discuss Min’s vision for CA-47. The rally followed a star-studded fundraiser Friday night in Laguna Niguel, where Clinton underscored the national importance of the CA-47 race and rallied the crowd around Min’s values of inclusivity, patriotism, and service to others. “This race is about more than just one district,” Min said. “It’s about ensuring that our values of inclusion, freedom, and service prevail.”
---
|
---
| The weekend continued Saturday afternoon with the DCCC-sponsored “AAPI Voters Matter” event at Min’s Irvine campaign office, which brought together Reps. Chu, Strickland, and Tokuda. Around 100 attendees joined for a panel discussion on AAPI representation in politics, followed by a buffet of AAPI treats and boba. The event showcased the diversity within the AAPI diaspora and the need for more representation in Congress. # [Muzzled media poses major threat to whistleblowers and truth](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=283449&post_id=150901872&utm_source=post-email-title&utm_campaign=email-post-title&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTUwOTAxODcyLCJpYXQiOjE3MzAyMjczMDIsImV4cCI6MTczMjgxOTMwMiwiaXNzIjoicHViLTI4MzQ0OSIsInN1YiI6InBvc3QtcmVhY3Rpb24ifQ.z4b3q6R_BIPUF3z8NsKCRVLmcMyFh3fXO7gI0lV3F7k)

Before I was outed as a whistleblower by Ron DeSantis -- on live television, no less -- I spent two weeks in a deep depression, not know how to move forward with the information I had.
The only answer I could see was the same answer whistleblowers had sought for generations: the press.
Mesoscale News with Rebekah Jones is a reader-supported publication. To receive new posts and support my work, consider becoming a free or paid subscriber.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..pG_OmwvHGiYstv-5YcYuVoj8BXYlwL0FvzSDeOirnSA?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=150901872)
Daniel Ellsberg took the Pentagon Papers to The New York Times initially, before they shut down the story under pressure from then-President Richard Nixon.
So he went to The Washington Post, and when Nixon threatened The Post, they decided to publish, anyway.
The face-off between The Post and Nixon stands as one of the most important moments in journalism history.
Had I been given the chance to chart my own path in my whistleblower journey, perhaps that's the route I would have taken.
Today, though, given the state of media, I'm not so sure.
The Washington Post, owned by billionaire Amazon founder Jeff Bezos, once seemed like a bright light in the darkness of American media.
Today, in the shadow of Bezos' egregious decision to control the paper's opinion column, Americans are looking at our media with renewed criticism.
Interference by billionaires in the papers they own extends far beyond the paper's editorials, though.
A [recent column ](https://substack.com/redirect/f2d5da0f-f67b-4cb4-8b10-149cecb5f031?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)by Whistleblower News Network, an off-shoot of the National Whistleblower Center, highlighted how dangerous the media landscape can become for whistleblowers if faith in the press continues to falter as it is now.
Whistleblowers change history.
I do not want to live in a society where the few brave enough to tell the truth have no one brave enough to print it.
And it's not paranoia to say the media are already holding back stories of critical import. News broke more than a week ago about a story pitched to dozens of news agencies regarding secret recordings taken of Trump -- a story [one reporter said ](https://substack.com/redirect/2d14dc6d-7d21-40c4-8e30-35588fefe028?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)would "end his campaign."
News agencies, intimidated and threatened with retribution, have continued to sit on the "campaign ending" story, a gross violation of the foundations of journalism.
Then there's the very public cases of lying in the media -- like the [fabricated story](https://substack.com/redirect/26fbb6da-db5d-4069-838a-42902f9e30a9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) about mass rape by Hamas published in The New York Times -- that erode public trust in media.
That case was severe enough to make me swear off the The New York Times for good.
If I were a whistleblower trying to find a path to share an important, history-changing truth, I'm not sure I'd trust the press right now to publish it.
And that puts all of us in grave danger.

Oct 29 | | | | | | | | | | | Before I was outed as a whistleblower by Ron DeSantis -- on live television, no less -- I spent two weeks in a deep depression, not know how to move forward with the information I had. The only answer I could see was the same answer whistleblowers had sought for generations: the press. Mesoscale News with Rebekah Jones is a reader-supported publication. To receive new posts and support my work, consider becoming a free or paid subscriber. Daniel Ellsberg took the Pentagon Papers to The New York Times initially, before they shut down the story under pressure from then-President Richard Nixon. So he went to The Washington Post, and when Nixon threatened The Post, they decided to publish, anyway. The face-off between The Post and Nixon stands as one of the most important moments in journalism history. Had I been given the chance to chart my own path in my whistleblower journey, perhaps that's the route I would have taken. Today, though, given the state of media, I'm not so sure. The Washington Post, owned by billionaire Amazon founder Jeff Bezos, once seemed like a bright light in the darkness of American media. Today, in the shadow of Bezos' egregious decision to control the paper's opinion column, Americans are looking at our media with renewed criticism. Interference by billionaires in the papers they own extends far beyond the paper's editorials, though. A Whistleblower News Network, an off-shoot of the National Whistleblower Center, highlighted how dangerous the media landscape can become for whistleblowers if faith in the press continues to falter as it is now. Whistleblowers change history. I do not want to live in a society where the few brave enough to tell the truth have no one brave enough to print it. And it's not paranoia to say the media are already holding back stories of critical import. News broke more than a week ago about a story pitched to dozens of news agencies regarding secret recordings taken of Trump -- a story "end his campaign." News agencies, intimidated and threatened with retribution, have continued to sit on the "campaign ending" story, a gross violation of the foundations of journalism. Then there's the very public cases of lying in the media -- like the about mass rape by Hamas published in The New York Times -- that erode public trust in media. That case was severe enough to make me swear off the The New York Times for good. If I were a whistleblower trying to find a path to share an important, history-changing truth, I'm not sure I'd trust the press right now to publish it. And that puts all of us in grave danger. Fellow patriot,

This is it. My race in New Mexico’s 2nd District is one of the most competitive in the entire country – a real battleground that could decide the House majority.

**The polls are TIGHT:** we’re within the margin of error! [**That means that every bit of momentum, every single dollar, and every single supporter matters more than ever.**](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=c59184f21aca431ab12db3b97fe9dd98&_e=xesI266mOrSymjSf4pzhWTwqB_dFG7dYPXXlX5dKfGmi8ru_sK2KVr4yYA1dQ0vCvjAIRtqiuFzSDJR2bGPBCT0btts9YnzZPy3dp_FBFRQYyeGiM-INaUNAf4jNJeYRJZk8hM21xsrlbWAmXWlSSd4oAoUP0Y0h7ckUpHRO7fybisa9C-n-m4ZC7fvdSkPQFokQQ9geLCH0Sfzb_q6GKAw6AOus4te9wQhYiy-DCIa8pbdEw-rL-pq_HrhhPTrY9oJz-7DoynQyG4ACQJ5oeHSy0Y_iMRRQpXckFR1yG23Kr7bJHQyuXTb6aDj-3aC7dmpcyhovQwf7uEFQDUKgUsUlYZ20bp1WATlBpnH6wlWDTm40DjfsozIj9n2U4mwfV-WZpBzZ9BPvpDyqapPGGw%3D%3D) With your help, we can surge ahead and send Gabe Vasquez packing.

New Mexico families deserve a representative who will defend our values, secure the border, and stand up against the radical left’s dangerous policies. **I’m committed to fighting for you in Washington – but I can’t do it alone.**

[**Our FINAL push before Election Day is underway, and I need every bit of support to close the gap.**](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=c59184f21aca431ab12db3b97fe9dd98&_e=xesI266mOrSymjSf4pzhWTwqB_dFG7dYPXXlX5dKfGmi8ru_sK2KVr4yYA1dQ0vCvjAIRtqiuFzSDJR2bGPBCT0btts9YnzZPy3dp_FBFRQYyeGiM-INaUNAf4jNJeYRJZk8hM21xsrlbWAmXWlSSd4oAoUP0Y0h7ckUpHRO7fybisa9C-n-m4ZC7fvdSkPQFokQQ9geLCH0Sfzb_q6GKAw6AOus4te9wQhYiy-DCIa8pbdEw-rL-pq_HrhhPTrYKErczOQsc-YX_XFASgcA_4idGlyTwDKXF5oVL1GPy63xicMbJTqE8HIO4w_1bGa2QxzTokh7c8KEwSNs3GRp_78fCZyK-6GMvbTeUG-r0bEge8Aiq6KK6xzlxs4S_riHnUlEggW_xdC_OhVctvfXNA%3D%3D) _This is basically our last chance to shift the outcome._

[**Please, will you step up right now and contribute? Whether it’s $10, $25, or even more – your support will bring us closer to the House majority and protect New Mexico’s future.**](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=c59184f21aca431ab12db3b97fe9dd98&_e=xesI266mOrSymjSf4pzhWTwqB_dFG7dYPXXlX5dKfGmi8ru_sK2KVr4yYA1dQ0vCvjAIRtqiuFzSDJR2bGPBCT0btts9YnzZPy3dp_FBFRQYyeGiM-INaUNAf4jNJeYRJZk8hM21xsrlbWAmXWlSSd4oAoUP0Y0h7ckUpHRO7fybisa9C-n-m4ZC7fvdSkPQFokQQ9geLCH0Sfzb_q6GKAw6AOus4te9wQhYiy-DCIa8pbdEw-rL-pq_HrhhPTrYCo8YN6FvKIV1bgkfKr3i0WmtWYwrtw8tu0WQUhjtu6KR5zmDytrKb6cPQE9wvrXu0VGIqKY6nXlVoCT4QE91CyiNkxB9Yo2Ooo3h8mgPGgmCp_PdRP9R8vAcrJNotujVIuKY-i89vUtzVzd70lnAwg%3D%3D)

name: No Dem Left Behind
subject: Across the Country: October 29nd, 2024
body:
MAGA's hate-filled rally at Madison Square Garden could swing battleground states.
| | | | | |
---
**_Across the Country_**
---
|
---
Hello, folks! Welcome back to Across the Country, our weekly series from No Dem Left Behind! I’m Sabrina Niazi, here with Daniela Rodriguez, to bring you the latest on key issues as we head into the final stretch before Election Day. This week, we’re taking a closer look at former President Donald Trump’s rally at Madison Square Garden—an event that starkly highlights the stakes in this election.
---
| | | | **Trump’s Madison Square Garden Rally Sparks Outrage — How Will It Impact the Election?**
---
|
---
The MAGA rally at Madison Square Garden saw Trump amplify his typical themes—but this time with even harsher rhetoric targeting immigrants, marginalized communities, and Democratic leaders. Through inflammatory language, Trump painted immigrants and political opponents alike as “threats to America,” a message that has alarmed people across the political spectrum. The rally wasn’t just divisive; it was openly hostile, with Trump allies on stage delivering racially charged remarks that outraged both Republicans and Democrats. One speaker, comedian Tony Hinchcliffe, sparked widespread backlash after calling Puerto Rico a “floating island of garbage”—a remark denounced as racist and condemned by leaders in both parties, especially in states like Florida, where Puerto Rican voters make up a critical demographic. Kamala Harris and her campaign team have responded swiftly, urging voters to recognize there’s a different path forward—one that values diversity, strengthens economic opportunities for all, and tackles pressing issues like inflation and housing costs without vilifying entire communities. Harris has doubled down on policies that prioritize unity and equity, emphasizing a future where all Americans can thrive. With only a week left until Election Day, the stakes in battleground states like Pennsylvania and Arizona could not be higher. Polling shows Trump and Harris running neck-and-neck, but recent trends reveal a shift: undecided voters are increasingly concerned about the divisive tone emerging from Trump’s campaign. Among these undecided voters, 60% say they’re seeking a leader who will address economic challenges without stoking division. Harris, with her message of inclusivity and practical solutions, is positioned to reach these voters by embodying unity and steady leadership. Trump’s rally highlighted the stark choice that voters face. His approach risks alienating communities, deepening divisions, and sowing further discord. Harris, on the other hand, is committed to addressing our nation’s biggest challenges—housing, inflation, healthcare—with integrity and respect for every American’s dignity. As we count down the final days, it’s vital to choose leaders who will unite rather than divide us. Now is the time to stay informed, get involved, and work toward a brighter, more inclusive future with No Dem Left Behind!
---
|
---
-Sabrina Niazi

I'm knocking on doors in at least 20 different counties and cities to help get out the vote before Election Day!
We all know that this is one of the most important elections of our lifetime. Not only is Wisconsin key to a victory for Kamala Harris this November, but we also have a great chance to flip both chambers of our state legislature.
If we take advantage of our new, fairer maps this November and win a majority, Governor Evers and I will be able to focus on passing our people-first agenda—not stopping Republican attempts to bully working-class Wisconsinites.
From Green Bay to Kenosha to Eau Claire, I'm talking to voters to help lead Wisconsin into a better future.

Lt. Gov. Sara Rodriguez, MSN, MPH, RN, was sworn in as Wisconsin’s 46th Lieutenant Governor on January 3, 2023. A working mom, wife, and proud Wisconsinite, Lt. Gov. Rodriguez was elected on November 8, 2022. Before her election, she served in the Wisconsin State Assembly, representing Assembly District 13, comprising a portion of Waukesha and Milwaukee Counties. While serving as a state representative, she worked on the Committees on Health, Insurance, Energy and Utilities, and Science, Technology and Broadband.

In this role, she provided strategic direction to the teams that managed population health interventions for risk-based contracts and direct-to-employer products.
Before running for office, Lt. Gov. Rodriguez built a career in public health and population health management. She held positions with public health departments at the local, state, and federal levels, including serving as an epidemic intelligence service officer with the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, the chronic disease director for the state of Colorado, a healthcare systems consultant, and a vice president at a Fortune 100 Company.

Before her election, she served in the Wisconsin State Assembly, representing Assembly District 13, comprising a portion of Waukesha and Milwaukee Counties. Rodriguez is an experienced healthcare executive who has worked in various leadership roles for over 20 years, including founding her own small business. Prior to serving in the Wisconsin State Assembly, Lt. Gov. Rodriguez was the vice president of Population Health and Integrated Care Management at one of the largest healthcare systems in the Midwest. In this role, she provided strategic direction to the teams that managed population health interventions for risk-based contracts and direct-to-employer products. Before running for office, Lt. Gov. Rodriguez built a career in public health and population health management. She held positions with public health departments at the local, state, and federal levels, including serving as an epidemic intelligence service officer with the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, the chronic disease director for the state of Colorado, a healthcare systems consultant, and a vice president at a Fortune 100 Company. | From the Desk of Dr. Ben Carson: Dear Fellow Patriot,

We are witnessing a brutal, unceasing, and deadly assault currently being waged against American families--especially the traditional nuclear family. I'm sure you've felt it.

That's why I launched the American Cornerstone Institute--what I call a "think tank / do tank" -- in order to continue this perilous fight to protect, shore up, and support American families. [](http://links.redconservatives.com/u/click?_t=66ce1250519441959ebe70cf27686494&_m=1741fcb3214a40a4aefd84aa2a8ade24&_e=Rn20A4ABUZfZN-Z-Uq2Ra8pqXvyC5QWP3i_0xaqXmoxPeg_6l8GlTziyJ5xT4HZ9OmQk9YRMSZSzE2Ii0hrZaKW4pRvIiWVK_A8L_eT8yuSAXeFDQB1oGlN3JCM33xk_eAQ1JTioEwvG5kjGrk1jfx4CaqktEh_yMwz5S7vFSB92HrImlnJOSxyQJketoAFnvhKqS0ReCfIloziSNj43y-F40yQgdX4yDbrx0fROMsn1lW_8q-_NT_OdN_GVDiw9iYNwsxYZveRqASIqqDB_cRepqMLwLTNzYUtoTIgBbTF-P2xys-Xo3vV3IFFd_uMyLjjD6o1vUl25braFcMNdXFpsCIGbR4k9fdXkDi3FmzVjWjk7q6xgyYbTbLNJUoiu_1RiMFjObeaKL8qSY2OVrw%3D%3D) Your gift of $100 or more to ACI today will help strengthen the bonds of our communities by lifting up the virtues of faith, liberty, community, and life.

Will you give today to support these cornerstone principles? They are essential to the success of our nation--principles that can be bolstered immeasurably and immediately by strengthening our families. To show my appreciation for your gift of $100 or more, you will receive an advanced signed copy of my new book "The Perilous Fight: Overcoming Our Culture's War on the American Family".

And to help pass down these important pillars to the next generation, I'lll also send you a free copy of my children's book "Why America Matters" that celebrates our great country and reminds us what a blessing it is to be an American.

body:
Control of the White House and the Senate will be decided by what we do in these final days.

|
---

| | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96093691/508883879/-1739130185?refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_EOM_241029_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4ZjZjYmU3Yy0yODk2LWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=_Yl2h1KQH4xRm051lzw2NVNepHVfu4T_-xpfrJQvkho=) Derek,

Election Day is one week from today, and a quick look at recent polls is all you need to see how close this race is going to be. New York Times: Harris 48 - Trump 48 CNN: Harris 48 - Trump 48 I’ve seen these kinds of races before — I’ve run in a couple of them myself. Control of the White House and the Senate will be decided by what we do in these final seven days. And we need your help.

[_**Rush a GOTV donation of $5 or more ahead of our end-of-month fundraising deadline so we can mobilize voters and keep the White House and the Senate >>**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96093692/508883881/-1739130185?amount=5&refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_EOM_241029_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4ZjZjYmU3Yy0yODk2LWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=_Yl2h1KQH4xRm051lzw2NVNepHVfu4T_-xpfrJQvkho=)

I know elections can be stressful when there is so much on the line and the races are this close. You may be wondering how you can help tip the scales – donating today is a great way to do it.

| | | Friend,

There is not much time left to save this country. I'm willing to sacrifice everything for it because if we lose, there will be nothing left.

**[Will you make a small sacrifice of JUST $10?](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=9532ef696ed24756ac3575ed856bfdec&_e=42K5zgbJUtHl7Z7h-lmtPhxyj2Ntx5_WgJkjXE1aWiiQrXsWozsnzq18DRrBSxhzKaSr8bOaf6QxpwZe-RCtk7v2zz4L_OutUbfqdN08-AnKELyxTL87mgIKEq1tvksjntdCY9dXe_yc2zk_yt-exqmJ7RxPa6qzKz85FobzXnVdbP1W4I8SX0hI6JiwbBd0tZhcJhkLIU4tZ2Oz2oMegCIyXSuuu3cmxH_1z62htscMPo9rbUBarWVs0TuRw-xgU8-96BViBnD4SI2i8c8XT-S-aWHh6Y_A4tOEvpO1zmg3k6cVDtiP8liofQhh8iyD6CSpFoZXco0ZDsA2B3i4S6neXHi-Qlma167lmR9jsB4lf_EbkfrGHe2MhLwvT9oAAx_L6I-o2b_N7zz7ug2gVaQktwrdHR4mxh9fjmZ_kw1LqqRSY9AezZE0z1tRItpg "Will you make a small sacrifice of JUST $10?")**

Running for Senate has been the hardest decision I've made in my entire life. I am just a normal mom. The disgusting things the media and establishment have done to me are unforgivable. If you had asked me a few years ago if I believed someone would come to my door and ask me to sell out my country for a pile of cash, I wouldn't have believed you.

**There 's so much I miss about my life before politics, and there's no shortage of sacrifices I've had to make. Much of them at the cost of my personal life. **

I gave up my career in the news media. I loved my job, but I refused to tell the lies that are now required of those working in mainstream media.

**I miss my family.** There's too little time to spend with my kiddos when I spend every day on the campaign trail. Thankfully, my husband, Jeff, is always by my side. However, I ran for Senate to protect my kids' future, and it hurts my heart that I can't see them as much as I'd like to.

**I miss waking up and enjoying just five minutes of sleep before my phone starts ringing.** Now I can't go a few hours without some fire drill needing to be put out.

**I miss not having to send these emails.** Finances have to be the worst part of running for Senate. Campaigning across Arizona costs more than I ever thought it would, but I'm committed to seeing this race through, even if it hurts my pride to ask you for help.

**I miss my alone time!** I never realized how much I took advantage of spending a few hours by myself. In this race, I'm often campaigning from dawn to dusk and, more often than not, early into the morning of the next day.

Friend, as much as I miss some of the comforts of day-to-day life, I know the sacrifices I'm making now will be worth it.

Now listen, there are less than two months before ballots start dropping in Arizona, and I need your help now more than ever. Recent polls show me tied to my opponent, Ruben Gallego, and every penny could push us over the edge and help secure victory.

Today, I'm asking you to make a sacrifice Friend. Will you stand with me and make a ONE TIME small-dollar contribution to my Senate campaign?

I’m willing to sacrifice everything for it because if we lose, there will be nothing left. | | | | | Friend, There is not much time left to save this country. I'm willing to sacrifice everything for it because if we lose, there will be nothing left. "Will you make a small sacrifice of JUST $10?" Running for Senate has been the hardest decision I've made in my entire life. I am just a normal mom. The disgusting things the media and establishment have done to me are unforgivable. If you had asked me a few years ago if I believed someone would come to my door and ask me to sell out my country for a pile of cash, I wouldn't have believed you. There 's so much I miss about my life before politics, and there's no shortage of sacrifices I've had to make. Much of them at the cost of my personal life. I gave up my career in the news media. I loved my job, but I refused to tell the lies that are now required of those working in mainstream media. I miss my family. There's too little time to spend with my kiddos when I spend every day on the campaign trail. Thankfully, my husband, Jeff, is always by my side. However, I ran for Senate to protect my kids' future, and it hurts my heart that I can't see them as much as I'd like to. I miss waking up and enjoying just five minutes of sleep before my phone starts ringing. Now I can't go a few hours without some fire drill needing to be put out. I miss not having to send these emails. Finances have to be the worst part of running for Senate. Campaigning across Arizona costs more than I ever thought it would, but I'm committed to seeing this race through, even if it hurts my pride to ask you for help. I miss my alone time! I never realized how much I took advantage of spending a few hours by myself. In this race, I'm often campaigning from dawn to dusk and, more often than not, early into the morning of the next day. Friend, as much as I miss some of the comforts of day-to-day life, I know the sacrifices I'm making now will be worth it. Now listen, there are less than two months before ballots start dropping in Arizona, and I need your help now more than ever. Recent polls show me tied to my opponent, Ruben Gallego, and every penny could push us over the edge and help secure victory. Today, I'm asking you to make a sacrifice Friend. Will you stand with me and make a ONE TIME small-dollar contribution to my Senate campaign? "My staff has shared these links with me, which you can click to donate. I wouldn't ask you if I wouldn't do the same thing in your shoes and if this race wasn't as important as it is. If we don't win in Arizona, we will lose America. Remember the fear, the chaos, and the corruption of his first term. _Now, remember the relief we all felt when we defeated him._ Let that memory fuel you, Peter. **We can win again, but not without your help. ## Sean Spicer Show Election Special...
We're planning something big for Election Night and I want you to mark your calendar now. I will be live 8 pm Eastern to midnight (maybe beyond depending on what happens) giving you my unfiltered take, real-time reactions, the data I'm checking AND bringing you into all the different appearances I'm doing on other shows.
Some details are still being worked out, but mark your calendar, subscribe to my YouTube and hit the notification button so you don't miss it.
[CLICK HERE](https://substack.com/redirect/174c9f12-9bca-4a10-8e52-c025aee3e606?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

## You're invited: Discuss the 2024 election with me and Dana Loesch this afternoon
This afternoon, I'll be joined by fellow Substacker [Dana Loesch](https://open.substack.com/users/7566638-dana-loesch?utm_source=mentions) for a **live conversation** at 4pm ET to discuss the 2024 election. You won't want to miss our discussion.

| [](https://substack.com/redirect/4083416f-f494-4ccd-b457-3dca8a090279?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

So this afternoon you'll get to watch Dana and me in live conversation and even send us questions to answer. To participate, **you 'll need to download the Substack app**, so go ahead and do that now so you'll be able to join the conversation. **This event is open for ALL subscribers.**
[ Join me in the app](https://substack.com/@seanspicer?liveStreamShare=true&liveStreamDate=2024-10-29T16:00:00-04:00&liveStreamGuest=Dana%20Loesch)

See you in the app,
Sean

name: Power the Polls
subject: Time to make a plan, Peter
body:
| 📋 Even poll workers need to make a plan to vote! _You’re receiving this email because you have expressed interest in the past about applying to be a poll worker in your community. Power the Polls is here to help connect people to their local elections offices. If you no longer wish to receive emails from Power the Polls,[_you can safely unsubscribe here_](https://act.powerthepolls.org/cms/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?akid=8793.934366.3lNL4K&t=1&akid=8793%2E934366%2E3lNL4K)._
# [](https://act.powerthepolls.org/go/42?t=2&akid=8793%2E934366%2E3lNL4K)
Dear Peter, Today is Vote Early Day, marking one week ‘til Election Day on November 5. **If you haven’t voted yet and you intend to, then _now_ is the time to make a plan – especially if you’re serving as a poll worker!** If you’re serving as a poll worker this year (or even if you’re not!), here’s what to know about casting your ballot between now and November 5:
1. Go to [**_voteearlyday.org_**](https://act.powerthepolls.org/go/4851?t=3&akid=8793%2E934366%2E3lNL4K) to find out about early voting options in your area.
2. If you plan to vote on Election Day (November 5), then [**_find your polling place_**](https://act.powerthepolls.org/go/4852?t=4&akid=8793%2E934366%2E3lNL4K). _Important: Your Election Day polling place may be different from your early voting location._
3. Figure out the date and time that you can get to the polls – and of course, be sure to thank your poll workers!

**Voting early is helpful for several reasons:** It helps you avoid any last-minute issues that could come up when voting on Election Day, including if you’re called to serve at the last minute, it often means shorter lines for you, and it helps poll workers manage voters more efficiently by keeping the flow of people steadier throughout the election season. So, what are you waiting for? [**_Learn about voting early in your state_**](https://act.powerthepolls.org/go/4851?t=5&akid=8793%2E934366%2E3lNL4K) or [**_find your Election Day polling place now_**](https://act.powerthepolls.org/go/4852?t=6&akid=8793%2E934366%2E3lNL4K). And remember to thank your poll workers! —The Power the Polls Team
---
* * *

[Click here to unsubscribe.](https://act.powerthepolls.org/cms/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?ak_proof=1&akid=8793.934366.3lNL4K&t=7&akid=8793%2E934366%2E3lNL4K) If you have any questions, please contact us at [info@powerthepolls.org](mailto:info@powerthepolls.org) and a member of our team will be in touch.

The comments made about Puerto Rico at Donald Trump's rally this weekend were NOT a joke. They were racist, insulting, and entirely unacceptable.

_**Ya no más.**_
Any person or party who espouses this kind of vile rhetoric against other humans — let alone citizens of the United States — is unfit to run the White House. **And anyone who would tie themselves so closely to a candidate who does, like Rick Scott, has no business in any position of power — especially in Florida.**

And what's more, friend, is that they know full well that what they're doing is wrong — and they're terrified of facing the consequences.
_How am I so sure?_ Well, when I went to vote on Sunday, I had the displeasure of running into Rick Scott myself, as he rallied Miami Republicans in a misguided attempt to try and intimidate me for social media clicks.
**As soon as he saw me there,****he sped off in his chauffeured getaway car.**
_Disappointing?_ Yes. _Surprising?_ Hardly. It's just who he, Donald Trump, and the GOP are: **b****igots, cowards, and losers.**
First, Rick took a note out of Trump's playbook when he refused to debate me. Then, he comes to my home district and doesn't even have the courage to face me, not to mention answer for his puppet master's despicable attitudes.
Now, he's panicking and desperately trying to placate Florida's large Puerto Rican population, whose votes he's courting to win and stay in power.****
