Friends,
We put out the call on Friday to help power our get out the vote and WOW - did you deliver!
We have one of the largest field programs in the COUNTRY right now. We knocked on over 18,000 doors this weekend alone - and called another 6,000 voters. We sent over 280,000 texts.
You did that.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/avlononeweek?refcode=1029 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/avlononeweek?refcode=1029]
We’re pushing even harder over the next seven days. We’re going to contact every voter in the district multiple times between now and Election Day. We even got three ads up during the World Series last night!
This is how a winning campaign closes. We’re running through the tape.
We can’t do this without you. Now is the time to double down. If you can make a contribution today, it will help us reach even more voters in this final week.
Please pitch in and let’s go win this >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/avlononeweek?refcode=1029]
Thank you for fighting the good fight with us,
-Team Avlon
Here's what we sent on Friday asking for your support, and you delivered:
We’re in the home stretch, folks. There's just one week until Election Day, and we need to make the most of every single day. The best way to do that? We’re out there talking to voters as you read this email. (OK, unless you’re a night owl...)
Your support matters now more than ever. So many of you have signed up to volunteer and help get the word out - but you can also support our efforts by pitching in down the stretch.
We aren’t pulling any Trumpy “8000x match shenanigans” - but here’s what your contributions from this email are going to go help us do:
$7 = 150 voters texted with a GOTV reminder [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/avlononeweek?refcode=1029&amount=7]

$150 = newspaper ads for John in the final two weeks [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/avlon-newsdaypoll?refcode=1029&amount=150]
$500 = one more TV ad to undecided voters [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/avlon-newsdaypoll?refcode=1029&amount=500]
Your contributions have fueled this campaign for months. And now, we need the support more than ever. For the next 17 days, we’re all about reaching voters, any way we can.
So if you’re able, chip in what you can to the campaign. As you can see, even small contributions go a long way. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/avlononeweek?refcode=1029]
As always, thank you for fighting the good fight with us. Now, let’s go win an election!
-Team Avlon

| |

| | | Friend,

There is not much time left to save this country. I'm willing to sacrifice everything for it because if we lose, there will be nothing left.

**[Will you make a small sacrifice of JUST $10?](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=c976a8b1535641e68b08bdb29a15ed1f&_e=Y2MqlG-3giRWVTD_sIlCm7iHIILIa6X2QV88q8gB-1p_oBlrR_DlPb6CyNTRATrBud67MJgDCrAMl07sS8ZZEdZ2I9AX2nAwTgaUYynJexn2SrRyYf6xf0ddFFYcMxjUYOKxtTPPRUAaaKfdvkmxthldcGWSxk5WY5Tuy9Rk6WV3ZbrX2OHb0gDnxK8eFYUXFFXS3_aBhIhShZjQTrxuEF_ThbrzxRLn5XC30SEDtOsogmbQon4dzT3bEzoyE3SaCdnPN8Kcj2vqO0vza28n19Fb-AzsD0J5pB9Q1ryA01AebiwgNeZkZ0sZ8swVzVchNTC4b3BxXnrAU9u4p81CYn5T2Q0o6NUv2pN883sCoe_Y0XhoKgOZL4a7fX6IIPDUAz2mnLrntNF3zTuRc1f2pIn27b6v1hGZooob5ciYvgGYooORrNewv0sKuDiPAYvd "Will you make a small sacrifice of JUST $10?")**

Running for Senate has been the hardest decision I've made in my entire life. I am just a normal mom. The disgusting things the media and establishment have done to me are unforgivable. If you had asked me a few years ago if I believed someone would come to my door and ask me to sell out my country for a pile of cash, I wouldn't have believed you.

**There 's so much I miss about my life before politics, and there's no shortage of sacrifices I've had to make. Much of them at the cost of my personal life. **

I gave up my career in the news media. I loved my job, but I refused to tell the lies that are now required of those working in mainstream media.

**I miss my family.** There's too little time to spend with my kiddos when I spend every day on the campaign trail. Thankfully, my husband, Jeff, is always by my side. However, I ran for Senate to protect my kids' future, and it hurts my heart that I can't see them as much as I'd like to.

**I miss waking up and enjoying just five minutes of sleep before my phone starts ringing.** Now I can't go a few hours without some fire drill needing to be put out.

**I miss not having to send these emails.** Finances have to be the worst part of running for Senate. Campaigning across Arizona costs more than I ever thought it would, but I'm committed to seeing this race through, even if it hurts my pride to ask you for help.

**I miss my alone time!** I never realized how much I took advantage of spending a few hours by myself. In this race, I'm often campaigning from dawn to dusk and, more often than not, early into the morning of the next day.

Friend, as much as I miss some of the comforts of day-to-day life, I know the sacrifices I'm making now will be worth it.

Now listen, there are less than two months before ballots start dropping in Arizona, and I need your help now more than ever. Recent polls show me tied to my opponent, Ruben Gallego, and every penny could push us over the edge and help secure victory.

Today, I'm asking you to make a sacrifice Friend. Will you stand with me and make a ONE TIME small-dollar contribution to my Senate campaign?

Running for Senate has been the hardest decision I've made in my entire life. I am just a normal mom. The disgusting things the media and establishment have done to me are unforgivable. If you had asked me a few years ago if I believed someone would come to my door and ask me to sell out my country for a pile of cash, I wouldn't have believed you. There 's so much I miss about my life before politics, and there's no shortage of sacrifices I've had to make. Much of them at the cost of my personal life. I gave up my career in the news media. I loved my job, but I refused to tell the lies that are now required of those working in mainstream media. I miss my family. There's too little time to spend with my kiddos when I spend every day on the campaign trail. Thankfully, my husband, Jeff, is always by my side. However, I ran for Senate to protect my kids' future, and it hurts my heart that I can't see them as much as I'd like to. I miss waking up and enjoying just five minutes of sleep before my phone starts ringing. Now I can't go a few hours without some fire drill needing to be put out. I miss not having to send these emails. Finances have to be the worst part of running for Senate. Campaigning across Arizona costs more than I ever thought it would, but I'm committed to seeing this race through, even if it hurts my pride to ask you for help. I miss my alone time! I never realized how much I took advantage of spending a few hours by myself. In this race, I'm often campaigning from dawn to dusk and, more often than not, early into the morning of the next day. Even after agreeing to the Electoral College, founder James Madison said the constitutional congress delegates were impaired by “ the hurrying influence produced by fatigue and impatience .”
Yes -- even the person who created it didn't like it and thought it was a cop-out.
We can't allow ourselves and our elections to be held back by this antiquated, backward system for even one more election. Pitch in $35 or more to help rid us of the Electoral College forever! >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-end-electoral-college?refcode=102924_4&amount=35]
Voter Action Project Logo [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-weekly?refcode=102924_4&amount=25]
New Yorker: The Case for Dumping the Electoral College [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-end-electoral-college?refcode=102924_4&amount=35]
The Electoral College has been described as “ a loaded pistol pointed at our system of government. ” They warned that it created “a game of Russian roulette” because the way it distorts the will of the people could threaten our democracy.
We've already seen the popular vote loser win the White House five times, including twice in the last twenty years .
And this obtuse system of choosing a national leader led directly to the former President -- one of those five who lost the popular vote (in 2016) but still won the office -- attempting to subvert the will of the people by twisting the Electoral College into a mess and when that didn't work, fomented a literal insurrection with supporters breaking into the Capitol Building to disrupt certification of the election. And now he's running again.
Opponents of voting rights have shown they'll bend these rules and go to any length in order to win. RUSH $35 or more to help us end the Electoral College once and for all >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-end-electoral-college?refcode=102924_4&amount=35]

We don’t have to wait for Congress to act, either. The National Popular Vote Interstate Compact (NPVIC) is an agreement among a group of U.S. states and the District of Columbia to award all their electoral votes to whichever presidential candidate wins the overall popular vote in the 50 states and the District of Columbia.
Minnesota joined last year, giving NPVIC 16 states plus DC, accounting for 206 electoral votes and 76% of the states needed to essentially make the popular vote the law of the land.

body:

| Peter, 7 days. That’s all we have left until the most important election of our lifetimes. While all of the focus is squarely on the presidential election, I am going to ask you to focus elsewhere: **control of the House of Representatives. ** Control of the House of Representatives should be the top priority for conservatives. Why? It’s actually quite simple. If Donald Trump is elected, like I believe he will be, but does not have a Republican majority in the House then his presidency won’t be successful. Think back to President Trump’s first term when Democrats controlled the House - endless political investigations and impeachment efforts. President Trump needs a Republican House majority to secure the border, extend the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, and restore American energy dominance. If the worse case scenario happens, it is absolutely critical that Republicans maintain control of the House of Representatives to keep Kamala Harris in check. We cannot allow Kamala Harris to have a Democrat House majority if she is elected president, because Democrats will bend to every one of her progressive demands. The fight for control of the House of Representatives could not be closer. We have commonsense conservative incumbents running tough races in some of the bluest areas of the country - California and New York. We also have quality candidates running to flip Democrat-held seats in places like Michigan and Virginia. This is where my focus is for the next 7 days. I am spending my time, energy, and campaign money to help Republicans hold and expand our majority in the House. [**If you’re able to help me out and donate to my campaign, that is exactly what your money will be used for: protecting our conservative House majority to give President Trump the kind of Congress he needs to get America back on track.**](https://ctrk.klclick2.com/l/01JBD1RPPXVBWZHEDDSWWCVQKA_1)

**[ELECT LUCAS: CHIP IN →](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/80999?refcode=em20241029-8285&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=8285%2E614464%2E8Mszox)**
What if I told you that just yesterday new polling showed that, thanks to the messages communicated through our TV ads, Lucas is in a STATISTICAL TIE with Josh Hawley for Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat?
Or what if I told you that Hawley’s campaign and Super PAC have already spent over $6 MILLION to tear Lucas down on TV? They’ll continue spending as much as they can, but if we have the resources to combat their attacks over the final days of this election, we can turn out the undecided voters we need to win.

body:
www.jayjones.com [www.jayjones.com]
Folks,
With just one week until Election Day, Republican Governor Glenn Youngkin and Attorney General Jason Miyares are not letting up on their fight to purge Virginia voter rolls.
Their attempts to deny eligible citizens their freedom to vote just days before an election are lawless and offend the very foundation upon which our democracy rests – and the courts have agreed.
As the son and grandson of civil rights leaders who gave everything they had to secure the right to vote, I am committed to protecting that fundamental freedom.
If you’re with me, can you add your name here to send a message that you’re committed to protecting voting rights? [https://secure.ngpvan.com/pVBC28iXiU25kumdbLRg6g2]
ADD YOUR NAME >> [https://secure.ngpvan.com/pVBC28iXiU25kumdbLRg6g2]
In August, Gov. Youngkin forced state election officials to engage in unlawful purges of the voter rolls — it’s a blatant case of voter suppression. American citizens were stripped of their rights – and some had no idea they’d been made ineligible to vote.
Thankfully, a federal court ruled this attempt to purge these “noncitizen voters” violated the National Voter Registration Act. But he hasn’t given up the fight – he’s taken it all the way to the Supreme Court.
Folks, let’s be clear: The only thing Gov. Youngkin’s voter purges do is make it harder for Americans to exercise their rights.
No matter which way the Supreme Court rules, we need to unite against efforts to restrict our fundamental rights. If you’re with me, show your support for voting rights using this link. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/pVBC28iXiU25kumdbLRg6g2]

subject: Asking you to read my new op-ed

body:
I hope you’ll take a few minutes to read my op-ed about the state of gun violence in our country
#

Hi friends, it’s Gabby Giffords. I’m reaching out today in the hope that you’ll take a few minutes to read an excerpt of my op-ed published in _Newsweek_ last week. With time running out before Election Day, I thought it important to write this piece about why we must elect Vice President Kamala Harris, a proven gun safety champion.
[**Keep scrolling to read my op-ed, and if you’re able, please consider using this link to make a contribution to GIFFORDS PAC. Your donation ahead of our final end-of-month fundraising deadline before Election Day would mean so much to me.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-oct24.iFm2sk&refcode=em2401029-2-30&t=1&akid=9325%2E3935704%2ENkQ3gL)
**[CONTRIBUTE](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-oct24.iFm2sk&refcode=em2401029-2-30&t=2&akid=9325%2E3935704%2ENkQ3gL)**
* * *
**[Trump Did Nothing on Gun Violence. Don't Let Him Do It Again**](https://go.giffords.org/go/58100?t=3&akid=9325%2E3935704%2ENkQ3gL)
By Gabby Giffords
Gun violence isn't some far-away problem that you hear about but won't experience yourself. It has infiltrated every corner of this country, spreading like a virus. Guns are the number one killer of American kids—77 percent of parents report being worried about guns at school. They are the reason we lose so many lives to suicide every year. Nearly everyone in this country will know a victim of gun violence in their lifetime.
Thirteen years ago, my own life was turned upside down by gun violence. I was meeting with constituents in the parking lot of a grocery store in Tucson, Arizona, when a gunman showed up to assassinate me. He shot me in the head, killed six people, and wounded 13 more.
So, I know just how brutal this crisis is. Trust me when I say the way we address gun violence—and our future as a country—depends on the outcome of this election.
...
We're at a turning point. We can move forward and save lives with Vice President Kamala Harris and Gov. Tim Walz leading the charge. Or we can dive backward into another Trump presidency, which will derail all the progress we've made.
And we know exactly what another Trump presidency would look like—you just have to listen to him. Trump has said that he was proud to do "nothing" on guns while in office, and has promised to undo every gun safety measure the Biden-Harris administration has put in place.
...
When she talks about the epidemic of gun violence in America, Harris will often say "it doesn't have to be this way." She's right—and she's the only person in this race who will do something about it.

Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee. www.Giffords.org

We try to send only the most important information and opportunities to participate via email, but click [here](https://go.giffords.org/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=4&akid=9325%2E3935704%2ENkQ3gL) if you'd like to unsubscribe. Giffords PAC was started to support elected officials who step up to fight the gun violence epidemic. Thank you for standing with Gabby and the Giffords team.

name: Elissa Slotkin
subject: Real urgency
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Scholten for Congress
body:
If we lose here in Michigan, Republicans will almost certainly take control of the U.S. Senate.

| Team —

If your inbox is anything like mine, you are bombarded with emails telling you that the sky is falling and all hope is lost.

You will never get that fake urgency from me.

On the flip side, I also will never sugarcoat things. There *are* real needs that we have right now if we’re going to win.

Real needs, because we are seeing our margin in public polls start to tighten, and our opponent is trumpeting that his campaign’s internal polls show a tied race.

Real needs, because if we lose here in Michigan, Republicans will almost certainly take control of the U.S. Senate.

Tina for Oregon [https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP12/1/92654/images/TinaForOregon-Logo-FullColor-white.png]
Hi Peter,

One quick ask before you fill out your ballot: Join me in voting for Dr. Elizabeth Steiner for Oregon Treasurer.

Elizabeth has spent her career trying to make Oregon the healthiest state in the nation. As a family physician, a mom of three, and one of Oregon’s chief budget writers, she’s seen firsthand how investing in preventive care, saving for education, and balancing a budget can make all the difference for hard-working families.

Her main opponent? He threatened state troopers after walking off the job in the legislature and has spent his career fighting to limit women’s reproductive rights. We can’t afford to let him win.

Elizabeth has been endorsed by trusted organizations like the Oregon Nurses Association, Planned Parenthood of Oregon PAC, the Oregon League of Conservation Voters, and many others.

Her experience, both as a physician and a state senator, has prepared her to steward the investments that fund our public employee retirement system and expand savings programs that can benefit every Oregon family.

Please vote for Dr. Elizabeth Steiner for State Treasurer.

Thank you!

Tina

name: Tamie Wilson
subject: One week to end Jim Jordan’s reign of terror.
body:
alt [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/100067/images/LOGO.jpg]
Friends,
Here we are – One week out from Election Day.
We’re here at the final stretch, on the cusp of victory, and it’s all thanks to you and every single supporter who’s stood with us.
When we started this movement, the pundits barely gave us a second glance — they didn’t think we had a chance.
But look at us now. We've forced Jim Jordan into a corner, scrambling to bring in Donald Trump himself to drum up votes.
Jordan’s running ads, plastering up billboards, and hosting campaign events for the first time in his 17 years in Congress.
If that doesn’t show he’s nervous, I don’t know what does.
And now, with one week left, this campaign has one focus: finishing strong.
Will you rush a contribution right now to help us keep our momentum through Election Day? Every dollar we raise powers the ads, volunteers, and conversations we need to reach every last voter. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20241029_one_week_link1]
We’ve made national headlines for a reason: ours is the most important congressional race in the country.
We've tied Jordan in the polls and built the best-structured, most well-financed campaign he’s ever faced.
Now, it's about building a vision for Ohio and this country where we’re done suffering under the ULTRA-MAGA agenda, and where real progress can take root.
Imagine a future where women belong in power, where every voice matters, and where communities aren’t torn apart by division and chaos but brought together by common goals.
This is a future where we defend reproductive freedom, pass no-tax-on-overtime legislation to uplift workers, and secure healthcare and affordable housing for every person and family.
Jordan’s terrified of this vision, and his panic shows that we're on the brink of making this future a reality.
But we can’t stop now.
The finishing line is in sight, and every moment and every contribution counts.
Let’s make history and build a future where our country stands as a beacon of progress, compassion, and justice.
We have seven days to push forward, and we’re ready to finish what we started. We are getting down to the wire on our big $3M fundraising goal, but we can hit it TODAY if even half the people reading this email gave $22 right now. Join the fight and help me send Jim Jordan packing for good. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20241029_one_week_link2]
Thank you for being part of our movement. Together, let’s make Election Day a victory for everyone who believes in a brighter tomorrow.
Working for US,
Tamie Wilson

subject: ¿Hablas Español? This is for you
body:
Bilingual speakers are needed to provide crucial resources to Spanish-speaking voters. | | | | |
---
| | | | | Demócratas,
With just ONE WEEK until Election Day, our Latino community's voice has never been more powerful. Right now, thousands of families across California are making their plan to vote – but only 10% of Latinos in California have returned their ballot.
**We need your help to reach even more of voters**. Many of our battleground districts have large Latino populations who speak English, Spanish, or both. The Central Valley, in particular, has several majority-Latino districts where your outreach could be crucial.
¡Necesitamos voluntarios como tú! Will you join us in these final days to help turn out the Latino vote?
CADEM

Every spring, I spend a lot of weeks working the stubble, getting equipment ready for planting, and out in the field seeding. Come summer, I am out there harvesting. I maintain my own heavy equipment and deliver my grain in a truck that’s a bit bigger than what any of my colleagues drive.
I buy grease by the case and seeds by the ton. I butcher my own beef. My wife, Sharla, and I work the farm hand-in-hand.

## Just SEVEN Days Left To Defeat Mary Peltola's Lies!

Dear Friend,

We’re just a week away from flipping this seat and making sure Alaska finally has a voice in Washington that’ll fight for **us** , not for Rep. Peltola's leftist DC handlers. The latest polls show we’re in the lead, and that’s thanks to supporters like you who believe in a stronger future for Alaska.

And let me tell you, our opponent is panicking. She’s watching our momentum, and she knows what’s coming. Instead of focusing on the issues, she’s doing everything she can to sling mud, twist the facts, and throw every exaggerated attack she can think of at us.

**Her attacks are vile -- and worse, they are flat-out lies and distortions.

You know it.

I know it.

She knows it.

[Even the PRESS knows it!](https://alaskansfornickbegich.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8aeb8c45837a089b0eee9add8&id=b31a5c4282&e=6679001ba0)**

But she'll keep on attacking me with the same debunked lies, right up to the end of the race. It's the same old Washington playbook: throw out lies and hope something sticks.

But here’s the truth: that approach only works if we’re silent – and I have no intention of backing down. But to stay on the offense and make sure Alaskans know the truth, we need every bit of firepower we can get. And that means we need you, now more than ever, standing with us to bring this home.

**[Your contribution](https://alaskansfornickbegich.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8aeb8c45837a089b0eee9add8&id=e13e433877&e=6679001ba0) today is what makes the difference.** With just a week left, every dollar you pitch in will go straight to countering these attacks and making sure our message reaches every Alaskan who deserves a real voice. **Whether it’s $25, $50, or even $100 – every bit helps us keep pushing to the finish line.**

We’re close – **so close**. We can't let up now. Together, we can take this all the way and make a real difference for Alaska. [Chip in](https://alaskansfornickbegich.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8aeb8c45837a089b0eee9add8&id=d2c68bf953&e=6679001ba0) whatever you can today and let’s finish strong.

If we’re going to win this, we need [your financial support](https://alaskansfornickbegich.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8aeb8c45837a089b0eee9add8&id=a4f9281ec8&e=6679001ba0) to push back against Peltola’s smear campaign and get our message out there. **Your support has made the difference so far, and now is not the time to slow down; it's time to keep fighting back**.

Thanks for all that you do – it’s because of supporters like you that we’re about to make history.

Thank you for standing with me.

Nick Begich
Candidate for U.S. Congress
\---

P.S. If you haven't voted yet, we need your voice! Visit [elections.alaska.gov](https://alaskansfornickbegich.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8aeb8c45837a089b0eee9add8&id=f1acdbbba8&e=6679001ba0) to find out where you can vote early, or on Election Day!

This is a huge development in our race.
Peter, I have a big favor to ask:
[**If just 5% of folks reading this email chipped in $5, we would hit our $3 million goal in no time. Can I count on you to step up with a split donation of $5 to my campaign and Bob Casey's today to ensure my team and I have the resources we need to push back against the $40 million worth of attack ads Ted Cruz and his allies are running against us right now?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20241029-5?refcode=em20241029-5&refcode2=4715_552475_MwPBE_&akid=4715%2E552475%2EMwPBE_)

Peter,

In just one week, Upper and Northern Michiganders will be heading to the voting booths to elect their vision for MI-01. This is our chance to elect a representative who shows up, listens, and fights for the real issues we face every day.

Jack Bergman has failed our district time and time again.

**❌ ****He voted against reauthorizing the Violence Against Women Act** , refusing essential support for victims of domestic violence.

**❌ ****He voted to overturn the 2020 election** , aligning himself with extremists who threatened our democracy. We need a leader who respects the will of the people–not one who undermines it.

**❌ ****Bergman has voted AGAINST much-needed infrastructure funding** , _even as he was a top spender in a tax-payer-funded program for his own food and lodging expenses._

**❌ **And when it comes to protecting the dignity and support our seniors and veterans need, **Bergman has failed to advocate for Social Security and Medicar** e, two pillars of security that so many Northern and Upper Michiganders rely on.

name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: Slim margins in Texas and Florida
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
Colin Allred has a very real chance to defeat Ted Cruz, and Debbie Mucarsel-Powell is trailing Rick Scott by just 3 points.

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2394%2E4032634%2ED5NvNI)
---
Update, the U.S. Senate race in Texas is within the margin of error right now — and Rep. Colin Allred has a very real chance to defeat Ted Cruz and flip a Senate seat blue. And in Florida, Democratic challenger Rep. Debbie Mucarsel-Powell is trailing her Republican opponent Rick Scott by just three points in another key pickup opportunity. That’s right: Democrats are competing in Texas and Florida, and grassroots supporters like you are rushing more resources to help power these campaigns to victory during the final sprint to Election Day. **If we can win in Texas and Florida, we’ll almost certainly maintain our Senate majority.** [**If you can, please chip in a contribution right now to send support to Rep. Allred in Texas, Rep. Mucarsel-Powell in Florida, and our re-election campaign. We’ve got to do everything we possibly can to keep our Senate majority — and that means sending resources in flippable states.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2794?t=8&akid=2394%2E4032634%2ED5NvNI)

Both Colin Allred and Debbie Mucarsel-Powell have run terrific campaigns in Texas and Florida — campaigns that are about centering working people and defending our freedoms. Rep. Mucarsel-Powell came to the U.S. from South America at a young age with her mom and sisters, fleeing violence and searching for a better life. She worked her way through college and has focused her career on expanding access to health care in Florida. Since being elected to Congress, Debbie has written a bill to expand seniors’ Medicare Advantage coverage, worked across the aisle to provide economic relief to families and small businesses, and secured funding for Everglades restoration. Rep. Allred is a fourth-generation Texan raised by a single mom. In 2018, Rep. Allred defeated a 22-year Republican incumbent to win his seat in the U.S. House, and he has spent his time in Congress working with both parties to deliver real solutions — lowering prescription drug prices, keeping jobs in Texas, establishing a new veterans medical center, and much more. While Democrats fight to defend Senate incumbents, part of our strategy to defend our majority _also_ involves flipping states like Texas and Florida. We’ve got to fight and invest in these states so that working people get the representation they deserve in our government. Sending Colin and Debbie to the Senate is within reach — we’ve got to fight hard for this. [**Any contribution you can make right now will boost these critical campaigns in the final stretch. If you’re able, split a donation between Colin Allred, Debbie Mucarsel-Powell, and our re-election to help hold our Senate majority and elect champions for working people across the country.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2794?t=14&akid=2394%2E4032634%2ED5NvNI) Thanks for being a part of this, Elizabeth

| | | Friend,

There is not much time left to save this country. I'm willing to sacrifice everything for it because if we lose, there will be nothing left.

**[Will you make a small sacrifice of JUST $10?](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=246167b579ca432ab48f4c9a7fb32a4e&_e=E0OURFqTe0uwtDEZDQ8v9bctXkVlp7uUf1tNEoKryfsRlpJPRuH_poxXOwoh-W_lzl9YdEItqFAROP0PEQ5AwZnOHNcFOrXcfeWGFio5iWO0Ff2944ocmQaunrL51-5RJ-LOY0H9UUsCb6KTrhL6e3c-e3ZHU4fJQQox2dNz3JRJHqgQ-1VMMhFZ5gE4XSY5ulA4DDQ4-XqYC0gPEUyGDib1e4CVBYtoq1OirChSSpBuz5t8aXh0h1_KPyeFJiFM7xU4VGl6vt4MkvSNG5FtO7hjMnvJMaIWlrkRnaqFrXTlt18W8jSydJ56XOGrbLwmKfNux8uufZ4zT0MWQnQ7MhcWweuCd1Umpp_lu3omFLbn5A0To_Td36TiAXrYTLO9n7ye7fiI2jzzYkoZplZiDfEwf3f3PHP7K8OsGax0tmFPSp_5fftC7oJ4w2XXgGR3 "Will you make a small sacrifice of JUST $10?")**

Running for Senate has been the hardest decision I've made in my entire life. I am just a normal mom. The disgusting things the media and establishment have done to me are unforgivable. If you had asked me a few years ago if I believed someone would come to my door and ask me to sell out my country for a pile of cash, I wouldn't have believed you.

**There 's so much I miss about my life before politics, and there's no shortage of sacrifices I've had to make. Much of them at the cost of my personal life. **

I gave up my career in the news media. I loved my job, but I refused to tell the lies that are now required of those working in mainstream media.

**I miss my family.** There's too little time to spend with my kiddos when I spend every day on the campaign trail. Thankfully, my husband, Jeff, is always by my side. However, I ran for Senate to protect my kids' future, and it hurts my heart that I can't see them as much as I'd like to.

**I miss waking up and enjoying just five minutes of sleep before my phone starts ringing.** Now I can't go a few hours without some fire drill needing to be put out.

**I miss not having to send these emails.** Finances have to be the worst part of running for Senate. Campaigning across Arizona costs more than I ever thought it would, but I'm committed to seeing this race through, even if it hurts my pride to ask you for help.

**I miss my alone time!** I never realized how much I took advantage of spending a few hours by myself. In this race, I'm often campaigning from dawn to dusk and, more often than not, early into the morning of the next day.

Friend, as much as I miss some of the comforts of day-to-day life, I know the sacrifices I'm making now will be worth it.

Now listen, there are less than two months before ballots start dropping in Arizona, and I need your help now more than ever. Recent polls show me tied to my opponent, Ruben Gallego, and every penny could push us over the edge and help secure victory.

Today, I'm asking you to make a sacrifice Friend. Will you stand with me and make a ONE TIME small-dollar contribution to my Senate campaign?

I’m willing to sacrifice everything for it because if we lose, there will be nothing left. | | | | | Friend, There is not much time left to save this country. I'm willing to sacrifice everything for it because if we lose, there will be nothing left. "Will you make a small sacrifice of JUST $10?" Running for Senate has been the hardest decision I've made in my entire life. I am just a normal mom. The disgusting things the media and establishment have done to me are unforgivable. If you had asked me a few years ago if I believed someone would come to my door and ask me to sell out my country for a pile of cash, I wouldn't have believed you. There 's so much I miss about my life before politics, and there's no shortage of sacrifices I've had to make. Much of them at the cost of my personal life. I gave up my career in the news media. I loved my job, but I refused to tell the lies that are now required of those working in mainstream media. I miss my family. There's too little time to spend with my kiddos when I spend every day on the campaign trail. Thankfully, my husband, Jeff, is always by my side. However, I ran for Senate to protect my kids' future, and it hurts my heart that I can't see them as much as I'd like to. I miss waking up and enjoying just five minutes of sleep before my phone starts ringing. Now I can't go a few hours without some fire drill needing to be put out. I miss not having to send these emails. Finances have to be the worst part of running for Senate. Campaigning across Arizona costs more than I ever thought it would, but I'm committed to seeing this race through, even if it hurts my pride to ask you for help. I miss my alone time! I never realized how much I took advantage of spending a few hours by myself. In this race, I'm often campaigning from dawn to dusk and, more often than not, early into the morning of the next day. Friend, as much as I miss some of the comforts of day-to-day life, I know the sacrifices I'm making now will be worth it. Now listen, there are less than two months before ballots start dropping in Arizona, and I need your help now more than ever. Recent polls show me tied to my opponent, Ruben Gallego, and every penny could push us over the edge and help secure victory. Today, I'm asking you to make a sacrifice Friend. body:
One week to go. We've got 6 seats in play here in CA -- enough to win back the House. But we're at the point where funds are low and we have to make some really tough spending decisions on our paid GOTV program. Right now, I'm reaching out with the hope that some of my friends can help us pull together enough to close the gap. Here is the link if you can help: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tbthzoe2024 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tbthzoe2024]

Anything you can do will be immediately spent to get the vote out in our red2blue House races.

I know we are all anxious for this election to be over. I am more and more cautiously optimistic that Kamala will win if we all do what we need to do. But we know she needs a Democratic House to get her agenda passed. A House run by Mike Johnson, Jim Jordan, Marjorie Taylor Greene, etc will be a nightmare for her... and for us. I hope you'll lend whatever support you can to help us in this final push.

We've got this if we keep pulling together in the same direction.
Zoe

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

clean_body: Our financial situation is dire right now, and we need your help to illuminate the pathway to victory for our Republicans in neck-and-neck races. | Fellow American, Our pathway to victory runs through eight critical states, and troublingly, our Republican candidates are falling behind at the wrong time in neck-and-neck races. Even more troubling, Democrats are shattering fundraising records every day. Kamala Harris has already sent $50 million to Senate Democrats, and more is coming soon. Some of our best candidates, Tim Sheehy, Eric Hovde, Bernie Moreno, Sam Brown, Mike Rogers, Larry Hogan, Dave McCormick, and Kari Lake, are at risk of losing because of this last-minute flood of Democrat cash. Most of these candidates in races we can’t afford to lose are behind by margins of 2, 3, or even 4 dollars to 1. Even the most well-executed, expertly staffed, and passionately supported campaigns can only overcome dangerous financial deficits like these with support. We know the pathway to victory, and now it’s up to us to step up with the support our Republican candidates need to win these close races. With less than a week left until Election Day, our candidates need to be able to fund advertisements, grassroots events, door-knocking days, and letter-writing campaigns to propel themselves over the finish line. Our pathway to victory will only materialize if we send them an urgent financial lifeline. Thank you Steve Daines Steve Daines is a fifth-generation Montanan, life-long sportsman and father of four serving the people of Montana as their Senator. Steve is committed to always putting Montana first as he works to bring real change to Washington and fights for more jobs, less government and common sense solutions to get our country back on track. Senator Steve Daines | | Paid for by Steve Daines for Montana

name: Wes Moore
subject: We need Sarah Elfreth in Congress
body:
Friend,

Dawn and I just cast our ballots and I was proud to vote for Sarah Elfreth!

Sarah is a bold, committed leader with whom I’ve had the privilege to work during her time in the State Senate — and I know she is the best choice to represent Maryland’s 3rd Congressional District.

Sarah has a proven record for leading on the issues that matter most to everyday Marylanders. As a state legislator, she:

→ Voted to expand access to reproductive healthcare and co-sponsored a constitutional amendment to enshrine reproductive freedom as a fundamental right in Maryland’s State Constitution,
→ Passed legislation to combat the epidemic of gun violence in our communities,
→ Fought to expand access to affordable childcare and passed a law to expand broadband access to Maryland households and small businesses, and
→ Helped lead the fight for historic investments in Maryland schools through the Blueprint for Maryland’s Future.

Right now, we’re in the final sprint before Election Day, and I need your help to ensure Sarah has the resources to win and elect Democrats up and down the ballot this November. Will you join me in supporting Sarah Elfreth’s campaign by contributing toward her campaign today? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-20241029-1?refcode=em20241029-1]

Elevate,

Wes Moore
Governor of Maryland

Sixteen years ago, I completed my final treatment for breast cancer.

Surviving breast cancer made me realize I couldn’t put off the things I was passionate about, and it made me reevaluate the impact that I could make on the world with whatever time I was privileged enough to have.

At that time, the city of Glendale hadn't had a woman on its council in over a decade, and had elected less than ten women in its almost hundred-year history. Glendale had a conservative council, unwilling to stop the Glendale gun show from operating on city property, and uninterested in making environmental sustainability a priority.

**So I decided to do something about it. I ran for city council.**

What started as just me and a handful of women -- stuffing envelopes and walking precincts -- turned into one of the largest grassroots campaigns we'd seen in years. The morning after election day, I was the top vote-getter despite running against three incumbents.

Here’s the truth: I've never considered myself a politician.

This has always been about bringing people together to address the very real issues we all face, and that won't change when I’m in Congress.

I'll continue to advocate _for us._ We need solutions to issues like affordable housing and the cost of living. Our government needs to treat health care like a human right accessible to all. And we need to tackle the climate crisis with the urgency it deserves.

But if we’re going to pass our biggest test yet, it’s going to take overwhelming grassroots support.

| [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/96108754/508936518/1328794144?refcode=ea.c7c892b6-4c96-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&ms=ea.c7c892b6-4c96-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImM3Yzg5MmI2LTRjOTYtZWYxMS04OGNlLTAwMGQzYTk4ZmE2YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=yeVqjHPBZTOxiWvnlej9rhf0WNvHuT1DiJjGqKPnHtg=&emci=c5c892b6-4c96-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&emdi=c7c892b6-4c96-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&ceid=4823105)

[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/96108755/508936520/-1179469662?refcode=ea.c7c892b6-4c96-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&ms=ea.c7c892b6-4c96-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImM3Yzg5MmI2LTRjOTYtZWYxMS04OGNlLTAwMGQzYTk4ZmE2YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=yeVqjHPBZTOxiWvnlej9rhf0WNvHuT1DiJjGqKPnHtg=) We’re **_7 days out_** from Election Day, and we have no time to waste. As we close in on the most critical election of our lifetimes for climate action, I want to spotlight two remarkable JanePAC-endorsed candidates who need us in their corner: **Rep. Maxwell Frost,** running for re-election in Florida’s 10th Congressional District, and **Debbie Mucarsel-Powell,** who’s running for U.S. Senate in Florida! These powerhouse candidates are running to bring real climate leadership to Florida and beyond — but they need your help in this final stretch. **[Can you split a $20 donation between my climate champions of the week to ensure they have what they need to win one week from today?](https://click.everyaction.com/k/96108756/508936521/-1179469662?amount=20&refcode=ea.c7c892b6-4c96-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&ms=ea.c7c892b6-4c96-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImM3Yzg5MmI2LTRjOTYtZWYxMS04OGNlLTAwMGQzYTk4ZmE2YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=yeVqjHPBZTOxiWvnlej9rhf0WNvHuT1DiJjGqKPnHtg=)** Florida is on the front lines of the climate crisis. The state is uniquely vulnerable to extreme weather — yet over and over again, its leaders dismiss the role of climate change. Earlier this year, Governor Ron DeSantis signed a bill removing climate change from state energy policy, calling it a “radical” agenda. And while record-breaking heat waves and hurricanes pummel the state, he openly mocks the science behind climate impacts. **It’s clear Florida needs leaders who take the climate crisis seriously.** [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/96108757/508936523/-1179469662?refcode=ea.c7c892b6-4c96-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&ms=ea.c7c892b6-4c96-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImM3Yzg5MmI2LTRjOTYtZWYxMS04OGNlLTAwMGQzYTk4ZmE2YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=yeVqjHPBZTOxiWvnlej9rhf0WNvHuT1DiJjGqKPnHtg=) 🌍 **Maxwell Frost** is the first Gen Z and Afro-Cuban member of Congress, and he’s already shaking things up! Since being elected, Max has secured over $200 million for environmental protection and fought to deliver critical FEMA funding after Hurricane Irma. He is exactly the kind of bold, relentless leader we need to tackle the climate crisis — especially in Florida, where climate action can’t wait.
* * *

clean_body: We have a chance to make history in the Sunshine State. | = We’re 7 days out from Election Day, and we have no time to waste. As we close in on the most critical election of our lifetimes for climate action, I want to spotlight two remarkable JanePAC-endorsed candidates who need us in their corner: Rep. Maxwell Frost, running for re-election in Florida’s 10th Congressional District, and Debbie Mucarsel-Powell, who’s running for U.S. Senate in Florida! These powerhouse candidates are running to bring real climate leadership to Florida and beyond — but they need your help in this final stretch. = Florida is on the front lines of the climate crisis. The state is uniquely vulnerable to extreme weather — yet over and over again, its leaders dismiss the role of climate change. Earlier this year, Governor Ron DeSantis signed a bill removing climate change from state energy policy, calling it a “radical” agenda. And while record-breaking heat waves and hurricanes pummel the state, he openly mocks the science behind climate impacts. It’s clear Florida needs leaders who take the climate crisis seriously. = 🌍 Maxwell Frost is the first Gen Z and Afro-Cuban member of Congress, and he’s already shaking things up! Since being elected, Max has secured over $200 million for environmental protection and fought to deliver critical FEMA funding after Hurricane Irma. He is exactly the kind of bold, relentless leader we need to tackle the climate crisis — especially in Florida, where climate action can’t wait. = 🌍 Debbie Mucarsel-Powell is running to unseat far-right Senator Rick Scott, one of the nation’s most vocal climate deniers. She’s no stranger to the climate fight — Debbie’s record includes bringing in over $200 million to protect Florida’s beloved Everglades and critical natural resources. Her priority? Clean water, sustainable infrastructure, and climate resilience for every Floridian. Debbie’s win would flip Florida blue, all but ensure we hold onto the Senate majority, and bring another pro-climate voice to Washington. [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/96108893/508936895/-353492916?refcode=BLU_EM_FFP_2024-10-29_2&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNS8xLzc3NDA2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjJhNjFmNTA1LTRkOTYtZWYxMS04OGNlLTAwMGQzYTk4ZmE2YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=Q8q_n9rPE5O_Mq2IzPyiZW9ZDIHDk6KCaetCdqqdbUI=)
If not, no worries. Rachel and I covered a lot, so let me break it down for you. Here's the good news and the bad news:

The **bad news** is after national Republicans outspent us 3-to-1 to attack me on the airwaves, recent polling from Morning Consult showed me 1 point behind my MAGA opponent.

body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

The last day to vote in the 2024 general election is one week from today
on Tuesday, November 5th. While it’s unclear who will win the critical
presidential election or gain majority control of Congress, one thing is
for sure: AIPAC had a massive influence on this election cycle.

While AIPAC has been around for decades, they only started contributing
directly to political candidates in the 2022 midterms — now, the
right-wing megadonor-funded group is one of the largest outside spenders
in our elections.

The Intercept published a new report revealing just how much the
anti-Palestinian lobby group has impacted political races in the United
States this year. Here are the major takeaways:

* AIPAC spent in more than 80% of all congressional races, seeking to
influence 363 seats in the House and 26 in the Senate, leaving very
few races untouched by their right-wing money.

* The group supported more Republicans than Democrats, but spent more
money supporting conservative, so-called Democratic candidates who
challenged and unseated progressive Squad members Jamaal Bowman and
Cori Bush in the two most expensive House primaries in history.

* After every single one of its wins this cycle, AIPAC tweeted, “Being
pro-Israel is good policy and good politics!” While it won most of its
races, 57 of AIPAC’s candidates had no primary and 88 had no opponent.

While AIPAC has been around for decades, they only started contributing directly to political candidates in the 2022 midterms — now, the right-wing megadonor-funded group is one of the largest outside spenders in our elections. The Intercept published a new report revealing just how much the anti-Palestinian lobby group has impacted political races in the United States this year. Here are the major takeaways: AIPAC spent in more than 80% of all congressional races, seeking to influence 363 seats in the House and 26 in the Senate, leaving very few races untouched by their right-wing money. The group supported more Republicans than Democrats, but spent more money supporting conservative, so-called Democratic candidates who challenged and unseated progressive Squad members Jamaal Bowman and Cori Bush in the two most expensive House primaries in history. * After every single one of its wins this cycle, AIPAC tweeted, “Being pro-Israel is good policy and good politics!” While it won most of its races, 57 of AIPAC’s candidates had no primary and 88 had no opponent. [ ]With just one week until the end of the 2024 election cycle, will you rush a grassroots contribution of ANY amount to fuel Justice Democrats’ work to recruit new progressive leaders and reject AIPAC? [ ]Contribute $5 In solidarity, Justice Democrats Contribute to Justice Democrats:

| | Happy Tuesday Evening! Welcome back to another edition of our weekly Kean for Congress newsletter update! There is only one update left next week before Election Day...thanks for sticking with me each week! Election Day is only __**ONE**_******_WEEK_**_ away! I can't believe where the time has gone, and we are almost over the finish line. Thank you again for all the hard work you have put in for the team. The state of the race looks promising, and the Kean for Congress team feels positive about the outcome of next week's results. But we can't let up just yet. Let's leave everything we have on the field this week. No days off until the results are in! Over 115,000 voters across NJ-07 have already cast their vote - nearly 18% of all registered voters in the District! We have made incredible progress since my last update and are putting points on the board ahead of Election Day. I'll share more on this below. Please consider volunteering to phone bank, knock doors, or sign blitz in these last seven days so we can maintain our momentum, and run up the score even more. This past week, Tom and our campaign team were operating on full throttle. Tom spent time at events in all six counties, knocked on doors, and raised the resources needed to keep our closing message on air. He and Rhonda [cast their votes early](https://link.tomkean.com/u/click?_t=9b7a451def6d4254858fc869cf07cd48&_m=73d02a5f0abe479e9a5e81d70b0f9ba9&_e=2REdCH156goMCZspsDZ1STx59jEsv37QS37Piyqh7NxRTS1zyKBk7jh2GAK5Rb-Hd_QRp41nySnktdpNlzC401kXYHpO4uoHhPySnSb2sa9rhBJP1xtaM-7Psn-PedeURLypURBtgb68zmG0p-srQh2cm8fkZGlD6El7rk05RVaCEb057dSWmxIeA6Z1d5iTvES-GjkdPel72ahgzQspjqEe1fuAEuL4wTs4T0cvx6HnC8SVjqREaQQq_4EWuVy9) on Sunday in Rahway! clean_body: Updates from our week in the field| | | | | Friend, | | Happy Tuesday Evening! Welcome back to another edition of our weekly Kean for Congress newsletter update! There is only one update left next week before Election Day...thanks for sticking with me each week! Election Day is only ONE****WEEK away! I can't believe where the time has gone, and we are almost over the finish line. Thank you again for all the hard work you have put in for the team. The state of the race looks promising, and the Kean for Congress team feels positive about the outcome of next week's results. But we can't let up just yet. Let's leave everything we have on the field this week. No days off until the results are in! Over 115,000 voters across NJ-07 have already cast their vote - nearly 18% of all registered voters in the District! We have made incredible progress since my last update and are putting points on the board ahead of Election Day. I'll share more on this below. Please consider volunteering to phone bank, knock doors, or sign blitz in these last seven days so we can maintain our momentum, and run up the score even more. This past week, Tom and our campaign team were operating on full throttle. Tom spent time at events in all six counties, knocked on doors, and raised the resources needed to keep our closing message on air. He and Rhonda on Sunday in Rahway! Our Field Team spent the week organizing volunteers and working with our local campaign partners on the ground. Our Get Out The Vote (GOTV), vote-by-mail chase, and Early Voting push efforts are proving successful. In NJ-07, we are keeping consistent with our VBM return rates (and even LEADING in Somerset County), and there were for Republicans the first weekend of Early Voting. In the District, we are beating the Democrats by over 7,300 early votes!! The Field Team hosted our usual weekly phone banks, and increased our door-to-door canvassing goal across all six counties. Please do not wait if you have a vote-by-mail ballot. USPS advised that if you are mailing it back, to put it in the mail by November 1st to ensure it is counted in time. Make sure to check your mailbox for your ballot, complete it and send it back by using either a secure dropbox, the U.S. Postal Service, or by delivering it to your county Board of Elections as soon as possible. Early voting is open the rest of the week until Sunday, November 3rd. You can vote at any early voting site in your county, no appointment necessary. Polls are open each day from 10a - 8p, except Sunday (10a - 6p). You can find more information on all ways to vote and participate by visiting our . Are you ready to work to deliver Republican victories next week, and send Tom Kean, Jr. back to Congress? Don't miss the LAST CALL to get involved - just. Read more below to stay up-to-date on everything Kean for Congress has been up to! P.S.: FINAL CALL FOR LAWN SIGNS, to request a Kean for Congress lawn sign now while you can! | | | | | | | ✅ Kean Advocates for Over $1.6M in Funding for Bernards Township Police ✅ | | This past week, Tom continued his FY25 Community Project Funding Tour in Bernards. Hetoured the Bernards Township Police Department to understand local law enforcement needs ahead of the FY25 appropriations. He is advocating for $1,626,100 to enhance communication capabilities for the Bernards Police Department and partner emergency response agencies. “With these resources, local police officers will be able to upgrade their radio communication system, significantly enhancing their ability to communicate and coordinate deployments. This investment is crucial for ensuring the safety and security of this community.” \- Congressman Tom Kean, Jr. | | | | | | | Field Update | | | | | | | | | | | | Tom made stops in Bridgewater to participate in a Jewish Candidate Forum, meet volunteers, and door knock with Councilman Kirsh; Springfield for a ; Lambertville for a launch with the Mercer County Young Republicans and the TCNJ College Republicans; New Providence for the Fall Street Fair; Watchung for their Republican Autumn Reception; Phillipsburg for the Annual Halloween Parade; and Rahway to knock with local candidates and then Early Vote (amongst many other stops)! Tom also participated in interviews with and . Our door knocking program covered towns like Bernards , Bridgewater , Bernardsville , Warren Township , Hillsborough , Westfield , Springfield , Mine Hill , Berkeley Heights , Long Hill , Summit , Clark ,Washington Borough , Pohatcong , Alpha , Lopatcong , Sparta , Byram , Stanhope , Allamuchy , Hackettstown , Frenchtown , Raritan , and Flemington! I would give special thanks to our partners in labor - Operating Engineers Local 825 and IBEW Local 102 for their efforts to help Tom in the Field. IBEW held a labor launch in Mine Hill where they knocked on over 2,000 doors - covering the whole town - and IUOE 825 held a launch in Springfield knocking over 7,000 doors. We are honored to have such fantastic partners in labor on our team, and Tom will continue to fight for their priorities every day in Washington. We have a number of scheduled launches in the final week, including with more with our partners in labor. We hope to see you there. Our final week door goal is the highest we have ever had, and we must make sure we are doing everything we can to reach the voters we need to in the final days. Kean for Congress continued our phone banking efforts with five organized phone banks this week. This week we were able to call over 12,000 voters across all six counties. We also sent out over 175,000 text messages to residents and voters. Hi Derek, it’s
Paul Reiser.

You might know me from Mad About You, Beverly Hills Cop, Stranger Things,
or you might not know me at all. (I almost said, "You might not know me
from Adam” - but that might be confusing in this context.) In any event -
I’m writing to you today about something serious.

Millions of Americans have already voted. They have voted by mail. They
have voted early. And over the next 7 days, tens of millions of additional
votes will be cast. We all face a tremendous choice.

We can turn the page on Donald Trump’s divisive chapter of American
history, move our country forward, and defend our democracy with Kamala
Harris as our President and Adam Schiff as California’s next Senator. Or
we can allow Trump to drag us down into the darkness.

In California’s Senate race, I know where I stand: I’m with Adam Schiff.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/2907?c0=oct2024_abs_em.VpOmzl&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20241029_PM2_V1_S1&email=&t=1004&akid=8084%2E5257348%2EtIZ7i9 ]That’s why I’m asking you to chip in to his campaign. With just 7 days
left in this election, your support now will go a long way in turning out
the voters we need to help Adam win this Senate race AND to elect more
California House Democrats up and down the state.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=oct2024_abs_em.0Y0BaT&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20241029_PM2_V1_S1&email=&t=1005&akid=8084%2E5257348%2EtIZ7i9 ]DONATE

If we want to see action on the climate crisis, Supreme Court reform,
affordable healthcare, and support for democracies worldwide, we need to
send Adam Schiff to the Senate, elect Kamala Harris, and flip control of
the House.

It won’t be easy — Donald Trump treats Adam as one of his biggest
adversaries — because no one has done more than Adam Schiff to stand up to
him.

Trump will do and say anything he can to defeat Adam because of Adam’s
work to hold Trump accountable for his attempts to dismantle our
democracy.

He isn’t just calling Adam names. He’s threatening to use the United
States military to stop Adam and any other “enemies from within” who dare
dissent.

That’s how democracies become dictatorships, and we’d be foolish to
believe it can’t happen here. Especially after Trump’s first term and the
violence on January 6.

I’ve long admired Adam’s work to stand up for the rule of law and our
Constitution. Now, with just 7 days until the election, let’s show our
support for him as he runs for the United States Senate.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/2907?c0=oct2024_abs_em.VpOmzl&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20241029_PM2_V1_S1&email=&t=1006&akid=8084%2E5257348%2EtIZ7i9 ]I trust Adam Schiff to be a key partner in the Senate for Kamala
Harris. I hope you’ll join me in chipping in to his campaign so we can
keep California blue and elect Kamala Harris. Now more than ever, we need
fighters like Adam to lead our country forward.

"**3 Houston ISD staffers accused of running teacher certification cheating ring,** " Houston Landing's **Asher Lehrer-Small** ,**Angelica Perez** and **Jacob Carpenter** -- "Three Houston ISD employees are among the five people charged in connection with a scheme to help hundreds of people cheat on state teacher certification tests, Harris County prosecutors said Monday.

Prosecutors said longtime Booker T. Washington High School boys basketball coach **Vincent Grayson** led a cheating ring in which people typically paid about $2,500 for help fraudulently obtaining a teacher license. As many as 400 people might have illegally obtained a teacher certification in Texas since 2020 through the cheating ring, which netted the organizers about $1 million, prosecutors said.

The scheme involved conspirators taking and administering tests on behalf of aspiring certified teachers, prosecutors said. Investigators believe the hundreds of participants are spread throughout the state, with some likely still in classrooms. The licenses likely helped school employees get promotions, earn higher salaries and keep their teaching jobs, prosecutors said.

"To me, the damage is not just to the education system, which is under great duress right now, but it's actually to to the families of the children who go to those schools, who trust the government to educate their kids and keep them safe for eight hours a day," Harris County District Attorney **Kim Ogg** said during a press conference Monday.

Grayson did not immediately respond to a text or phone call from the Houston Landing. His lawyer, **Cheryl Irvin** , declined to comment, telling the Landing that "I don't know hardly anything" about the details of the indictment yet.
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $70/yr](https://substack.com/redirect/73871e31-cb1c-4e56-abd0-7916c6717221?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The arrests come amid a [rise in uncertified teachers](https://substack.com/redirect/de0d1914-e5df-4b0a-a06a-334e2030b22f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) getting hired in Texas public schools, as fewer people enter the teaching profession through traditional college education programs. Certified teachers must complete a bachelor's degree, a Texas university education preparation program and a state certification exam.

In a statement Monday, Texas Education Agency spokesperson**Jake Kobersky** wrote that the department "will review any and all information shared by law enforcement and pursue appropriate action against any educator involved in this scheme." The State Board of Educator Certification will decide on any punishment, Kobersky said." Prosecutors said longtime Booker T. Washington High School boys basketball coach Vincent Grayson led a cheating ring in which people typically paid about $2,500 for help fraudulently obtaining a teacher license. As many as 400 people might have illegally obtained a teacher certification in Texas since 2020 through the cheating ring, which netted the organizers about $1 million, prosecutors said. The scheme involved conspirators taking and administering tests on behalf of aspiring certified teachers, prosecutors said. Investigators believe the hundreds of participants are spread throughout the state, with some likely still in classrooms. The licenses likely helped school employees get promotions, earn higher salaries and keep their teaching jobs, prosecutors said. "To me, the damage is not just to the education system, which is under great duress right now, but it's actually to to the families of the children who go to those schools, who trust the government to educate their kids and keep them safe for eight hours a day," Harris County District Attorney Kim Ogg said during a press conference Monday. Grayson did not immediately respond to a text or phone call from the Houston Landing. His lawyer, Cheryl Irvin , declined to comment, telling the Landing that "I don't know hardly anything" about the details of the indictment yet. The arrests come amid a getting hired in Texas public schools, as fewer people enter the teaching profession through traditional college education programs. Certified teachers must complete a bachelor's degree, a Texas university education preparation program and a state certification exam. In a statement Monday, Texas Education Agency spokespersonJake Kobersky wrote that the department "will review any and all information shared by law enforcement and pursue appropriate action against any educator involved in this scheme." The State Board of Educator Certification will decide on any punishment, Kobersky said." FREE SUBSCRIPTIONS HAVE ENDED : As of July 11, 2022, we have moved to a paywall for free subscribers. "**3 Houston ISD staffers accused of running teacher certification cheating ring,** " Houston Landing's **Asher Lehrer-Small** ,**Angelica Perez** and **Jacob Carpenter** -- "Three Houston ISD employees are among the five people charged in connection with a scheme to help hundreds of people cheat on state teacher certification tests, Harris County prosecutors said Monday.

Prosecutors said longtime Booker T. Washington High School boys basketball coach **Vincent Grayson** led a cheating ring in which people typically paid about $2,500 for help fraudulently obtaining a teacher license. As many as 400 people might have illegally obtained a teacher certification in Texas since 2020 through the cheating ring, which netted the organizers about $1 million, prosecutors said.

The scheme involved conspirators taking and administering tests on behalf of aspiring certified teachers, prosecutors said. Investigators believe the hundreds of participants are spread throughout the state, with some likely still in classrooms. The licenses likely helped school employees get promotions, earn higher salaries and keep their teaching jobs, prosecutors said.

"To me, the damage is not just to the education system, which is under great duress right now, but it's actually to to the families of the children who go to those schools, who trust the government to educate their kids and keep them safe for eight hours a day," Harris County District Attorney **Kim Ogg** said during a press conference Monday.

Grayson did not immediately respond to a text or phone call from the Houston Landing. His lawyer, **Cheryl Irvin** , declined to comment, telling the Landing that "I don't know hardly anything" about the details of the indictment yet.

Certified teachers must complete a bachelor's degree, a Texas university education preparation program and a state certification exam.

In a statement Monday, Texas Education Agency spokesperson**Jake Kobersky** wrote that the department "will review any and all information shared by law enforcement and pursue appropriate action against any educator involved in this scheme." The State Board of Educator Certification will decide on any punishment, Kobersky said." Peter, it’s Adam Kinzinger.
You might know me as one of the only Republicans in Congress on the January 6th Committee, and one of 10 Republicans who voted to impeach Trump.
I’ll be straight with you — I’m a proud conservative. But I am doing everything in my power to defeat Donald Trump and MAGA extremism at the ballot box in November. Our democracy is more important than parties or politics.
[**That’s why I’m supporting Ruben Gallego’s Senate campaign in Arizona. Will you chip in $5 or $10 to help him take on Kari Lake and win?**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-oct24.6QErJb&refcode=em241029-5-160&t=2&akid=3482%2E734936%2EHGUHMC)

Ruben and I are both veterans. We were both on the floor of the House on January 6th. We both saw the consequences of the lies that Trump and Kari Lake spread in advance of that terrible day and in the years since.

Adam

Hey there, friend,
I want to take a moment to tell you about the person who most influenced me and my politics — my mother. She was the person who introduced me to politics without knowing that's what she was doing.
[ ](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqu4ksFa5SF7IXH6Sr7Lz9yTXJnNaBzaqSWKIi6GZ5qrbKk3eDMVq1fh1WdYImV-tWUyz4OZ0ukk7eMYGd272FphBQALRxY3VLmKlyyM07BLCoTpIV45a_Ej47YVrqlBsBybiUmmm2XnkkS6Rt1rG5fSjv46fZB3Ay7zagZS9fyxK1jCt4zJKE-6dvqQUEokD4nR6urBg_EvKtHNKuv7iLMV7kKeM1srhuOPBstlquW7Y7JeirbteFw4LUFz1xdXO4QBA2RC_vnHKRjBTebeVNHGVqU_MSlRG62DOkcb3u8qspAU2AOCPBw4Z1FYCXCIEYJ5m00M3ddPNfALqs5kpZ9rin_F9zJiC4WOQvH2tU4vSMDsH_mgpPCu2AgV1Ae2rUpFqO6O6TRmKReS8rkrdFs9RyTUPH9uiGCvGoeY2_JDzw/4b0/oj4JKFJSTOiiC49OGLQAgQ/h1/h001.2hqya-GSmLjvbx1BbR1lR8XQ1kMXtsDGQHuFjWQUnPc)

My mom never graduated from high school or college but was a small business owner and employer. She was a cancer survivor, foster mother, adopted me, and later took in a family of 13 kids (a combination of siblings and cousins) in our little three-bedroom house.
The family we took in at the time were the children of two sisters who went out for groceries and never came back. They were alone for almost two weeks with the older siblings tending to the younger kids. One of the younger kids went to the school nurse for food because she was hungry. That’s when the state got involved planning to split the kids up.
She knew the very last thing these kids needed was to lose each other and campaigned for them — she led the charge to find local families to adopt all 13 kids with a commitment to stay in the area.
**My mom was the one who taught me that people need to see that you care about them, that you have a heart for them, that you're not just there about the policy, but how the policy impacts the family.** She was the biggest influence on me politically to stand up and work through the system to make it work.
She would often tell me “if you have to tell someone you’re a Christian, then are you really a Christian?” and it makes me think “if I have to tell people I’m a Democrat — talk about how we’re the party of diversity and inclusion and accessibility — am I really living that life?”
**I believe my role as Chair of the Nevada State Democratic Party is to build the community within the state, our state party with other state party leaders around the country to show and not tell voters what we’re about.** It’s not just about knocking on doors to say “vote for me” but showing up in that neighborhood and in our schools, being there for people knowing what their needs are and answering them.

[**_It takes a village to build a community and I need your help to make sure that we’re doing it right for Nevadans — chip in $20, $35, or whatever you can towards building our community and state party that delivers positive impacts._**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqu4ksFa5SF7IXH6Sr7Lz9yTXJnNaBzaqSWKIi6GZ5qrbKk3eDMVq1fh1WdYImV-tWUyz4OZ0ukk7eMYGd272FphC2Aj-v5ZVWM-t7k_TG41hS2Gl1YsOg_-4tyu52DAFBmziMW2iekfGi8kqIjx72j8WZH7m7MJa5l64eL4CmvcKTm5XASu-3uIHioY1FVAHOq8ZkhLg4hbnAFVGHu1o8ZHlP92aizQfIWcYWSUvVbHgNHUFoJ72Q8mhZSgPYtEnfIoswp80J8t6Bhiwv9nZYCrTQqxj24OQF6cOjiVhJ1R6RQVwYOV-lV8DwEEHnrnrNV7VFOZV3Uy88Sk3JFRqQZhASfkABPFy42gZsiLtD9VEwCj4WbOxlT_3TZYoPEn8Vavx82f3rnKOZ8H4LhTea6Mgqg_fnwQ50R_b-zU7zz45w/4b0/oj4JKFJSTOiiC49OGLQAgQ/h2/h001.0neRbJD6jTbCemjmS8ZuCV1-kxpFE-41knXt6W65z94)

clean_body: | | | | Hey there, friend, I want to take a moment to tell you about the person who most influenced me and my politics — my mother. She was the person who introduced me to politics without knowing that's what she was doing. My mom never graduated from high school or college but was a small business owner and employer. She was a cancer survivor, foster mother, adopted me, and later took in a family of 13 kids (a combination of siblings and cousins) in our little three-bedroom house. The family we took in at the time were the children of two sisters who went out for groceries and never came back. They were alone for almost two weeks with the older siblings tending to the younger kids. One of the younger kids went to the school nurse for food because she was hungry. That’s when the state got involved planning to split the kids up. She knew the very last thing these kids needed was to lose each other and campaigned for them — she led the charge to find local families to adopt all 13 kids with a commitment to stay in the area. My mom was the one who taught me that people need to see that you care about them, that you have a heart for them, that you're not just there about the policy, but how the policy impacts the family. She was the biggest influence on me politically to stand up and work through the system to make it work. She would often tell me “if you have to tell someone you’re a Christian, then are you really a Christian?” and it makes me think “if I have to tell people I’m a Democrat — talk about how we’re the party of diversity and inclusion and accessibility — am I really living that life?” I believe my role as Chair of the Nevada State Democratic Party is to build the community within the state, our state party with other state party leaders around the country to show and not tell voters what we’re about. It’s not just about knocking on doors to say “vote for me” but showing up in that neighborhood and in our schools, being there for people knowing what their needs are and answering them.
